rows.english:
Good luck with this one, it is many times harder than the previous tiers. It is required to make extremely endgame materials such as hypogen.

The MK IV reactor grants 4/4 perfect overclocks for every machine tier above the minimum recipe tier instead of the 2/2 perfect overclocks from the previous tiers. That means the speed and power consumption are both quadrupled instead of doubled each time.

Regardless, you may notice the MK IV recipes are §oquite§o §rslow, perhaps consider making a Compact Fusion Reactor instead?

[note]You only have to complete one task to finish this quest.[/note]

rows.before: 你需要龍血製造第一批海珀珍。也許你已經有了些龍血，是很久以前擊殺終界龍掉落的，正躺在某個地方。不過還有兩個其他選擇：蜜蜂和龍研聚合裝置。%n%n對於蜜蜂路線，你需要深入研究蜜蜂培育線，但說不定你已經完成了？不論如何，看看“蜜蜂育種”工作列吧。%n%n在龍研聚合裝置中有兩個配方。較好的一個要用到巫術mod的無限之蛋。如果你沒有巫術進度的話，就只能用普通龍蛋，使用較弱的配方了。%n%n只要你有了些海珀珍，就能以此開始在超維度電漿鍛爐中製造更多，而不需要龍血了。我不知道為何這麼設計，要抱怨就找Colen吧。%n%n不過，你最終還是需要更多的龍血，以製造UMV超導。%n%n[note]實際上還有另一種方法獲得龍血，這與龍研聚合裝置的配方相似，不過是用攪拌機，它的速度更慢，資源利用率更低。尤其要注意的是，這個配方會消耗龍蛋。所以只有在你需要完全避開魔法和蜜蜂線的時候，才使用這個配方。[/note]%n%n[note]只是個提醒：流體任務目標只要求你物品欄內某個容器中有相應的流體。（單元、通用流體單元、大型單元、容量瓶，等等。）[/note]

rows.english:
For your first batch of Hypogen you will need some Dragonblood. Maybe you already have some lying around somewhere from killing the dragon a long time ago. You have 2 other options though. Bees and the DE Fusion Crafter.

For the bee path you have to go very deep into the breeding tree, but maybe you have already done that? Check the Bee Breeding tab either way.

In the DE Fusion Crafter you have 2 recipes. The better one uses an Infinity Egg from Witchery. Without any Witchery you can also just a normal dragon egg for the weaker recipe.

Once you have a bit of Hypogen you can then use that as a starting point to make more in your DTPF without any Dragonblood. I don't know why it works that way, complain to Colen.

However, you will still need more Dragonblood eventually for UMV superconductors.

[note]There is actually another way to get Dragonblood which is similar to the DE Fusion Crafter recipes but in the mixer instead. It's even slower and less resource efficient. In particular, the dragon egg does not survive the process. So only use that if you are absolutely trying to avoid magic and bees.[/note]

[note]Just a reminder: a fluid task just needs you to have the fluid in some container in your inventory. (cell, universal cell, large cell, volumetric cell, etc.)[/note]

rows.before: UEV能源倉？好極了！是時候獲得第二座星門的獎盃了。%n和上次一樣，要獲得獎盃你必須提交兩座星門的材料。%n%n§3第二座獎盃把我們帶到了<GT:NH>過去之旅的第二章，早期的UEV時代。%n%n在2022年早些時候，UEV等級的內容雖然還很空虛，但已經變得比以前有用的多了。UEV-UMV能源倉現在有了適當的配方（雖然使用的是UEV部件），光學貼片元件現在也投入使用了，萬幸。%n終於有比堆普通電漿渦輪更好的動力源選擇了，那就是矽岩燃料和壓縮核融合反應爐+XL電漿渦輪陣列。從技術上講，戴森雲也可以投入使用了，但它存在嚴重的漏洞，而且其“合法”動力輸出合理地說不會超過60億EU/t（與全力生產氦電漿的壓縮核融合MK4差不多）。%n一些有用的多方塊機器包括精密組裝機、巨型化學反應釜和巨型石油裂化機被引入了，此外，在巨型多方塊機器上的超頻現在已經可以超過MAX電壓。%n星門再次成為了一個遙不可及的目標，因為他現在需要極大數量的無盡催化劑和生物處理器，要求玩家把對新技術的利用推向極限。%n%n兩個玩家，§aPhineasor§3和§aGDCloud§3決心第一個完成這個目標，經過幾個月的激烈角逐，最終決出了勝負。§a%nGDCloud§3贏得了比賽並在§a2022年5月27日§3征服了這輪nerf。%n%n附註：再一次地，如果您想忠實於曾經的挑戰，請嘗試在不使用以下功能的情況下完成此任務：%n-PCB工廠，太空電梯，部件裝配線，進階裝配線，工業屠宰場，極限工業溫室，巨型合金冶煉爐%n-任何與蜜蜂有關的GT機器%n-任何UEV或以上的多方塊機器（除了低產能的戴森雲和矽岩燃料精煉廠）%n-大型源質發電機%n-低於1t的超頻，批處理，多方塊機器內建的溢位保護%n-ME請求器，AE2FC，儲存輸入匯流排/倉，樣板輸入匯流排，ME輸出倉%n%n附註2：同樣，混沌電容庫也被排除在外，原因與UV星門任務中所述的相同。對了，星門零件以前是UXV配方，但由於UMV倉室已經無法在UEV等級中製作，所以它們被下放到了UIV中，使其可以在UEV中製作。

rows.english:
UEV energy hatches? Great! Time for stargate trophy number two.
Once again, to get your trophy you have to submit two stargates' worth of materials.

§3Trophy number two brings us to chapter two of our journey through GTNHs past, the early UEV era.

The year 2022 has just begun and the UEV tier, albeit still quite empty, has become more useful than before. UEV-UMV energy hatches now have proper recipes (although with UEV parts) and optical SMDs are a thing now, hooray.
There finally are better powergen options than regular plasma turbine spam, namely naq fuel and compact fusions + XL plasma turbine spam. Technically dyson too, but that is horribly bugged and its 'legit' power output reasonably can't exceed around 6 billion EU/t (around the same as a compact MK4 running helium plasma).
Some useful newly introduced multis are the PrAss, MCR & Mega Oil Cracker and overclocks past MAX voltage are possible on megas now.
Stargate has once again become a distant goal, as it now required exorbitant amounts or infinity catalyst and bio circuits, requiring to utilize the new tech to its fullest.

Two players, §aPhineasor§3 & §aGDCloud§3 were determined to be first to completing this goal, and after months of a close friendly race, the winner had been decided. §a
GDCloud§3 won the race and conquered this round of nerfs on the §a27th of May, 2022§3.

P.S.: Once again, if you want to be faithful to the challenge, try completing it without these additions:
-PCB Factory, Space Elevator, Component Assemblyline, AAL, EEC, EIG, MABS
-Any bee related GT machines
-Any UEV or above multis (except weak dyson and naq refineries)
-LEG
-Sub 1-tick OC, Batch Mode, inbuilt Void Protection on multis
-Level Maintainer, AE Fluid Crafting, Stocking Buses/Hatches, Crafting Input Buses, ME Output Hatches

P.P.S.: Again the chaotic capacitor banks have been left out for the same reason as stated in the UV gate quest. Oh and the stargate parts used to be UXV recipes, but since UMV hatches are not craftable in UEV anymore, they have been downtiered to UIV to make them craftable in UEV.

rows.before: 超時空金屬是UIV部件中使用的主要金屬。%n%n這種金屬與您迄今為止處理過的金屬略有不同。您需要粉碎您的超立方體以獲得粉末，然後在高溫下對其進行燒煉，因此您需要冷卻劑來幫助控制熱量。%n%n由於超立方體粒子的不可思議的性質，您需要一種介質來使它們在三維空間中形成。出於某種原因，鎢在這方面的效果非常好。%n%n由於超時空金屬錠本身也不是很穩定；因此，必須在冷卻過程中塗上一層泰坦精鋼。%n%n[note]考慮搭建被動產線製造超時空金屬錠，因為整個製造過程非常緩慢。[/note]%n%n[note]你現在可以進入UIV了。祝你好運。[/note]

rows.english:
Transcendent Metal is the primary metal used in UIV components.

This metal is a bit different from the ones you have been processing so far. You need to macerate your tesseracts to get the dust and then blast it at such high temperatures that you'll need a coolant to help manage the heat.

Due to the impossible nature of the tesseract particles, you'll need a medium to enable them to form 3D shapes. Tungsten, for some reason, works very well for this purpose.

The ingot itself is also not very stable; therefore, a coating of titansteel must be applied during the cooling process.

[note]Consider passively generating it. This process is slow.[/note]

With the §1§lMothership§r (see the Space Race tab for how to build one) you can visit the truly last system: the Amun-Ra system. It has six planets and moons you can visit, each with at least one unique ore vein.

§l§nAnubis§r
Infinity Catalyst vein (Neutronium, Adamantium, Infinity Catalyst, Bedrockium)

§l§nHorus§r
Cosmic Neutronium vein (Neutronium, Cosmic Neutronium, Black Plutonium, Bedrockium)

§l§nMaahes§r
Naquadria vein (Naquadah, Enriched Naquadah, Naquadria, Trinium)

§l§nMehen Belt§r
Awakened Draconium vein (Draconium, Draconium, Awakened Draconium, Nether Star)

§l§nNeper§r
Dilithium (Dilithium, Dilithium, Mysterious Crystal, Vinteum)

§l§nSeth§r
Raw Tengam (Raw Tengam, Raw Tengam, Electrotine, Samarium)

Raw Tengam is the vein you will want the most, as you can process Raw Tengam into Attuned Tengam, which is the UEV+ replacement for Magnetic Samarium. On Horus and Neper generate Certus Quartz veins (Certus Quartz, Certus Quartz, Charged Certus Quartz, Quartz Sand) as well §mI can't imagine why you would still need that though§r.

rows.before: 最終，你做到了。超維度電漿鍛爐是一個強大的多方塊機器，需要消耗大量能源和催化劑才能運作。持續執行8小時或更長時間可以將催化劑消耗降低50%%，因此你應當找到自動化的方法來節省昂貴的催化劑。%n%n你總共需要2112個線圈方塊。接受的線圈等級為%n%n- 覺醒龍%n- 無盡%n- 海珀珍%n- 永恆%n%n雖然你可以從覺醒龍線圈開始，但至少需要無盡線圈來製造UIV的超立方體，所以直接跳到這些更高等級的線圈可能更划算。%n%n[note]也許它可以用來烘焙異星餅乾？[/note]
rows.after: 最終，你做到了。超維度電漿鍛爐是一個強大的多方塊機器，需要消耗大量能源和催化劑才能運作。持續執行8小時或更長時間可以將催化劑消耗降低50%%，因此你應當找到自動化的方法來節省昂貴的催化劑。%n%n你總共需要2112個線圈方塊。接受的線圈等級為%n%n- 覺醒龍%n- 無盡%n- 海珀珍%n- 永恆%n%n雖然你可以從覺醒龍線圈開始，但至少需要無盡線圈來製造UIV的超立方體，所以直接跳到這些更高等級的線圈可能更划算。%n%n[note]也許它可以用來烘焙異星餅乾？[/note]
rows.english:
At last, you have done it. The DTPF is a mighty multiblock fueled by large amounts of power and catalyst. Running it constantly for 8 hours or longer reduces catalyst consumption by 50%, so you will want to find a way to automate this to save on expensive catalyst.

You will need 2112 coil blocks in total. Accepted coil tiers are

- Awakened Draconium
- Infinity
- Hypogen
- Eternal

While you can start with Awakened Draconium coils, you will need at least infinity coils to make tesseracts for UIV, so it may be worth it to skip to those immediately

[note]Perhaps it can be used to bake exotic cookies?[/note]
rows.note: 第1082篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。2112線圈、8小時及催化劑減半未全面核對程式，保留。

rows.before: §5§l§nUEV能源倉
rows.after: §5§l§nUEV能源倉
rows.english: UEV Energy Hatch
rows.note: 第1083篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 又一個電壓等級，又一個能源倉，你可以用它們把裝配線超頻到UIV來給它加加速，
rows.after: 又一個電壓等級，又一個能源倉。你可以用它們把裝配線超頻到UIV電壓，提升處理速度。
rows.english: Another tier, another energy hatch. You can use these to overclock your assembly lines to UIV voltage and speed them up.
rows.note: 第1083篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§n更廉價的ZPM電路板
rows.after: §5§l§n更廉價的ZPM電路
rows.english: Cheaper ZPM Circuits
rows.note: 第1085篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 活性生物晶片可以同時處理更多的任務，你的ZPM電路板也更便宜了！%n%n[note]這個配方會消耗不少海珀珍，也許你可以等到海珀珍更加便宜的時候再使用這個配方。[/note]
rows.after: 活性生物晶片可以同時處理更多的任務，你的ZPM電路也更便宜了！%n%n[note]這個配方會消耗不少海珀珍，也許你可以等到海珀珍更加便宜的時候再使用這個配方。[/note]
rows.english:
Living bio chip can perform multiple tasks at once and will make your ZPM circuits cheaper!

[note]This does cost quite a bit of hypogen, perhaps hold off on using these until you can make hypogen easily.[/note]
rows.note: 第1085篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§n下載更多記憶體
rows.after: §5§l§n下載更多記憶體

rows.note: 第1086篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 只有最先進的記憶體晶片才能與光學電腦一同工作。
rows.after: 只有最先進的記憶體晶片才能與光學電腦一同工作。
rows.english: Only the most advanced memory chips will do when working with optical computers.
rows.note: 第1086篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§n為超維度電漿鍛爐提供燃料
rows.after: §5§l§n為超維度電漿鍛爐提供燃料
rows.english: Fueling the DTPF
rows.note: 第1087篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 要執行超維度電漿鍛爐，你需要提供激發的催化劑。目前你可以製造四個等級的催化劑，另一種催化劑將在之後解鎖。製造這些催化劑需要大量能量和時間，所以你幾乎肯定會用許多機器被動生產。%n%n在UIV階段，你將解鎖§p§o電漿攪拌機§r，一臺能用比你現在快的多的速度製造催化劑的專用多方塊機器，儘管這需要巨大的電力成本。無論如何，儘可能快的造出這臺機器也許是個好主意。
rows.after: 要執行超維度電漿鍛爐，你需要提供激發的催化劑。目前你可以製造四個等級的催化劑，另一種催化劑將在之後解鎖。製造這些催化劑需要大量能量和時間，所以你幾乎肯定會用許多機器被動生產。%n%n在UIV階段，你將解鎖§p§o電漿攪拌機§r，一臺能用比你現在快的多的速度製造催化劑的專用多方塊機器，儘管這需要巨大的電力成本。無論如何，儘可能快的造出這臺機器也許是個好主意。
rows.english:
To run the DTPF, you will need to feed it excited catalyst. There are four tiers of catalyst you can make right now, and one more to unlock later. Making these catalysts requires a lot of power and time, so you will almost certainly want to passive this with many machines.

In UIV, you will unlock the §p§oplasma mixer§r, a dedicated multiblock that can make catalyst much faster than you currently can, although this comes at an enormous power cost. Either way, it's probably a good idea to get this as soon as you can.
rows.note: 第1087篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§n完美的CPU？
rows.after: §5§l§n完美的CPU？
rows.english: The Perfect CPU?
rows.note: 第1088篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 利用新的光學電路基板和光學裸片，你已經成功製造出了一個看起來完美的CPU！這肯定能夠處理你超越維度邊界所需要的高階計算。
rows.after: 利用新的光學電路基板和光學裸片，你已經成功製造出了一個看起來完美的CPU！這肯定能夠處理你超越維度邊界所需要的高階計算。
rows.english: Using your new optically enhanced boards and chips, you've managed to create what looks like the perfect CPU! Surely this will be able to handle even the advanced computations you need to perform to breach dimensional boundaries.
rows.note: 第1088篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§n第10階段（UEV）
rows.after: §5§l§n第10階段（UEV）
rows.english: Tier 10 (UEV)
rows.note: 第1089篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 歡迎來到超極限壓（UEV）！你已經開始了第一塊無盡的製造，現在是時候擴張規模了。在這個階段，所有的部件都需要無盡。做好製作成噸無盡的準備吧。你的主要目標是製作超維度電漿鍛爐（DTPF）。這個巨大的多方塊機器會解鎖新的強力配方，用於製作無盡、中子和其他特殊材料。%n%n[note]中文wiki UEV階段：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/94585[/url]§r[/note]
rows.after: 歡迎來到超極限壓（UEV）！你已經開始了第一塊無盡的製造，現在是時候擴張規模了。在這個階段，所有的部件都需要無盡。做好製作成噸無盡的準備吧。你的主要目標是製作超維度電漿鍛爐（DTPF）。這個巨大的多方塊機器會解鎖新的強力配方，用於製作無盡、中子和其他特殊材料。%n%n[note]中文wiki UEV階段：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/94585[/url]§r[/note]
rows.english: Welcome to Extremely Ultimate Voltage! Now that you've started making your first infinity, it's time to start scaling up. In this tier, every component will require infinity. Be prepared to make tons. Your main goal to advance will be to build the Dimensionally Transcendent Plasma Forge, also known as the DTPF. This massive multiblock will unlock new powerful recipes to create infinity, neutronium and other special materials.
rows.note: 第1089篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§n最後一次
rows.after: §5§l§n最後一次
rows.english: One Last Time
rows.note: 第1092篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 為了目前遊戲中的最後一條電路板產線，你需要製作最後一個電路組裝機，或者為電路裝配線製作一個UEV能源倉。
rows.after: 為了目前遊戲中的最後一條電路產線，你需要製作最後一臺電路組裝機，或者為電路裝配線製作一個UEV能源倉。
rows.english: For the final circuit line currently in the game, you will need to either make one last circuit assembler, or a UEV hatch for your circuit assembly machine.
rows.note: 第1092篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§n穩定重子物質
rows.after: §5§l§n穩定重子物質
rows.english: Stabilized Baryonic Matter
rows.note: 第1093篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 在完成絕對重子完美淨化單元的自動化後，你將會緩慢的開始得到穩定重子物質，產出速率為500mB每120秒每並行。
rows.after: 在完成絕對重子完美淨化單元的自動化後，你將會緩慢的開始得到穩定重子物質，產出速率為500mB每120秒每並行。
rows.english: After automating Absolute Baryonic Perfection Purification Unit, you slowly start getting Stabilized Baryonic Matter, at a rate of 500mb/parallel every 120 seconds.
rows.note: 第1093篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§n為裝配線提供無線資料！
rows.after: §5§l§n為裝配線提供無線資料！
rows.english: Wireless Data for Your Assembly Lines!
rows.note: 第1096篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 接下來你可能不得不建造一堆裝配線，而資料庫無線傳送介面和裝配線無線接收介面可以讓你避免為它們建造，連線大量的資料庫和光纜。%n%n要使用這個，你需要先用螺絲刀右擊儲存快閃記憶體的資料庫，再在資料庫上放一個資料庫無線傳送介面，最後在裝配線上放一個裝配線無線接收介面。%n%n[note]無線資料倉可以多對多。[/note]
rows.after: 接下來你可能不得不建造一堆裝配線，而資料庫無線傳送介面和裝配線無線接收介面可以讓你避免為它們建造，連線大量的資料庫和光纜。%n%n要使用這個，你需要先用螺絲刀右擊儲存快閃記憶體的資料庫，再在資料庫上放一個資料庫無線傳送介面，最後在裝配線上放一個裝配線無線接收介面。%n%n[note]無線資料倉可以多對多。[/note]
rows.english:
Wireless Data Bank Transmission Connector and Wireless Assembly line Reception Connector lets you avoid building and connecting dozens of Data Banks and Optical Fiber Cable for the upcoming Assembly Lines you might have to build.

To use it, you have to screwdriver the Data Bank that is storing the data sticks, place a Wireless Data Bank Transmission Connector into the Data Bank, then Wireless Assembly line Reception Connector for the Assembly Lines.

[note]Wireless Data Hatches are N:M instead of 1:1[/note]
rows.note: 第1096篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §5§l§nUEV超導
rows.after: §5§l§nUEV超導
rows.english: UEV Superconductors
rows.note: 第1098篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。中文額外建議高階鎳鈦諾電漿線；英文僅天體鎢，版本差異保留。

rows.before: UEV超導，又一個無盡的無底洞。你可以直接使用雷射蝕刻機來生產天體鎢和高階鎳鈦諾，但這相當慢。或許應該考慮一下這兩位的電漿產線？
rows.after: UEV超導，又一個無盡的無底洞。你可以直接使用雷射蝕刻機來生產天體鎢和高階鎳鈦諾，但這相當慢。或許應該考慮一下這兩位的電漿產線？
rows.english: UEV superconductors, another great infinity sink. You can make the celestial tungsten and advanced nitinol in a laser engraver directly, but this is quite slow. Perhaps consider using the celestial tungsten plasma line?
rows.note: 第1098篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。中文額外建議高階鎳鈦諾電漿線；英文僅天體鎢，版本差異保留。

rows.before: §5§l§n無盡胸甲
rows.after: §5§l§n無盡胸甲
rows.english: Infinity Breastplate
rows.note: 第1100篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 配得上神的盔甲，這件胸甲能為穿戴者提供無限的創造飛行，並能消除所有負面效果。%n%n一旦你穿戴了全套的裝備，你將完全無法被殺死。
rows.after: 配得上神的盔甲，這件胸甲能為穿戴者提供無限的創造飛行，並能消除所有負面效果。%n%n一旦你穿戴了全套的裝備，你將完全無法被殺死。
rows.english:
An armor set worthy of a God. This breastplate provides the user infinite creative flight and removes all negative debuffs.

While wearing the complete set, you are completely unkillable.
rows.note: 第1100篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §9§l太陽核融合異化器
rows.after: §9§l太陽核融合異化器
rows.english: §b§lHeliofusion Exoticizer
rows.note: 第1105篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 使用大量引力子碎片會創造出極端的空間區域，在這些區域中，異星物質可以比通常情況下更穩定地存在。不幸的是，這個區域極端到幾乎與神鍛的其他部分在空間上完全斷開，無法利用現有的結構升級和它的其餘功能。%n%n[note]太陽核融合異化器是神鍛的第四個也是最後一個模組。它可以生產夸克膠子電漿和磁物質。最初它只能生產夸克膠子電漿，而生產磁物質需要一個更靠後的升級。查閱UI中的“神鍛資訊”部分以獲知如何生產這些材料。[/note]%n%n[note]使用此模組需要“強子隔離”升級。[/note]
rows.after: 使用大量引力子碎片會創造出極端的空間區域，在這些區域中，異星物質可以比通常情況下更穩定地存在。不幸的是，這個區域極端到幾乎與神鍛的其他部分在空間上完全斷開，無法利用現有的結構升級和它的其餘功能。%n%n[note]太陽核融合異化器是神鍛的第四個也是最後一個模組。它可以生產夸克膠子電漿和磁物質。最初它只能生產夸克膠子電漿，而生產磁物質需要一個更靠後的升級。查閱UI中的“神鍛資訊”部分以獲知如何生產這些材料。[/note]%n%n[note]使用此模組需要“強子隔離”升級。[/note]
rows.english:
Using large quantities of graviton shards creates regions of space so extreme that exotic forms of matter can exist with far greater stability than usual. Unfortunately, this region is so extreme that it is essentially spatially disconnected from the rest of the Forge, unable to utilize existing upgrades to the structure and its other modules.

[note]The fourth and final module of the Godforge, Heliofusion Exoticizer allows for the production of Quark Gluon Plasma and Magmatter. Initially only Quark Gluon Plasma is possible, with Magmatter requiring a much later upgrade. Consult the Godforge Information section of the UI to read how to produce these materials.[/note]

[note]Usage of this module requires the QGPIU upgrade.[/note]
rows.note: 第1105篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §9§l§n亞穩態黑洞遏制場
rows.after: §9§l§n亞穩態黑洞遏制場
rows.english: Pseudostable Black Hole Containment Field
rows.note: 第1109篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 隨著你周圍材料的卓越特性逐漸顯現，你發現傳統的壓縮方式，如活塞或氣體的壓力，已然無法將它們緊密地壓縮到所需的程度。%n%n那麼解決方案是什麼呢？答案是利用引力的強大力量。透過在四維的充能超立方體上施加極大的爆炸力，你可以在時空結構上撕開微小的裂縫，從而創造出一個能夠孕育黑洞的種子。如果你能構建一臺能駕馭它的機器，它將能夠將即使是最堅固的材料壓縮到可能達到的最緻密狀態。%n%n馴服黑洞絕非易事——即便有了所有預防措施，它仍然會不斷挑戰你試圖穩定它的努力，並試圖使自己坍縮。因此，有效延長黑洞的壽命將是極其困難的。透過精確校準的玻璃來彎曲時空，你可以逆轉霍金輻射，使其流回黑洞，從而保持其完全穩定——然而，需要注意的是，為了維持這一過程所需的時空量以指數級增長。%n%n隨著黑洞衰變，其威力反而增強——但請謹慎，因為它最終會變得不穩定，而你也將無法從事件視界邊緣取回物品。為了安全關閉黑洞並重新啟動此過程，你已經用相同的四維材料設計了一個坍縮器。%n%n[note]亞穩態黑洞遏制場是遊戲中最強大的壓縮機，可以將任何材料製造為超緻密板，同時還能夠執行更高階的中子態素壓縮機配方，從而節省大量資源.[/note]%n%n[note]請務必在輸入匯流排中使用程式設計電路，以確定機器是作為壓縮機還是中子態素壓縮機執行![/note]

rows.english:
As the materials around you achieve transcendental properties, you have found that traditional modes of compression like pistons or gases will not be enough to compact them as densely as you require.

The solution? Using the sheer force of gravity. By using extreme amounts of explosive force on your fourth-dimensionally engineered tesseracts, you can tear tiny rifts in the fabric of space, enough to create a seed which can birth a black hole. If you can build a machine which can harness it, it will be able to compress even the strongest materials to the most dense states possible.

Taming a black hole is no easy task - even with all of your precautions, it defies your efforts to stabilize it and attempts to collapse itself constantly. Meaningfully extending the lifespan of the black hole will be extremely difficult. By bending spacetime through carefully aligned glass, you can reverse the flow of hawking radiation back into the black hole and keep it completely stable - problematically, however, the amount of spacetime required to maintain this process increases at an exponential rate.

As the black hole decays, it becomes even more powerful - but be wary, as it will eventually become unstable and you will no longer be able to recover your items from the edge of the event horizon. To safely close the black hole and restart this process, you have engineered a collapser out of the same fourth-dimensional materials.

[note]The Pseudostable Black Hole Containment Field is the most powerful compressor in the game, capable of creating superdense plates out of any material, as well as being able to perform more advanced neutronium compressor recipes that will save incredible amounts of resources.[/note]

[note]You must use programmed circuits in the input buses to determine if the machine will act as a Compressor or Neutronium Compressor![/note]

As usage of the Forge continues, more data on graviton shards is gathered. It has been found that they can stabilize the outputs of the Forge, allowing for the direct extraction of molten material while it is still close to the heart of the star.

[note]The second module of the Godforge, Helioflux Melting Core allows processing EBF recipes by directly outputting molten metal when possible. This may not always be as efficient as other methods, but the time and scaling saved from Vacuum Freezer steps often more than makes up for this.[/note]

[note]Usage of this module requires the FDIM upgrade.[/note]

rows.before: 在你對§b§l神鍛計劃§r的研究中，你發現你需要用一種新型燃料來創造一顆中子星。矽岩燃料具有一些你需要的特性，但還不夠。用異星催化劑穩定燃料，再用其他材料大幅度提升燃料的密度，這些辦法讓你找到了一種可能有效的燃料。%n%n在合成的過程中，你意識到這種燃料可以被用於製作[note]暗物質[/note]。一種你曾經只在阿蒙·拉星系的邁罕帶見到過的物質。%n%n[note]如果你不想合成暗物質碎片的話，也可以在邁罕帶搜尋並人工開採。[/note]

In your research on §b§lProject Godforge§r, you determine that you need a new type of fuel to create a neutron star. Naquadah Fuel possesses some of the properties needed, but isn't enough. Stabilizing this fuel with Exotic Catalyst, and drastically increasing the density of the fuel with other things leads you to something that may just work.

During this synthesis, you realize that this fuel could be used to make [note]Dark Matter[/note], something you previously had only seen on the Mehen Belt in the Amun-Ra System.

[note]Dark Matter Shards can be found in the Mehen Belt and mined manually, if you don't want to synthesize it.[/note]

rows.english:
Definitely consider making one.

The Transcendent Plasma Mixer is a powerful asset for all your DTPF catalyst needs.

The base processing time is always 5 seconds. You can specify the number of parallels the machine can run in the GUI.

Each parallel additively increases the power requirement, so you don't lose any efficiency while increasing production!

[note]Most of your power will go here. Consider upgrading your naquadah fuel or creating the Dyson Swarm.[/note]

After many hours of grind, blood, sweat, tears, and a little bit of transcendent metal...
You are now finally able to solve mankind's hardest puzzle ever, clicking boxes randomly.

The §cUncertainty Resolution§r, §oa Dyson user's wet dream§r, will allow you to completely skip that annoying puzzle when you need to set some (probably a lot.) Quantum Computers up.

rows.english:
Stabilizing the neutron star of the Godforge was successful, but now you need something new to extract the power out of it into something usable. Your experiments lead you to using the newly discovered Mellion with a Transcendent Metal Nanite to create what seems like a crystal seed of some type, which exhibits perfect thermal conductance.

Processing this seed further into a solution, you realize you can grow this crystal into a slurry-like solution, which you decide to name [note]Phonon Transfer Medium[/note]. This incredible material displays exactly the properties you were looking for, and decide that now you can move forward with the second module of the Godforge.

This material is made as a plasma, and must be cooled alongside an extremely sturdy material. You try a curious mixture of dusts, which you decide to name [note]Mellion[/note].

[note]These materials may also be suitable for components you need many of, you may realize UIV components seem to handle these two materials quite well...[/note]

rows.before: 隨著計劃的最終完成，以及一種能夠掌握中子星能量的新材料的問世，你自然決定這種偉力的首次應用是一臺更為卓越的高爐。稍作思考之後，你決定有必要再來一臺，因為這個模組也可以很容易地被改造成一個普通熔爐。%n%n[note]太陽烈焰能量鍛爐是神鍛的第一個模組。在不同模式下，它分別可以執行工業高爐和熔爐的配方。可以在UI中切換模式，注意：熔爐模式不會被計入“轉換”里程碑！[/note]%n%n[note]使用此模組需要“由此開始”升級。[/note]

With the project finally completed, and a new material capable of harnessing the power of a neutron star, you decide the natural first application of this immense power could be used for a far superior Blast Furnace. With a little tinkering, you decide a second may be necessary, since this module could easily be retrofitted into an ordinary Furnace as well.

[note]The first module of the Godforge, Helioflare Power Forge can perform EBF recipes and Furnace recipes in separate running modes, toggleable in the UI. Note that the Furnace mode does NOT contribute towards the Conversion milestone![/note]

[note]Usage of this module requires the START upgrade.[/note]

rows.before: 隨著對引力子碎片理解的不斷深入，你改進了控制它們的方式，讓它們可以更好的操控物質。引力子碎片提供了一種替代電磁約束電漿的方法，透過時空操控代替電磁場，從而使神鍛能夠直接將物質以電漿的形式輸出。%n%n[note]太陽熱能電漿製造機是神鍛的第三個模組。它可以直接把物質轉換成其電漿形式，代價是耗費極多的能量。這種方法對大部分電漿來說都不理想，不過用在某些耐聚王上可以節約大量的時間。此外，之後的升級允許此模組製作用其它方法無法制作的異星電漿。[/note]%n%n[note]使用此模組需要“引離約束”升級。[/note]
rows.after: 隨著對引力子碎片理解的不斷深入，你改進了控制它們的方式，讓它們可以更好的操控物質。引力子碎片提供了一種替代電磁約束電漿的方法，透過時空操控代替電磁場，從而使神鍛能夠直接將物質以電漿的形式輸出。%n%n[note]太陽熱能電漿製造機是神鍛的第三個模組。它可以直接把物質轉換成其電漿形式，代價是耗費極多的能量。這種方法對大部分電漿來說都不理想，不過用在某些製作特別緩慢的電漿上，可以節省大量時間。此外，之後的升級允許此模組製作用其它方法無法製作的異星電漿。[/note]%n%n[note]使用此模組需要“引離約束”升級。[/note]
rows.english:
As understanding of graviton shards continues to improve, better control over the materials they manipulate can be achieved. Graviton shards provide an alternative to electromagnetic containment of plasma using spacetime manipulation instead, allowing the Forge to directly output processed materials as plasma.

[note]The third module of the Godforge, Heliothermal Plasma Fabricator can directly convert materials into their plasma form, at the cost of an immense amount of power. This may not be ideal for every plasma, but can save a lot of time on particularly slow ones. Additionally, later upgrades allow the creation of exotic plasmas which cannot be created through other means.[/note]

[note]Usage of this module requires the GPCI upgrade.[/note]
rows.note: 第1140篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §9§l神鍛計劃
rows.after: §9§l神鍛計劃
rows.english: §b§lProject Godforge
rows.note: 第1141篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 經過您的研究，您終於完成了它——諸神之鍛爐。%n%n諸神之鍛爐是圍繞一顆穩定的中子星建造的宏偉巨構——它的先程序度超乎想象，其全部功能尚未被完全理解。不過，透過持續使用，人們可以逐步升級並擴充套件神鍛的能力範圍， 揭示出一種隱藏在宇宙最極端區域的力量:[note]引力子碎片[/note]%n%n.這種深奧的材料只能在常規物質與中子星簡併中子質殼物質的交界處找到。在那裡，引力子更為常見，它們輻射著交界處混合的物質，產生極不穩定的引力子碎片。這些碎片目前僅可用於神鍛的內部升級。雖然這些碎片尚且不能在神鍛的極端環境之外存在，但隨著不斷的研究和利用，最終將其分離並提取到神鍛外部是有可能的——但這又是為了什麼呢？%n%n[note]請點選GUI中的標誌以瞭解更多關於如何操作神鍛的資訊.[/note]
rows.after: 經過您的研究，您終於完成了它——諸神之鍛爐。%n%n諸神之鍛爐是圍繞一顆穩定的中子星建造的宏偉巨構——它的先進程度超乎想象，其全部功能尚未被完全理解。不過，透過持續使用，人們可以逐步升級並擴充套件神鍛的能力範圍， 揭示出一種隱藏在宇宙最極端區域的力量:[note]引力子碎片[/note]。%n%n這種深奧的材料只能在常規物質與中子星簡併中子質殼物質的交界處找到。在那裡，引力子更為常見，它們輻射著交界處混合的物質，產生極不穩定的引力子碎片。這些碎片目前僅可用於神鍛的內部升級。雖然這些碎片尚且不能在神鍛的極端環境之外存在，但隨著不斷的研究和利用，最終將其分離並提取到神鍛外部是有可能的——但這又是為了什麼呢？%n%n[note]請點選GUI中的標誌以瞭解更多關於如何操作神鍛的資訊.[/note]
rows.english:
With your research now complete, you have finally constructed it - the Forge of the Gods.

The Forge of the Gods is an immensely powerful structure constructed around a stabilized neutron star - it is so advanced that its full capabilities are not yet understood. However, through continued use, one can slowly upgrade and expand the range of abilities of the Forge, and learn the power hidden in the most extreme parts of the universe: [note]Graviton Shards[/note].

This esoteric material can only be found where conventional matter and degenerate neutronium crust matter on the surface of a neutron star meet. At this point in space, gravitons are far more common and irradiate this material mixture to create highly unstable graviton shards, which can be used to internally upgrade the Forge. While these shards cannot yet exist outside the extreme conditions of the Forge, with continued research and utilization it may be possible to eventually isolate and extract them outside the Forge - but for what purpose?

[note]Click on the logo in the UI to read more on how to operate the Godforge.[/note]
rows.note: 第1141篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.after: §9§l§n數不勝數的太空電梯模組

rows.note: 第1142篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。現行多出T9行星解鎖，英文僅15模組；軌道／馬達命名差異保留。

rows.before: 更好的太空電梯模組需要更先進的加速軌道才能執行。%n%n此升級將允許你訪問T9行星，並且可以在太空電梯上安裝15個模組。如果你還沒有搭建外圈擴充套件，現在也許是個好時機。%n%n[note]你可以在GUI中啟用太空電梯外圈擴充套件。[/note]
rows.after: 更好的太空電梯模組需要更先進的加速軌道才能執行。%n%n此升級將允許你訪問T9行星，並且可以在太空電梯上安裝15個模組。如果你還沒有搭建外圈擴充套件，現在也許是個好時機。%n%n[note]你可以在GUI中啟用太空電梯外圈擴充套件。[/note]
rows.english:
Better modules will require a more advanced Space Elevator motor to function.

This upgrade will allow you to access 15 modules on your Space Elevator. If you haven't built the expansion yet, now might be a good time.

[note]You can enable the Space Elevator expansion in the GUI.[/note]
rows.note: 第1142篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。現行多出T9行星解鎖，英文僅15模組；軌道／馬達命名差異保留。

rows.before: §9§l§n你的第一塊時空
rows.after: §9§l§n你的第一塊時空
rows.english: Your First SpaceTime
rows.note: 第1144篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。現行淨化水／超導冷卻液替代與原文段落格式不同；保留機制與色彩。

rows.before: [note]§l萬歲，你終於可以進入UMV了！§r[/note]%n%n從超維度電漿鍛爐中產生的殘留物似乎與現實有著有趣的相互作用，就好像它能讓宇宙按照它的意志扭曲一樣。%n%n如果你將它與一些無盡和海珀珍結合在一起來激發它，再加上一個充能超立方體將其拋向四維空間，那麼它會變成什麼樣呢？%n%n也許這樣你就能實現不可能實現的目標，成功獲取整個宇宙的基石。%n%n初始配方非常糟糕，所以一定要先為你的DTPF製作永恆線圈。%n%n&g&#008CFF&#FF00E5恭喜你走到這一步！§r%n%n[note]注：時空可以作為所有超導冷卻液的替代，且可以極大地縮短製作耗時。[/note]
rows.after: [note]§l萬歲，你終於可以進入UMV了！§r[/note]%n%n從超維度電漿鍛爐中產生的殘留物似乎與現實有著有趣的相互作用，就好像它能讓宇宙按照它的意志扭曲一樣。%n%n如果你將它與一些無盡和海珀珍結合在一起來激發它，再加上一個充能超立方體將其拋向四維空間，那麼它會變成什麼樣呢？%n%n也許這樣你就能實現不可能實現的目標，成功獲取整個宇宙的基石。%n%n初始配方非常糟糕，所以一定要先為你的DTPF製作永恆線圈。%n%n&g&#008CFF&#FF00E5恭喜你走到這一步！§r%n%n[note]注：時空可以作為所有超導冷卻液的替代，且可以極大地縮短製作耗時。[/note]
rows.english:
[note]Hurrah, you can finally move on to the UMV tier![/note]

The residue produced from the DTPFs seems to have an interesting interaction with reality, as if it bends the universe to its will.

What if you combined it with some infinity and hypogen to excite it, and an energized tesseract as a way to fling it back and forth to the 4th Dimension?

Maybe then you could achieve the unachievable, a building block of the entire universe.

[note]The base recipe is horrible, so definitely make the Eternal Coils for your DTPF first.

Congrats on making it this far![/note]
rows.note: 第1144篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。現行淨化水／超導冷卻液替代與原文段落格式不同；保留機制與色彩。

rows.after: §9§l§nUIV力場發生器

rows.note: 第1145篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 有點貴，但能用來製作改善遊戲體驗的物品，還是值得的。
rows.after: 有點貴，但能用來製作改善遊戲體驗的物品，還是值得的。
rows.english: A bit expensive, but worth the QoL items you can craft with it.
rows.note: 第1145篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §9§l§n第11階段（UIV）
rows.after: §9§l§n第11階段（UIV）
rows.english: Tier 11 (UIV)
rows.note: 第1146篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。中文新增BEC、黑洞壓縮及反物質等內容，舊英文無對應，保留。

rows.before: 你已經享用了異星餅乾，現在繼續前進吧？%n%n歡迎來到UIV，一個有許多新的大機器可以玩的好階段！一開始，這一級主要是解決你的DTPF催化劑問題，並解鎖永恆線圈。之後，後期內容將在你面前展開，如諸神之鍛爐，玻色-愛因斯坦凝聚態裝置，以及黑洞壓縮機。直到整合包的終點，你都需要使用這些大機器！%n%n此外還引入了一些QoL（生活質量）道具，比如樣板輸入鏡像，Debug未定元解析器和魔導源質儲存元件。%n%n你還會解鎖戴森雲和半穩定反物質穩定序列器，這是兩種非常強大的發電方案。%n%n[note]中文wiki UIV階段：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/94618[/url]§r[/note]
rows.after: 你已經享用了異星餅乾，現在繼續前進吧？%n%n歡迎來到UIV，一個有許多新的大機器可以玩的好階段！一開始，這一級主要是解決你的DTPF催化劑問題，並解鎖永恆線圈。之後，後期內容將在你面前展開，如諸神之鍛爐，玻色-愛因斯坦凝聚態裝置，以及黑洞壓縮機。直到整合包的終點，你都需要使用這些大機器！%n%n此外還引入了一些QoL（生活質量）道具，比如樣板輸入鏡像，Debug未定元解析器和魔導源質儲存元件。%n%n你還會解鎖戴森雲和半穩定反物質穩定序列器，這是兩種非常強大的發電方案。%n%n[note]中文wiki UIV階段：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/94618[/url]§r[/note]
rows.english:
Now that you've enjoyed your exotic cookies, let's keep going, shall we?

Welcome to Insanely Ultimate Voltage! One of the shortest tiers in NH for now. This tier is mainly about solving your DTPF catalyst problems and getting to Eternal Coils.

There are a few QoL additions introduced, like the Uncertainty Resolver and the Thaumometric Essentia Cell.

You also gain access to the Dyson Swarm, an incredibly powerful power generation option.

[warn]This tier is not fully complete. Expect changes.[/warn]
rows.note: 第1146篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。中文新增BEC、黑洞壓縮及反物質等內容，舊英文無對應，保留。

rows.before: §9§l§n核融合，但是 MK-V
rows.after: §9§l§n核融合，但是 MK-V
rows.english: Fuwusion MK5
rows.note: 第1147篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 見識到調律源金的生產速度如此之慢之後，你可能想要升級一下你的核融合裝置了。%n%n和它的前身MK-IV一樣，這個版本也支援 4/4 超頻。希望這能讓你的亞穩態鿫問題變得更容易解決一些。%n%n[note]如果你不想讓它處理1tick配方時浪費產能，可以在GUI中設定批處理大小。[/note]
rows.after: 見識到調律源金的生產速度如此之慢之後，你可能想要升級一下你的核融合裝置了。%n%n和它的前身MK-IV一樣，這個版本也支援 4/4 超頻。希望這能讓你的亞穩態鿫問題變得更容易解決一些。%n%n[note]如果你不想讓它處理1tick配方時浪費產能，可以在GUI中設定批處理大小。[/note]
rows.english:
After seeing how slow Shirabon is to make, you might want to upgrade your Fusion setup.

Like its predecessor, the MK4, this version also supports 4/4 perfect overclocks. Hopefully, this will make your Metastable Oganesson issues a bit more manageable.

[note]You can specify the batch amount in the GUI if you don't want it to handle one-tick recipes.[/note]
rows.note: 第1147篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§n最後--宇宙素！
rows.after: §c§l§n最後--宇宙素！
rows.english: Finally, Universium!
rows.note: 第1151篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 你終於解決了這個問題。誰能想到，讓死去的恆星保持足夠長的時間，會導致你的人造太陽系內爆，進而引發宇宙大爆炸？%n%n如果你能在恆星再次開始膨脹之前，立刻充分利用那麼多質量，你就能把整個宇宙握在手心了。%n%n這是你從鴻蒙之眼中獲得的第三種也是最後一種材料。%n%n[note]它主要用於UXV的合成，但你的前幾批宇宙素應該放在永恒生產迴圈中。它的任務位於“終極目標”篇章中！%n%n恭喜！現在你可以製造磁流體約束恆星物質（藍框岩漿）了。[/note]
rows.after: 你終於解決了這個問題。誰能想到，讓死去的恆星保持足夠長的時間，會導致你的人造太陽系內爆，進而引發宇宙大爆炸？%n%n如果你能在恆星再次開始膨脹之前，立刻充分利用那麼多質量，你就能把整個宇宙握在手心了。%n%n這是你從鴻蒙之眼中獲得的第三種也是最後一種材料。%n%n[note]它主要用於UXV的合成，但你的前幾批宇宙素應該放在永恆生產迴圈中。它的任務位於“終極目標”篇章中！%n%n恭喜！現在你可以製造磁流體約束恆星物質（藍框岩漿）了。[/note]
rows.english:
You've finally solved it. Who knew that leaving dead stars long enough would cause your artificial solar system to implode and lead to a Big Bang?

If only you could tap into that much mass right before it started expanding again, you could literally hold the entire universe in the palm of your hand.

This is your third and final material from the EOH.

[note]It's mainly used for UXV crafts, but your first few should go in the Eternity loop. The quest for it is located in the Endgame Goals tab.

Congrats! You can now craft Magnetohydrodynamically Constrained Star Matter (MHDCSM).[/note]
rows.note: 第1151篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§n無線多安倉
rows.after: §c§l§n無線多安倉
rows.english: Wireless Multi-Amp Hatches
rows.note: 第1152篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 現在有了調律源金，你可以製作4A,16A和64A無線能源倉了。這些倉室對那些接受多A能源倉，但又用不上雷射艙提供的極高功率的機器非常有用。%n%n[note]這些東西曾經用的很多，是用在處理陣列上最好的能源倉。願它們安息。[/note]
rows.after: 現在有了調律源金，你可以製作4A,16A和64A無線能源倉了。這些倉室對那些接受多A能源倉，但又用不上雷射倉提供的極高功率的機器非常有用。%n%n[note]這些東西曾經用的很多，是用在處理陣列上最好的能源倉。願它們安息。[/note]
rows.english:
With Shirabon now acquired, you can create 4A, 16A and 64A wireless energy hatches. These are particularly useful for machines which can use multi-amp, but do not need extreme amounts of power warranting a laser hatch.

[note]These used to be needed in large quantities, being the best energy hatch to use on a Processing Array. May they rest in peace.[/note]
rows.note: 第1152篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§n磁流體約束恆星物質
rows.after: §c§l§n磁流體約束恆星物質
rows.english: Magnetohydrodynamically Constrained Star Matter
rows.note: 第1153篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 或簡稱MHDCSM。%n%n這是您製造UXV部件的主要材料。就和其他所有的終極材料一樣，它的製造非常麻煩，而且價格極其昂貴。%n%n您需要在永恆部件上澆築它，而不是直接將其固化。%n%n祝你玩得開心！%n%n[note]譯者注：中文社群常用藍框岩漿稱呼該物質，為書寫簡便，任務書其他篇章會稱其為藍框岩漿。[/note]
rows.after: 或簡稱MHDCSM。%n%n這是您製造UXV部件的主要材料。就和其他所有的終極材料一樣，它的製造非常麻煩，而且價格極其昂貴。%n%n您需要在永恆部件上澆築它，而不是直接將其固化。%n%n祝你玩得開心！%n%n[note]譯者注：中文社群常用藍框岩漿稱呼該物質，為書寫簡便，任務書其他篇章會稱其為藍框岩漿。[/note]
rows.english:
Or MHDCSM for short.

This is your primary material for UXV components. It's tricky to make and extremely expensive, as all endgame materials should be.

Instead of solidifying it directly, you need to coat Eternity parts with it.

Have fun!
rows.note: 第1153篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§n狂飲整個行星的氣體
rows.after: §c§l§n狂飲整個行星的氣體
rows.english: Guzzling Massive Amounts of Gas
rows.note: 第1154篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 它可以同時執行4個不同的配方，每個配方可以進行4次並行。%n%n儘管它需要用到一些時空，但這是一個值得的升級。
rows.after: 它可以同時執行4個不同的配方，每個配方可以進行4次並行。%n%n儘管它需要用到一些時空，但這是一個值得的升級。
rows.english:
It can run 4 different recipes simultaneously, with 4 parallels for each recipe.

A worthy upgrade for some SpaceTime.
rows.note: 第1154篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§nUMV能源倉
rows.after: §c§l§nUMV能源倉
rows.english: UMV Energy Hatch
rows.note: 第1155篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 倒數第二個能源倉。%n%n希望你知道先升級什麼。%n%n[note]到現在為止你研究過無線能源倉了嗎？[/note]
rows.after: 倒數第二個能源倉。%n%n希望你知道先升級什麼。%n%n[note]到現在為止你研究過無線能源倉了嗎？[/note]
rows.english:
The penultimate energy hatch.

Hopefully you know what to upgrade first.

[note]Have you checked out wireless energy hatches yet?[/note]
rows.note: 第1155篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§n珍惜你自己
rows.after: §c§l§n珍惜你自己
rows.english: You Are Worthy
rows.note: 第1157篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 如果你還在意自己的理智，就別再前進了。
rows.after: 如果你還在意自己的理智，就別再前進了。
rows.english: Go no further if you value your sanity.
rows.note: 第1157篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§n還沒到頭呢
rows.after: §c§l§n還沒到頭呢
rows.english: Not Quite There Yet
rows.note: 第1158篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 還能再強一點。
rows.after: 還能再強一點。
rows.english: Just a bit more.
rows.note: 第1158篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§nUXV電路板
rows.after: §c§l§nUXV電路
rows.english: UXV Circuits
rows.note: 第1159篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 量子電路，光學主機與皮米電路的再次升級。這些UXV級電路將成為未來大量合成配方中不可或缺的材料。%n%n[note]你需要先擁有皮米電路奈米晶片組裝複合體才能開始製作。%n%n你知道嗎，所有特殊電路都會為校準提供加成？[/note]%n%n[warn]傳聞這些電路可能很快就會退出歷史舞臺……%n%n不過，傳聞或許並不可信……[/warn]
rows.after: 量子電路，光學主機與皮米電路的再次升級。這些UXV級電路將成為未來大量合成配方中不可或缺的材料。%n%n[note]你需要先擁有皮米電路奈米晶片組裝複合體才能開始製作。%n%n你知道嗎，所有特殊電路都會為校準提供加成？[/note]%n%n[warn]傳聞這些電路可能很快就會退出歷史舞臺……%n%n不過，傳聞或許並不可信……[/warn]
rows.english: The final circuit in the game: Quantum Circuit, these will be required for lots of UMV/UXV crafts.
rows.note: 第1159篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §c§l§n白矮星物質
rows.after: §c§l§n白矮星物質
rows.english: White Dwarf Matter
rows.note: 第1161篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 誰知道創造人造太陽系最終會讓你提取到一顆剛剛死去的恆星的核心呢？%n%n以你目前鴻蒙之眼的粗製機殼，你只能加速人造太陽系的壽命來觀測白矮星。%n%n也許這個物質會幫助你進一步推動這一程序。%n%n[note]這是三種鴻蒙之眼材料之一。用它將你的機殼升級到 T4.[/note]
rows.after: 誰知道創造人造太陽系最終會讓你提取到一顆剛剛死去的恆星的核心呢？%n%n以你目前鴻蒙之眼的粗製機殼，你只能加速人造太陽系的壽命來觀測白矮星。%n%n也許這個物質會幫助你進一步推動這一程序。%n%n[note]這是三種鴻蒙之眼材料之一。用它將你的機殼升級到 T4.[/note]
rows.english:
Who knew that creating artificial solar systems would finally allow you to extract the core of a freshly dead star?

With your current crude casings, you can only accelerate the life of an artificial solar system to observe white dwarfs.

Perhaps this matter will help you push the process even further.

rows.before: 永恆線圈？是時候去獲取第三個星門獎盃了。%n你知道的，你提供兩個星門的材料，就能得到你的獎盃。就是這麼簡單。%n%n[note]我們的穿越時間之旅繼續向前，進入UMV，也稱為超維度電漿鍛爐時代。%n%n令人驚訝的是，現在仍然是2022年，但自我們上一站到達UEV時代以來，已經發生了巨大的變化。超維度電漿鍛爐已經實裝，包括海珀珍和永恆線圈，UMV的機器零件因此也可以製作了。無線能源現在也存在了，包括蘭波頓那種和常規倉室那種，AE2FC也加入了整合包，允許直接使用流體合成（意味著不再需要容量瓶搬運）。%n發電的情況自UEV時代以來沒有太大變化，除了戴森雲更加bug了，可以提供免費的無限電力（濫用這點會被貼上濫用bug的標籤）。%n其他一些新的有用的東西是巨型合金冶煉爐、整合礦石處理廠、太空電梯、UIV和UMV小機器、極限工業溫室、工業屠宰場、工業蜂箱和巨蜂箱、YOT儲罐、儲存輸入匯流排、資料庫鏈和龍研聚合裝置。%n星門的成本現在已經飆升得比以往任何時候都高，標誌著GT:NH終極目標的新階段，擴張的階段。%n%n這次領先的§aGDCloud§r團隊被§aNeo Caelestia§r團隊挑戰，他們以驚人的速度進步，越來越接近成為第一個到達星門的人，但最終還是沒能完全趕上，因此§aGDCloud§r團隊再次在§a2022年11月19日§r第一個征服了挑戰。%n%nP.S. 你知道該怎麼做，對吧？這是清單：%n-PCB工廠、部件裝配線、進階裝配線、超維度電漿攪拌機、鴻蒙之眼、量子操縱者%n-多安無線倉%n-低於1t的超頻、批處理、多方塊機器內建的溢位保護%n-ME請求器、儲存輸入倉、樣板輸入匯流排%n%nP.P.S. 混沌電容庫？那是什麼？[/note]

rows.english:
Eternal coils? Perfect time for stargate trophy number three.
You know the drill, you give 2 stargates' worth of stuff, you get your trophy. Simple as that.

[note]Our journey through time continues onwards, entering the UMV, aka DTPF era.

Surprisingly, it still is the year 2022, but there have been a huge amount of changes since our last stop in the UEV era. The DTPF exists now, hypogen & eternal coils included, and machine parts up to UMV thus are craftable. Wireless energy is a thing now too, both the LSC and the regular hatch kind, and AE2FC is in the pack, allowing direct fluid crafting (meaning no more volumetric flask shuffling).
The power situation hasn't changed much since the UEV era, except for dyson being even more bugged and giving free uncapped infinite power (abusing this was obviously labeled as bugabuse).
Some other new useful things are the MABS, Integrated Ore Factory, Space Elevator, UIV and UMV singleblocks, EIG, EEC, industrial & mega apiary, yottanks, stocking buses, data bank chaining and the Draconic Fusion Crafter.
The stargate's cost has now skyrocketed far more than ever before, marking the beginning of this new era of GT:NH endgame, the era of expansion.

This time around the leading §aGDCloud§r was challenged by the team §aNeo Caelestia§r, who were progressing at a staggering speed, inching ever closer to being first to gate, but ultimately weren't able to fully catch up and thus §aGDCloud§r once again was first to conquer the challenge on the §a19th of November, 2022§r.

P.S.: You know how this works, right? Here's the list:
-PCB Factory, Component Assemblyline, AAL, Transcendent Plasma Mixer, EOH, QFT
-Multi-Amp wireless hatches
-Sub 1-tick OC, Batch Mode, inbuilt Void Protection on multis
-Level Maintainer, Stocking Hatches, Crafting Input Buses

P.P.S.: Chaotic capacitor bank? What's that?[/note]

With total mastery of the Forge of the Gods achieved, it is possible to begin a new universe-spanning initiative. It is now possible to quantize and extract graviton shards for use outside the Forge in powerful new technological endeavors; produce the most exotic plasmas beyond merely periodic elements; and most importantly, begin to understand the immense power of magmatter, a form of matter made entirely of magnetic monopoles with density and stability billions of times that of conventional bosonic matter. It is with this development you realize that the completion of the Forge was not the end goal, but merely a stepping stone to universal transcendence.

[note]Required for UXV components, Magmatter is the second material the Heliofusion Exoticizer can create, and will require a second module. Read the Godforge Information in the UI for more information on how to automate this.[/note]

[note]The creation of Magmatter requires the END upgrade.[/note]

[note]Congrats! You can now move on to the UXV tier![/note]

rows.note: 第1171篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。DTPF催化劑數學及既有多餘[/note]保留；未全面驗證實作／渲染。

rows.before: 在長時間執行你的DTPF[note]（8小時）[/note]之後，可以讓多維空間完美對齊。%n%n憑藉你新獲得的技術，你現在可以完美同步地利用這些空間，讓你的電漿鍛爐以難以置信的速度執行。%n%n超維校準矩陣可以讓DTPF以無損超頻的方式執行。要做到這一點，您需要讓DTPF達到最大催化劑減免狀態，而額外的電力成本可以透過使用更多與配方所需相同的催化劑來抵消。%n%n總的來說，它的效率更高，而且完全值得。%n%n這個過程極其耗費催化劑。確保生產足夠的催化劑來維持其運轉。%n%n對於沒有催化劑的配方，必須在GUI中右擊維度收斂按鈕來指定催化劑，否則將預設為粗製超維度催化劑。[/note]%n%n[note]寫給好奇者的數學計算：%n%n為了弄清楚後臺到底發生了什麼，下面以一個例子來解釋額外催化劑消耗值是如何計算的：%n%n所選的示例配方是使用平凡超維度催化劑的熔融中子配方，以64AUMV（8,589,934,592EU/t）執行。%n%n在不使用超頻或DTPF催化劑減免的情況下。每次配方執行會使用14,753L平凡超維度催化劑和36,484,545,600EU。有了催化劑減免，催化劑用量減半，即7,376.5L催化劑，取整後為7,376L。由於機器被供應了64AUMV，配方超頻3次，即配方每次實際使用36,484,545,600*2^3=291,876,364,800EU。%n%n知道了超頻次數和配方的基礎電壓，就可以計算出配方每次在有無損超頻和沒有無損超頻的情況下所需EU的差值，本例中有損超頻造成的額外EU是291,876,364,800-36,484,545,600=255,391,819,200EU。%n%n要得出所需的額外催化劑量，需要將這一額外的EU值除以對應催化劑（本例中為平凡超維度催化劑）的能量密度。%n%n商值等於255,391,819,200EU/66,768,460EU/L=3,825.037L，取整為配方每次額外需要3,825L平凡超維度催化劑。在最後一步中，該值需要乘以0.5,因為它會受到催化劑減免的影響。這意味著配方中額外新增的催化劑總量為3,825L*0.5=1,912.5L，取整為1,912L。%n%n用一個公式來概括：%n每個配方的額外催化劑數量=（B*（（2^x）-1））/2L%n其中：%nB是配方的基礎EU消耗%nx是超頻次數%nL是對應催化劑的EU/L[/note]
rows.after: 在長時間執行你的DTPF[note]（8小時）[/note]之後，可以讓多維空間完美對齊。%n%n憑藉你新獲得的技術，你現在可以完美同步地利用這些空間，讓你的電漿鍛爐以難以置信的速度執行。%n%n超維校準矩陣可以讓DTPF以無損超頻的方式執行。要做到這一點，您需要讓DTPF達到最大催化劑減免狀態，而額外的電力成本可以透過使用更多與配方所需相同的催化劑來抵消。%n%n總的來說，它的效率更高，而且完全值得。%n%n這個過程極其耗費催化劑。確保生產足夠的催化劑來維持其運轉。%n%n對於沒有催化劑的配方，必須在GUI中右擊維度收斂按鈕來指定催化劑，否則將預設為粗製超維度催化劑。[/note]%n%n[note]寫給好奇者的數學計算：%n%n為了弄清楚後臺到底發生了什麼，下面以一個例子來解釋額外催化劑消耗值是如何計算的：%n%n所選的示例配方是使用平凡超維度催化劑的熔融中子配方，以64AUMV（8,589,934,592EU/t）執行。%n%n在不使用超頻或DTPF催化劑減免的情況下。每次配方執行會使用14,753L平凡超維度催化劑和36,484,545,600EU。有了催化劑減免，催化劑用量減半，即7,376.5L催化劑，取整後為7,376L。由於機器被供應了64AUMV，配方超頻3次，即配方每次實際使用36,484,545,600*2^3=291,876,364,800EU。%n%n知道了超頻次數和配方的基礎電壓，就可以計算出配方每次在有無損超頻和沒有無損超頻的情況下所需EU的差值，本例中有損超頻造成的額外EU是291,876,364,800-36,484,545,600=255,391,819,200EU。%n%n要得出所需的額外催化劑量，需要將這一額外的EU值除以對應催化劑（本例中為平凡超維度催化劑）的能量密度。%n%n商值等於255,391,819,200EU/66,768,460EU/L=3,825.037L，取整為配方每次額外需要3,825L平凡超維度催化劑。在最後一步中，該值需要乘以0.5,因為它會受到催化劑減免的影響。這意味著配方中額外新增的催化劑總量為3,825L*0.5=1,912.5L，取整為1,912L。%n%n用一個公式來概括：%n每個配方的額外催化劑數量=（B*（（2^x）-1））/2L%n其中：%nB是配方的基礎EU消耗%nx是超頻次數%nL是對應催化劑的EU/L[/note]
rows.english:
Running your Dimensionally Transcendent Plasma Forge for an extended period [note](8 hours)[/note] allows the Multidimensional Spaces to align perfectly.

With your newly acquired technology, you can now tap into these spaces in perfect sync, enabling your plasma forges to operate at incredible speeds.

The Transdimensional Alignment Matrix allows the DTPF to run with Perfect Overclocks. To achieve this, you need a full discount, and the extra power cost is offset by using more of the same catalyst.

Overall, it is more efficient and totally worth it.

This process is extremely catalyst-hungry. Ensure you're producing enough to sustain it.

For recipes without a catalyst, you must specify the catalyst in the GUI by right-clicking the Convergence button, otherwise it will default to Crude.[/note]

[note]Math for the curious:

To clear up what exactly happens in the background, here's an explanation on how the extra catalyst values are calculated using an example:

The example recipe of choice is the molten neutronium recipe using prosaic catalyst, running at 64A UMV (8,589,934,592 EU/t).
The recipe uses 14,753L of Prosaic catalyst and 36,484,545,600 EU per recipe without OCs or the catalyst discount. With the discount, the catalyst amount gets cut in half, meaning 7,376.5L of catalyst, which are rounded to 7,376L, and due to the 64A UMV the machine is supplied with the recipe overclocks 3 times, meaning each recipe actually uses 36,484,545,600 * 2^3 = 291,876,364,800 EU.

Knowing the amount of OCs and the base voltage of the recipe, the difference of the needed EU per recipe with and without perfect OC can be calculated, that being 291,876,364,800 - 36,484,545,600 = 255,391,819,200 extra EU due to imperfect OCs.
To get the value of needed extra catalyst, this extra EU value has to be divided by the energy density of the relevant catalyst, prosaic in this case.

The division equates to 255,391,819,200 EU / 66,768,460 EU/L = 3,825.037 L, rounded to 3,825L extra prosaic catalyst per recipe. For the final step, this value has to be multiplied by 0.5 as it's affected by the discount, meaning the total extra catalyst that gets added to the recipe is 3,825L * 0.5 = 1,912.5 L, rounded to 1,912L.

To summarize it all in a formula:
Amount extra catalyst per recipe = (B * ((2^x) - 1))/2L
where:
B is base total EU of the recipe
x is the number of overclocks
L is the EU/L of the relevant catalyst [/note]

Fortunately, reinforcing some of the casings with your new materials allows you to inject exotic coolants that capture extreme heat in miniature tears of spacetime, helping to cool your ingots a bit faster.

With Subspace Cooling, you can enable the Vacuum Freezer to achieve Perfect Overclocks… at a cost.

Tier 1 will consume SpaceTime in liquid form at [warn]7500 L/s[/warn] and allow for 1 Perfect Overclock.

rows.before: 既然你已經制作了一臺或者好幾臺永恆鍛爐，現在是時候邁向下一個等級，UXV了。%n%n介紹遊戲中的最終多方塊結構，也是迄今為止最昂貴的。%n它引入了4種新材料：原始恆星電漿，白矮星物質和黑矮星物質，最後是宇宙素。%n%n它有3種不同等級的外殼，每種有9個等級：%n%n壓縮時空場發生器：%n- 確定可以執行的行星方塊的等級，同時每級減少3%%的處理時間。%n%n時間膨脹場發生器：%n- 每級減少50%%的配方時間，同時每級減少9.25%%的配方成功率。%n%n穩定力場發生器：%n- 每級增加5%%的配方成功率，同時每級減少5%%的配方產出量。%n%n較低等級的穩定力場生成器有能量輸出的懲罰。%n%n找到不同外殼等級的最佳配置可能是一項艱鉅的任務，因此建議使用這個計算器來評估配置和視覺化產出：[url]https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FTFdfmY_UWbTbFOyNzARKeI90pbHvPBH6M3JHJmaC-E/edit?usp=sharing[/url]%n%n[note]請務必閱讀鴻蒙之眼控制器的tooltip。它詳細解釋了所有內容！根據你的GUI縮放比例，它可能有多個頁面。[/note]%n%n[note]嗯……基本上所有內容。鴻蒙之眼內建保底系統以防玩家紅溫，其運作邏輯如下：%n%n（此處所有機率均為小數形式）%n存在計數器C，初始值為當前配方成功率P。若配方失敗，則向C追加（1-P）*P。當C≥1時，下一次必定成功且C重置為P。%n若在C達到≥1前配方成功，則同樣重置計數器。%n切換配方時C立即重置為新配方的P值（即便下次本該保底成功）%n保底效果可能被溢位懲罰覆蓋（因懲罰作用於保底之後），但C值不受影響，故保底效果會順延至下輪配方。%n並行數>1時保底機制失效。[/note]

rows.english:
So you have made yourself an Eternal DTPF or hopefully a few, and now it is time for the push to the next tier, UXV.

Introducing the final multiblock in the game, and by far the most expensive.
It introduces 4 new materials: Raw Stellar Plasma, White and Black Dwarf Matter and finally Universium.

It has 3 different tiered casings with 9 tiers each:

Spacetime Compression Field Generator:
- Determines the tier of the planet block that can be run and decreases the processing time by 3% per tier.

Time Dilation Field Generator:
- Decreases recipe time by 50% per tier, while decreasing the chance of a recipe succeeding by 9.25% per tier.

Stabilisation Field Generator:
- Increases the chance of a recipe succeeding by 5% per tier, while decreasing the output of a recipe by 5% per tier.

Lower tier Stabilization Field Generators have a power output penalty.

Finding the best setup of different casing tiers might be a hard task, so a calculator visualizing all the drops and setups has been created: [url]https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15j30mNnFIWBhwpJGuDrKTfiHBXNEEqyvB_r7ztFWlyQ[/url]

[note]Be sure to read the tooltip of the Eye of Harmony controller, it explains everything in detail! Depending on your GUI scale it might have multiple pages.[/note]

[note]Well... it explains mostly everything. The Eye of Harmony has an inbuilt pity system to make sure you don't lose your mind. Here's a quick rundown on how it operates:

(All chances are decimals here)
There is a counter C that starts at the current recipe success chance P. If a recipe fails, (1-P)*P is added to C. If C reaches >= 1, the next roll is guaranteed to succeed and C resets to P. 
If a recipe succeeds before C reaches >= 1, it resets in a similar manner.
If you switch recipes, C will be reset to P of the new recipe, even if the next roll would be a guarantee.
The guarantee can be canceled out by overflow penalties as they apply after the pity does. However, they do not reset C, so the guarantee is shifted to the next recipe cycle.
If parallels are > 1, pity doesn't apply.[/note]

rows.before: 從現在開始，你將被極其緩慢的處理配方折磨。%n%n考慮完成你的量子操縱者叢集，升級或更換你的舊基建，以此來拯救岌岌可危的TPS。%n%n你絕對應該升級你的發電和基礎設施，以處理數百萬個配方。%n%n鴻蒙之眼在能夠盈餘電力之前，將消耗你的大部分電力。%n%n願Colen垂憐於你的靈魂。%n%n[note]歡迎來到休息室，請不要在機器上跳來跳去。[/note]
rows.after: 從現在開始，你將被極其緩慢的處理配方折磨。%n%n考慮完成你的量子操縱者叢集，升級或更換你的舊基建，以此來拯救岌岌可危的TPS。%n%n你絕對應該升級你的發電和基礎設施，以處理數百萬個配方。%n%n鴻蒙之眼在能夠盈餘電力之前，將消耗你的大部分電力。%n%n願Colen垂憐於你的靈魂。%n%n[note]歡迎來到休息室，請不要在機器上跳來跳去。[/note]
rows.english:
From now on, you'll be dealing with extremely slow recipes.

Consider finishing up your QFTs and upgrading or replacing your old infrastructure to save on TPS.

You should definitely upgrade your power generation and infrastructure to handle millions of recipes.

The Eye of Harmony will be consuming most of your power before it starts generating more than it uses.

May Colen have mercy on your soul.

[note]Welcome to the waiting lounge.[/note]

rows.before: 請務必考慮使用它來改進磁流體約束恆星物質的生產。你還需要它來製造藍框岩漿部件。%n%n這個生產迴圈的敲門磚是隨機產生且昂貴的。為了一個催化劑和頭5次搖獎機會，你總共需要20,736L宇宙素。%n%n量子操縱者的配方每次嘗試有25%%的機率生產永恆。你也許應該用電漿來開啟量子操縱者的聚焦模式，並聚焦生產永恆。%n%n[note]你知道量子操縱者有流體模式嗎？它可以用來提取熔融調律源金。只要用§a螺絲刀§r右擊控制器就可以了.[/note]%n%n[note]用永恆塊建造一個完整的信標可能有點奢侈，你覺得呢?[/note]
rows.after: 請務必考慮使用它來改進磁流體約束恆星物質的生產。你還需要它來製造藍框岩漿部件。%n%n啟動這個生產迴圈不但昂貴，還得靠運氣。為了一個催化劑和頭5次搖獎機會，你總共需要20,736L宇宙素。%n%n量子操縱者的配方每次嘗試有25%%的機率生產永恆。你也許應該用電漿來開啟量子操縱者的聚焦模式，並聚焦生產永恆。%n%n[note]你知道量子操縱者有流體模式嗎？它可以用來提取熔融調律源金。只要用§a螺絲刀§r右擊控制器就可以了.[/note]%n%n[note]用永恆塊建造一個完整的信標可能有點奢侈，你覺得呢?[/note]
rows.english:
Definitely consider this for the improved Magnetohydrodynamically Constrained Star Matter recipe. You'll also need it to make MHDCSM parts.

Kickstarting the loop is expensive and RNG-based. You need 20,736 L of Universium for the first 5 attempts and a catalyst.

The QFT recipe has a 25% chance of yielding Eternity per attempt. You should probably boost the QFT with plasmas and focus on producing Eternity.

[note]Did you know the QFT has a fluid mode? It could be useful for extracting molten Shirabon. Just right-click the controller with a §ascrewdriver§r.[/note]

[note]Building a full beacon out of Eternity Blocks might be a bit extravagant, don't you think?[/note]

rows.english:
Congratulations, with this final quest, you'll have beaten the hardest challenge in GregTech: New Horizons yet! 

The whole GT:NH Team thanks you for your time spent on this modpack. You are now part of the top 0.5% of our community!

Now that you made one gate, take this second gate and link them together! (Unless you want to craft the second yourself of course).

Don't hesitate to share your base in #screenshot-brag channel of our Discord server, claim your stargate role, and if you have any feedback on the endgame progression, we will gladly appreciate it!

I guess now it's time for you to go outside, touch grass, or... continue onwards?

As you've noticed, UXV components are extremely expensive compared to the amount of Universium you can currently produce.

The Astral Array Fabricator allows you to run EOH recipes in parallel. You can review the math in the second page of the tooltip.

For a direct answer, you can use this spreadsheet: [url]https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15j30mNnFIWBhwpJGuDrKTfiHBXNEEqyvB_r7ztFWlyQ[/url]

rows.before: 幾乎和真的一樣昂貴，對吧？不用擔心，這個星門和目前的成就只是個開始。%n%n[note]我們的旅程暫時告一段落，進入了UXV時代，也就是鴻蒙之眼時代。%n%n2023年，遊戲不斷被推向新的高度。鴻蒙之眼和直到UXV級別的機器部件都已經出現。多方塊結構已經獲得了無數的便利性提升，包括1toc、批處理、溢位保護，以及眾多AE2新增內容：如樣板輸入匯流排、儲存輸入倉、請求器等。自動化從未如此簡單，但目標卻從未如此遙遠。矽岩燃料現在有了多個等級。能夠一直用到遊戲後期。甚至可以與（現已修復的）戴森雲競爭，但仍然不及最大化的鴻蒙之眼產生的巨大能量（12.8T EU/t！）%n%n最初，星門的配方似乎不可能實現，需要在數百個最大化的鴻蒙之眼上執行數月，這促使進行了一些後期的調整使星門的實現更現實。在調整之後，競賽再次開始，這次是在§aJohny709§r和§aGDCloud§r之間。§aJohny§r在最後階段耗盡了精力，而§aGDCloud§r被另一個默默的競爭者§aStarStack§r超越，後者於§a2023年6月26日§r首次攻克了這一挑戰。%n%n這不僅僅是第一次，還標誌著“團隊挑戰賽時代”的開始，出現了更大量的挑戰，例如§aBallers Run§r（推動該時代的發展）、§aBee Run§r（對GTNH專案及其整體管理產生了廣泛影響）和§aCell Run 2§r（當時最快的星門挑戰，用時僅用73天，推廣了許多自動化技術，如請求器下單產線）。%n%n此外，這個版本見證了第一位玩家達成“GTNH之神”，即第三次完成星門挑戰。§aGDCloud§r作為§aCell Run 2§r的一員於§a2024年6月23日§r獲得了這個稱號。此後，還有三位玩家達成了這一成就：§aRamspace§r於§a2024年9月29日§r。以及§aStaffiX§r和§aserenibyss§r在一次團隊挑戰中於§a2024年11月17日§r。%n%nP.S.：以下是和往常一樣的清單：%n-新的多方塊結構，如高強度雷射蝕刻機、流體塑形機、工業高壓釜等。%n-諸神之鍛爐、黑洞壓縮機、反物質發電、T4精密組裝機。%n-DTPF維度收斂、部件裝配線的等級加速、大型真空冷凍機的亞空間冷卻模式、MK-V核融合提速亞穩態鿫。%n-無線資料倉、無線光學介面、Debug未定元解析器。%n-人造宇宙儲存元件、智慧阻擋模式。[/note]

rows.english:
Almost as expensive as the real one, right? Not to worry, this stargate and the current are only just the beginning.

[note]Our journey reaches the current end, entering the UXV, aka EOH era.

The year is 2023, and the game continues to be pushed further and further. The EOH exists now, along with machine parts up to UXV. Multiblocks have gained endless amounts of quality of life, including sub 1-tick OC, batch mode, void protection, and numerous AE2 additions like Crafting Input Buses, Stocking Hatches, Level Maintainers and more. Automation has never been easier, yet the goal has never been placed farther. Naquadah Fuel now has many tiers and can compete into the late-game, even competing with (now fixed) Dyson, but outclassed by the huge amount of power a maximized EOH can make (12.8 TEU/t!).

Initially the stargate recipe seemed impossible, requiring months of runtime on hundreds of maximized EOHs, requiring some adjustments to be more realistic to attain. After this was changed, the race began again, this time between §aJohny709§r and §aGDCloud§r. §aJohny§r burned out towards the end, and §aGDCloud§r was surpassed by a silent contender, §aStarStack§r, being the first to conquer this challenge on the §a26th of June, 2023§r.

Beyond just the first, this era marked the beginning of the Group Run Era, with large runs such as §aBallers Run§r (setting this era into motion), §aBee Run§r (affecting wide change on the NH project and its management as a whole), and §aCell Run 2§r (the fastest ever Stargate run, in only 73 days, popularizing many automation techniques like Level Maintained lines).

Additionally, this version saw the first player achieve GTNH Gods, reaching Stargate in a 3rd run, earned by §aGDCloud§r as a part of §aCell Run 2§r on the §a23rd of June, 2024§r. Later this Stargate would see three others reach this goal, §aRamspace§r on the §a29th of September, 2024§r, and §aStaffiX§r and §aserenibyss§r in a group run on the §a17th of November, 2024§r.

P.S.: Here's the list as usual:
-Many new processing multiblocks like HILE, Fluid Shaper, Industrial Autoclave, etc.
-Forge of the Gods, Black Hole Compressor, Antimatter power generation, Precise Assembler T4
-DTPF Convergence, Component Assembly Line tiered bonuses, Mega Vac Subspace Cooling, MK5 fusion skips for Metastable Oganesson
-Wireless Data Hatches, Wireless Optical Hatches, Uncertainty Resolution
-Artificial Universe Cells, smart blocking mode[/note]

rows.before: 忘記你有關食物的一切知識吧！有了全新的裝罐機，你可以將食物變成營養豐富的罐頭來填飽肚子了。 罐頭可以快速恢復你的飽和度，這會讓你感覺很快樂！而且隨便吃多少都不會有減持。%n%n別等飽和度掉到底才吃罐頭，罐頭恢復的飽和度非線性。一次吃3個效率最高。（此資料為玩家提供）  然鵝譯者認為罐頭根本不值錢，想怎麼吃就怎麼吃。
rows.after: 忘記你有關食物的一切知識吧！有了全新的裝罐機，你可以將食物變成營養豐富的罐頭來填飽肚子了。 罐頭可以快速恢復你的飽和度，這會讓你感覺很快樂！而且隨便吃多少都不會有遞減懲罰。%n%n別等飽和度掉到底才吃罐頭，罐頭恢復的飽和度非線性。一次吃3個效率最高。（此資料為玩家提供）  然鵝譯者認為罐頭根本不值錢，想怎麼吃就怎麼吃。
rows.english:
Forget everything you know about food and values. With your new canning machine you are able to fill tin cans with very nourishing food. This food can be consumed in milliseconds and makes you full and happy. And you can eat as much as you want without getting tired of the food.

Eating before you are starving restores saturation and conserves cans.
rows.note: 第1251篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。罐頭恢復與一次3個最有效等譯者註未驗證，只改遞減懲罰錯字。

rows.after: 最後一步，你需要用一些史詩級的食物為你的棉花糖注魔。當然，你得先解鎖此研究才能進行注魔。%n%n這值得麼？ 真的有需要這麼多buff才能打過的敵人麼？ 這取決於你。
rows.english:
In the last step you need to infuse your Marshmallow with some epic food in the thaumcraft infusion altar. Before you can do it you need to unlock the research.

Is this worth it? Is there any enemy worthy of using the buffs this gives on? That's up to you.

rows.before: 在地獄可以找到巨型黃蜂。 快！ 潛入蜂巢偷一些蜂蜜！%n%n這些巨大的蜂巢懸掛在地獄天花板上。其中只有大概一般含有蜂蜜，聚集在蜂巢下半部分的一層蜂蜜塊下。如果你遇到的是空的，可以另找一個。%n%n[note]只要揹包中有單元或者桶裝的流體就可以提交了。[/note]
rows.after: 在地獄可以找到巨型黃蜂。 快！ 潛入蜂巢偷一些蜂蜜！%n%n這些巨大的蜂巢懸掛在地獄天花板上。其中只有大概一半含有蜂蜜，聚集在蜂巢下半部分的一層蜂蜜塊下。如果你遇到的是空的，可以另找一個。%n%n[note]只要揹包中有單元或者桶裝的流體就可以提交了。[/note]

Giant wasps can be found in the Nether. Quick! Sneak into their hive and steal some honey!

[note]Just having the fluid in cells or buckets in your inventory lets the quest detect it.[/note]

rows.after: 真正op的食物
rows.english: Really OP Food
rows.note: 第1258篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 你聽說Dezil的棉花糖是非常OP的食物，偶爾能在寶箱中找到。讓我來告訴你如何製作它怎麼樣？%n%n在夢之世界製作出水心之釀後，將一點麵粉、糖、世界鹽和龍塵放入你的IV攪拌機。%n放入水心之釀後，此配方會開始合成，最後生成難看的糖漿————一種惡臭的、令人厭惡的……玩意。%n%n當心，手持這玩意時，會獲得失明II效果。
rows.after: 你聽說Dezil的棉花糖是非常OP的食物，偶爾能在寶箱中找到。讓我來告訴你如何製作它怎麼樣？%n%n在夢之世界製作出水心之釀後，將一點麵粉、糖、世界鹽和龍塵放入你的IV攪拌機。%n放入水心之釀後，此配方會開始合成，最後生成難看的糖漿————一種惡臭的、令人厭惡的……玩意。%n%n當心，手持這玩意時，會獲得失明II效果。
rows.english:
You've heard about Dezil's Marshmallow, a really OP food which can be found from time to time in chests. What about I show you a way to cook this stuff yourself?

After you've mastered the flowing spirit in the dream dimension (witchery), put a bit of flour, sugar, salis mundus and draconium dust in your IV Mixer.
The recipe starts when you give flowing spirit to it and gives you malformed slush, a very stinky and disgusting piece of...something.

Be careful, you'll get blindness II when holding it in your hand.
rows.note: 第1258篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 難看的糖漿
rows.after: 難看的糖漿
rows.english: Uncooked Slush
rows.note: 第1259篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 下一步是把這個難看的糖漿弄得像點樣子。使用棉花糖模具，在IV衝壓機床中給難看的糖漿塑形，得到生糖漿。記得用完後消毒。%n%n當心，手持生糖漿時，會獲得失明II和飢餓II效果。
rows.after: 下一步是把這個難看的糖漿弄得像點樣子。使用棉花糖模具，在IV衝壓機床中給難看的糖漿塑形，得到生糖漿。記得用完後消毒。%n%n當心，手持生糖漿時，會獲得失明II和飢餓II效果。
rows.english:
Next step is to form this slush into the right shape. Use a Marshmallow form and press it with your iv forming press. Remember to sterilize it after using it.

Be careful, you'll get blindness and hunger II holding it.
rows.note: 第1259篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.after: 熱棉花糖

rows.before: 下一步是在工業高爐內通入稀有氣體，並以4500K的爐溫加熱生糖漿，使其閃閃發光。%n%n現在，你又獲得了麻痺II效果。
rows.after: 下一步是在工業高爐內通入稀有氣體，並以4500K的爐溫加熱生糖漿，使其閃閃發光。%n%n現在，你又獲得了麻痺II效果。

Next step is heating up your Marshmallow in an Electric Blast Furnace at 4500K with some radon gas and making it glow.

Now you'll get a Paralysis II effect in addition to the others.

In the next step you cool your Glowing Marshmallow in an HV Vacuum Freezer to make it more stable.

You still get Weakness II and Nausea II.
rows.note: 第1261篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。中文EV與英文HV真空冷凍需求不同，保留待查。

rows.before: 廚具2.0
rows.after: 廚具2.0
rows.english: Kitchenware 2.0
rows.note: 第1262篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 小刀這樣的GT工具在處理食物時用完了？潘馬斯的工具（砧板、榨汁機、烤盤）可以永遠使用。%n%n當你能燒製不鏽鋼，到達高壓後，你就能製作這些工具了，基本永遠都不會壞。
rows.after: 小刀這樣的GT工具在處理食物時用完了？潘馬斯的工具（砧板、榨汁機、烤盤）可以永遠使用。%n%n當你能燒製不鏽鋼，到達高壓後，你就能製作這些工具了，基本永遠都不會壞。
rows.english:
GregTech tools like the knives get used up when crafting foods. Pams Tool like the Cutting Board, Juicer or the Bakeware can last forever.

After you reach stainless steel in HV you can make these tools that last forever.
rows.note: 第1262篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 就像媽媽以前做的
rows.after: 就像媽媽以前做的
rows.english: Just Like Mom Used to Make
rows.note: 第1263篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 果醬三明治是一種很好的食物來源，提供不錯的飽和度，且容易製作。幾乎所有的水果都可以用燉鍋加糖製成果醬。有幾種不同的堅果奶油可供選擇。花生可在森林、山巒或冰原生物群系中的陸地菜園找到。腰果可在叢林或者沼澤的樹上找到。板栗可在更溫暖的森林裡找到。開心果樹在叢林裡。許多這些樹苗都可與村民交易獲得。你需要使用軟錘或榨汁機將這些堅果榨成奶油糊糊！%n%n為了儲存你的所有配方，你可以用廚房多方塊結構（如果你想要看到所有可用的配方），或者林業的工作台（如果對你來說只有有限的9個配方也沒問題的話）。%n%n有些三明治提供更多的飽和度，所以在購買對應樹苗前請先檢視NEI！
rows.after: 果醬三明治是一種很好的食物來源，提供不錯的飽和度，且容易製作。幾乎所有的水果都可以用燉鍋加糖製成果醬。有幾種不同的堅果奶油可供選擇。花生可在森林、山巒或針葉林生物群系中的陸地菜園找到。腰果可在叢林或者沼澤的樹上找到。板栗可在更溫暖的森林裡找到。開心果樹在叢林裡。許多這些樹苗都可與村民交易獲得。你需要使用軟錘或榨汁機將這些堅果榨成奶油糊糊！%n%n為了儲存你的所有配方，你可以用廚房多方塊結構（如果你想要看到所有可用的配方），或者林業的工作台（如果對你來說只有有限的9個配方也沒問題的話）。%n%n有些三明治提供更多的飽和度，所以在購買對應樹苗前請先檢視NEI！
rows.english:
Jelly sandwiches are a great food source with decent saturation and are easy to make. Almost any fruit can be converted to jelly with sugar and a saucepan. There are a few different nut butters available. Peanuts can be found in Ground Gardens in forest, mountain, or taiga style biomes. Cashews are trees located in jungles or swamps. Chestnuts can be found in warmer forests. Pistachios can be found in jungles. Many of these saplings are also available for trade from villagers.

To keep all your recipes together, you can use either a Kitchen multiblock if you want to see all recipes available to you, or a Forestry Worktable if you're fine with the limit of nine recipes.

Some sandwiches have better saturation than others, so be sure to check before buying that sapling!
rows.note: 第1263篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 我喜歡大三明治
rows.after: 我喜歡大三明治
rows.english: I Like Big Sandwiches
rows.note: 第1264篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 現在你有了麵糰，有多種大三明治可供選擇。它們能提供大量的飽和度而且製作簡單。%n%n蔬菜和乳酪三明治製作工序較多，不是好的選擇。%n%n如果你需要更多的飲食選擇，這些三明治也有正常尺寸的種類。
rows.after: 現在你有了麵糰，有多種大三明治可供選擇。它們能提供大量的飽和度而且製作簡單。%n%n蔬菜和乳酪三明治製作工序較多，不是好的選擇。%n%n如果你需要更多的飲食選擇，這些三明治也有正常尺寸的種類。
rows.english:
Now that you have dough, there are several options for large sandwiches. They offer great saturation restoration and are easy to make.

The veggie and cheese options aren't quite as good and need more work to produce.

There are also normal-sized varieties of these sandwiches if you need more diet choices.
rows.note: 第1264篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 雞，一隻也別想跑！
rows.after: 雞，一隻也別想跑！
rows.english: No Chicken Escapes!
rows.note: 第1265篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 你喜歡派嗎？當然！  有許多種派可供選擇。  雞肉派是最容易做的派之一。只需生雞肉、土豆、胡蘿蔔和麵團。水果派要簡單一點，所以提供的飽和度不太多，但是在你等待最好食物的過程中，它們對填飽肚子很有用。
rows.after: 你喜歡派嗎？當然！  有許多種派可供選擇。  雞肉派是最容易做的派之一。只需生雞肉、馬鈴薯、胡蘿蔔和麵糰。水果派要簡單一點，所以提供的飽和度不太多，但是在你等待較佳食物的遞減懲罰消退期間，它們對填飽肚子很有用。
rows.english: Do you like pies? I sure do! There are many varieties of pies available for you. The chicken pot pie is one of the easiest to make. Just a chicken, potato, carrot, and some dough. The fruit pies are a little simpler, so they don't quite restore as much saturation, but are great for filling tummies while you wait for the best foods to wear off.
rows.note: 第1265篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 南瓜派
rows.after: 南瓜派
rows.english: Pumpkin Pie
rows.note: 第1266篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。南瓜派原文飽食量與中文配方段落不同，保留。

rows.before: 南瓜派是一種傳統的美國甜點，在萬聖節、感恩節和聖誕節期間特別受歡迎。%n2南瓜+3糖再加擀麵杖，多簡單。%n好好享受吧。
rows.after: 南瓜派是一種傳統的美國甜點，在萬聖節、感恩節和聖誕節期間特別受歡迎。%n2南瓜+3糖再加擀麵杖，多簡單。%n好好享受吧。
rows.english:
Pumpkin Pie is a traditional US dessert that is particularly popular for Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Christmas.

1,5 Food Bars for just two Pumpkins and a three sugar. Bon Appétit.
rows.note: 第1266篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。南瓜派原文飽食量與中文配方段落不同，保留。

rows.before: 感謝mitch把這個超棒的mod移植過來。 透過這個mod可以幫助你合成新食物。 所有與廚房地板相連的方塊都被視為同一多方塊結構（都可以直接使用！）。 廚房的工作台面會搜尋上方兩格的櫥櫃，包括在整個多方塊結構中。%n%n儲存在儲存器（比如櫥櫃）或你的物品欄中的物品，都可以參與合成。 所有儲存物品的儲存器都是一樣的，所以除非你真的很想要一面牆的冰箱，否則不要造太多…… 為水槽供水，即可支援所有需要水的食物配方。%n%n你可以在烤箱中存放一些烹飪工具。剩下的可以存放在廚具架上，這樣就可以在合成食譜配方時自動使用它們了。 如果你還沒法做齊潘馬斯的工具，也是支援GT工具的，比如軟錘。%n%n烤箱有3個輸入槽，3個輸出槽，一次可以處理9個物品。 它基本上就是個爐子。而真正核心的是烹飪桌。%n%n烹飪桌會自動顯示基於現有原材料，可以製作的所有食物，而你可以透過點選直接完成它們。 製出所有的食物，並獲得所有的獎勵生命上限！%n%n你可以使用染料對廚房進行塗色，烤箱除外。%n%n請注意，由於開發還未完成，所以懶人廚房還存在一些問題，例如：讓烤箱之類的機器支援RF/EU能量的升級還沒有加入。 等等……不過值得慶賀的是，吐司機修好了！%n%n[note]罐子裡沒有奶牛，未來也不會有。[/note]

rows.english:
Say thanks to mitch for backporting this great mod. You can use it to help you craft new food items. All blocks connected to the kitchen floor (use it as walls too!) are considered part of the same multiblock. Countertops will search up two blocks for cabinets to include.

Items stored in storages like the cabinet (or your inventory) can be used in recipes. All storage spaces for items are the same, so don't bother making a ton of fridges unless you really want to. Supply water to the sink to get water for recipes.

You can store some cooking tools in the oven. You can store the rest on tool racks to auto-use them all in recipes. This includes stuff like the GT soft mallet if you can't make all the Pam's tools yet.

The oven has 3 input slots and 3 output slots, and can work on 9 items at once. It's basically a furnace. You can request items be cooked from the cooking table too.

The Cooking Table will automatically show you all recipes that can be created with the existing ingredients, and you can click on them to craft them. Make all the food, and get all the hearts!

You can use dye to color the kitchen, except for the oven.

Note that the implementation is not finished, so there are some problems. Upgrades like powering the oven with RF/EU are not in yet. And so on. But we finally have a toaster so you can make TOAST!

[note]There is no cow in a jar, it will not come back.[/note]
rows.note: 第1268篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。廚房牆面與櫥櫃掃描等機制待實作驗證。

Given sufficient magical prowess, the Thaumaturgist need not waste their time physically consuming food. The Talisman of Nourishment can hold up to 1000 hunger and 1000 saturation points, and will feed you automatically. 

You can fill it up by placing food items on your hotbar, the more valuable the food, the more points added.

[note]Careful not to place food items you want to keep in your hotbar while you have it on you![/note]

rows.english:
Growing dyes on crops sticks? Try to plant some flowers. If you cross breed Rose and Dandelion flowers maybe you'll get a new flower and new dyes with different colors.

You will need to plant 4 vanilla flowers to get them on a cropstick. They also don't plant unless they are in bright light.

To get "Rose Seeds" place poppies. Honestly there are several flowers you can use, though.

[note]If you actually want these for dyes, go make the rainbow cactus instead.[/note]

rows.before: 這種工具是除草鏟、鋤頭和鍬的組合。基礎款的鏟子能讓你輕鬆地除去作物架上的雜草，耕地，以及有機率僅僅透過收穫作物（右擊）而非破壞來獲得額外的種子。每一點抗性屬性都會增加使用基礎鏟子收穫時獲得種子的機率如下：%n%n1點抗性 = 3%%%n10點抗性 = 32%%%n31點抗性 = 100%%%n%n[note]如果你要用鏟子移除一株作物，潛行可以讓你移除作物而無需擔心鏟子直接破壞作物架。[/note]
rows.after: 這種工具是除草鏟、鋤頭和鍬的組合。基礎款的鏟子能讓你輕鬆地除去作物架上的雜草，耕地，以及有機率僅僅透過收穫作物（右擊）而非破壞來獲得額外的種子。每一點抗性屬性都會增加使用基礎鏟子收穫時獲得種子的機率如下：%n%n1點抗性 = 3%%%n10點抗性 = 32%%%n31點抗性 = 100%%%n%n[note]如果你要用鏟子移除一株作物，潛行可以讓你移除作物而無需擔心鏟子直接破壞作物架。[/note]
rows.english:
This item is a combined Weeding Trowel, Hoe and Shovel. If you're the type that accidentally does things, only use this when necessary, as it's easy to mess up and use it to harvest/destroy your crops when you wanted to get rid of a weed.

You can use it to get seeds from crops when they're §9immature§r using §6right-click§r at very low rates. Using [warn]left-click[/warn] when §9immature§r will result in nothing.

If it's §amature§r, use §6left-click§r to have a higher chance of a seed dropping. Using [warn]right-click[/warn] when §amature§r will result in lower seed drops than punching it normally.

Keep in mind that the higher the tier/stats of the crop, the lower the chances. By a lot.

[note]The formula is 1+tanh((-1)(X+5((-Re/2)+Gr+Ga)/21)/12); X=0 to 16, where Re, Gr, Ga are respectively Resistance, Growth and Gain stat of the crop, and X is tier. Don't ask me whether this is for L/R-click, ask bart or look at the code.[/note]
rows.note: 第1297篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。鏟子採種方式、抗性機率與舊IC2英文公式不同，保留。

rows.before: 作物管理器是一臺單方塊機器，可以監控周圍區域的作物，並根據需要自動施肥（物品或流體）、使用除草劑與澆水。水、肥料和除草劑可以直接泵入或使用任何一種IC2水單元。普通單元使用後不會返還單元。%n%n和其他單方塊機器一樣，作物管理器不防雨，但是你可以在機器正上方放一格水源！%n%n耕地仍然需要附近有水方塊才能保持濕潤，因為管理器只會澆灌作物，而不是土壤。試試將睡蓮放在水上，這樣走路就不會掉下去了。

rows.english:
The Crop Manager is a LV machine that will monitor crops in a 11x5x11 area and automatically apply fertilizer, Weed-EX, and Water as needed. Water can be pumped in directly or use IC2 Universal water cells, normal cells aren't returned when they're used.

The Crop Manager is NOT rainproof, but you can cover it with a water source block just fine!

Tilled dirt still requires a nearby water block to be hydrated as the Manager will only water the crop, not the soil. Try putting a lily pad on top so it isn't annoying to walk on, or using Garden Soil instead.
rows.note: 第1299篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 除草劑
rows.after: 除草劑
rows.english: Weed Ex

rows.before: 除草劑用於阻止雜草在空作物架上生長或傳播。%n%n你可以自己透過噴罐手動使用，或者將其提供給作物管理器來自動對範圍內的所有作物使用。
rows.after: 除草劑用於阻止雜草在空作物架上生長或傳播。%n%n你可以自己透過噴罐手動使用，或者將其提供給作物管理器來自動對範圍內的所有作物使用。
rows.english:
Weed-EX is used to prevent the growth of Weeds on empty Crop blocks at the cost of some weed-EX. Damage to the crop's quality is illusory, and not true. We have people that have looked at the code, we assure you. §oUnless§r it counts as a weed (venomilia Gr 8+, any other crop Gr 24+), then it loses maybe 1 stat. Maybe. And you can just increase it again too. And it might not take effect even then if you don't apply too much, like a crop matron won't.

Usage:
While holding Weed-Ex, right-click on a Crop to apply it. It can also be placed in a Crop Manager to automatically apply it to your crops.

rows.after: 黏性甘蔗

rows.before: 甘蔗自己已經相當有用了，它的近親黏性甘蔗甚至更有用！得益於它的黏性樹脂產出，它在各類電子產品所需的橡膠生產中幾乎都有應用。
rows.after: 甘蔗自己已經相當有用了，它的近親黏性甘蔗甚至更有用！得益於它的黏性樹脂產出，它在各類電子產品所需的橡膠生產中幾乎都有應用。
rows.english:
One of the first useful crops you'll get is Stickreed. It's fast growing, and can produce sticky resin and sugarcane (harvest before it reaches full maturity). It's also great for crossing with other crops to raise their stats. One of the best strategies is to get these to around 20/31/10, then breed out from there. Most people will say 23/31/10, but 24+ act like weeds, so it's better to have some wiggle room.

I'll trade you some fertilizer for 2 stacks of each.

[note]PS, you don't really need rubber trees if you can get these.[/note]

[note]You'll need a Basic Scanner to scan your Stickreed seeds once you get them, though any set of stats will work. See the quest in LV, and note it requires MV circuits.[/note]
rows.note: 第1301篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

As a reward, I'll give you a silly seed a friend of mine came up with. It will definitely keep you on your toes.

rows.english:
When breeding together crops for an output crop, try to get crops that are close in tier to the output crop, and have similar attributes to the output crop.

For example, Redwheat has "Red", "Wheat" and "Redstone" attributes and is tier 6. Nether Wart has "Red" and is tier 5. Use the cropnalyzer crop prediction mode to see how many points Redwheat has using two Nether Wart.

You'll also want to make sure the light level is between 5-10 for this particular cross breeding to occur. Honestly, it's the worst, condition-wise.

Really though, once you get to MV it's better to make a Glowstone crop and centrifuge it for redstone. Or a redstone block crop. Or just mine it, honestly. Red wheat == Dead wheat.

rows.before: 行動式掃描器是植物透鏡的直接升級版。%n%n和植物透鏡一樣，掃描器能顯示作物架上生長的作物的所有資訊，但和植物透鏡不同，它還能顯示作物架提供的精確營養值。%n%n[note]行動式掃描器並非僅用於作物，它實際上能顯示幾乎所有東西的詳細資訊！檢視“多方塊結構”章節中工業高爐任務後面的行動式掃描器任務以獲得更多資訊！[/note]

rows.english:
With the portable scanner, you can get the crop's stats and environmental info while it is still in the ground by right-clicking it. It also stays scanned after getting the seed. Look for the portable scanner quest after the EBF in Multiblock Goals. About those stats:

§aGrowth§r:
How fast it grows, with higher = faster. Specifically, it increases the growth points your crop gets per growth tick. If it gets to 24+, your crop acts like a weed, so most people say to stay at 23 or less. However, it will only weed other crops under certain conditions.

1) Is in a cardinal direction on the same Y level. 2) Will only affect dirt/grass, or cropsticks or crops 3) If there's a crop there that is §oalso§r a weed, if it's at a maturity level > 1, it §owon't affect it§r 4) If it affects the crop, it'll be replaced with a normal weed

§9Gain§r:
Influences chances of how many drops you get, and whether you get any at all. 31 is the best for sure.

§eResistance§r:
This stat is responsible for a couple of crops' properties: chances for getting a seed while punching crop, resistance of your crop to trampling (jumping on it), decreases chance of crop dying due to lack of environmental stats, and resistance of crop to weed spread. It also reduces mutation chance as it goes up (apparently). Aim for around 10 for balance.

rows.after: 如果你想要留著你的牛和馬來產奶和……膠水……你可以用皮革葉來獲得皮革。

rows.after: 苦力怕之草（Creeperweed）可為你提供火藥，不需要擔心爆炸。
rows.english:
Creeperweed can supply your gunpowder needs without dealing with bothersome explosions. It also has quite a few attributes, making it a good source of random crops.

Corium can breed into creeperweed.

rows.note: 第1323篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.after: 你最好把你的防化服穿上

rows.before: 想要些綠寶石用來買東西或是做些別的？這裡有個來源。%n%n譯者注：原文為Bobsyeruncleranks，這個詞的最初來源是英國熟語“Bob's your uncle”，意為“就在這兒了”或者“這就完成了”。誕生背景是1887年英國首相任命侄子事件，暗含裙帶關係帶來的捷徑成功。

rows.after: 深藍色的藍寶石之海

rows.note: 第1326篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 你需要在下方放個藍寶石塊才能讓這美麗的植物成熟。在LV階段獲得工業高爐後它是鋁和氧的優秀來源，但還有更優的選擇……

rows.english: Sapphirum are pretty easy to get from Copper Oreberries. You'll need a block of Sapphire beneath them to get them to maturity. They are a good source of aluminium and oxygen in LV.
rows.note: 第1326篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 紅配黃
rows.after: 紅配黃
rows.english: Red Touch Yellow
rows.note: 第1327篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。礦砂與粉末、HV研磨機需求差異保留。

rows.before: 石榴石實際上比藍寶石更有價值。它們是初期鉻和錳的可靠來源。而這兩樣金屬對HV機器的製造來說是必不可少的。你也可以將鎂鋁榴石粉，鐵鋁榴石粉或錳鋁榴石粉與硝酸離心來獲取更多副產物資源。你需要在田地下方放個石榴石塊（任意類型）才能培育出它。 可以透過粉碎錳鋁榴石礦石獲取石榴石（副產物），還可以用聚爆壓縮機將石榴石粉重新壓成晶體，再製作成塊。%n%n蒸汽多方塊機器對處理石榴石草的產物很有幫助！不過說實話，你距離使用一些化學品來充分利用這些產物，還有很長一段路要走。
rows.after: 石榴石實際上比藍寶石更有價值。它們是初期鉻和錳的可靠來源。而這兩樣金屬對HV機器的製造來說是必不可少的。你也可以將鎂鋁榴石粉，鐵鋁榴石粉或錳鋁榴石粉與硝酸離心來獲取更多副產物資源。你需要在田地下方放個石榴石塊（任意類型）才能培育出它。 可以透過粉碎錳鋁榴石礦石獲取石榴石（副產物），還可以用聚爆壓縮機將石榴石粉重新壓成晶體，再製作成塊。%n%n蒸汽多方塊機器對處理石榴石草的產物很有幫助！不過說實話，你距離使用一些化學品來充分利用這些產物，還有很長一段路要走。
rows.english: Garnets are actually more valuable than Sapphires. They're an early source of Chrome and Manganese, which you'll need for HV machines. You can also centrifuge Pyrope, Almandine, and Spessartine Dust with Nitric Acid to obtain a variety of additional passive resources. To reach maturity, you will need a block of Garnet (either type) beneath this crop. You can get Garnets from the HV macerator and Spessartine Ore, or you can use an Implosion Compressor to turn Garnet Sands into crystals to make blocks.
rows.note: 第1327篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。礦砂與粉末、HV研磨機需求差異保留。

rows.after: 匍匐攀緣者

rows.before: 盆栽之道
rows.after: 盆栽之道
rows.english: Wax On, Wax Off
rows.note: 第1329篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 只需將樹苗種在作物架上，你就能創造出迷你版本的相應樹木——小小的真可愛！%n%n盆栽樹的產物與普通樹相同，但不用浪費那些生成一棵樹的所有方塊只為了將其再砍掉的服務端計算。而這些通常是消耗伺服器資源的大頭，所以如果你想玩得流暢，就培育一些盆栽樹吧。
rows.after: 只需將樹苗種在作物架上，你就能創造出迷你版本的相應樹木——小小的真可愛！%n%n盆栽樹的產物與普通樹相同，但不用浪費那些生成一棵樹的所有方塊只為了將其再砍掉的服務端計算。而這些通常是消耗伺服器資源的大頭，所以如果你想玩得流暢，就培育一些盆栽樹吧。
rows.english:
You can take vanilla tree saplings and place them directly on crop sticks. This will give you a "bonsai" tree. Bonsai trees will give you drops just like a tree, but without the wasted CPU of placing all the tree blocks just to chop them down again.

This can be significant overhead on a server, so if you want to be nice, breed some bonsai trees for your pyrolyze ovens. They also drop a ton and are fast, especially statted up, so there's no reason not to if you can automate them.
rows.note: 第1329篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 作物的屬性
rows.after: 作物的屬性
rows.english: Min-Maxing Crops
rows.note: 第1330篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。整段CropsNH屬性說明取代IC2舊版，未核對CropsNH實作。

rows.before: CropsNH的一個重要部分是提升作物的屬性。每當一株新作物發芽時——無論是來自自交或者雜交——它總有一定機率發生……%n%n§l生長速度§r：%n§2提升生長速度§r%n- 提升每生長刻獲得的生長進度，最大可達約525%%，隨作物的等級有一定變動。%n§4可能會導致雜草生成§r%n- 當生長速度屬性高於23（對於死靈花來說是7）時，作物會開始向周圍的作物散播雜草和疾病。%n- 你可以透過使用除草劑，或將抗性屬性提升至大於或等於生長速度屬性來避免這一點。%n%n§l產量§r：%n§2提高收穫產量§r%n- 在達到31收穫時最大2.5倍產量。%n- 有（收穫/100）的機率將任何掉落物的堆疊數目提升1。%n%n§l抗性§r：%n§2提升種子收穫機率§r%n- 10點抗效能保證使用強化鏟子收穫成熟作物時總會掉落種子。%n- 以（抗性/10）的比率相應放大：%n  - 20：2顆種子%n  - 25：2顆種子 + 50%%機率掉落第3顆%n  - 31：3顆種子 + 10%%機率掉落第4顆%n- 31點抗效能保證即使不用鏟子收穫也能掉落種子。%n§2提升雜草抗性§r%n- 當作物的生長速度屬性高於23點時，只要抗性大於等於生長速度，它就會阻止雜草散播。%n§2提升作物的抗病性§r%n- 每點抗性都會減少作物染病的機率。%n- 31點抗性的作物將完全免疫疾病。%n§2這也包括營養評分過低導致的疾病，但低於最低營養評分需求時作物仍然不會生長。%n

rows.english:
Breed stickreed until it's around 20/31/10, then create other crops with it, they inherit the stats. Crossbreeding with the ones you got on the way to raise their stats is also good.

Set up camp in a swamp/jungle type biome around Y130, or use the biome changing methods to make one. This is way faster when breeding crops, not just growing them for drops.

Use multifarms, always. You can use them together with the harvesters if you have super fast crops. Or just use more farms. Or add more gearboxes.

Dark glass is nice for oreberry crops.

To avoid weeding, checkerboard up and down on your multifarm. It may look stupid, but no weeds, Gr 23->31, and +2 AQ!

Use fertilia to create more fertilizer.

You can replace mob farms with crops if you don't care about the other drops. Infernals drop special stuff though.

Use WAs in TE mode to accelerate crops if you need it. Mostly useful for breeding, statting up, and for the primordial berry crop.

As you tier up, you can create 31/31/0 crops with the machines and UUM. It's up to you whether it's worth it though.

Go do bees if you want something higher than EV tier materials.
rows.note: 第1330篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。整段CropsNH屬性說明取代IC2舊版，未核對CropsNH實作。

rows.before: 堅不可摧的容器
rows.after: 堅不可摧的容器
rows.english: Indestructible Vessel

rows.before: 鑑於你的神秘魔法研究，你得出結論，宏偉之木確實是一種非常適合建造堅固船隻的材料。充分利用這種材料的潛力使你能夠建造一艘速度稍快且永遠不會因碰撞而損毀的船。
rows.after: 鑑於你的神秘魔法研究，你得出結論，宏偉之木確實是一種非常適合建造堅固船隻的材料。充分利用這種材料的潛力使你能夠建造一艘速度稍快且永遠不會因碰撞而損毀的船。
rows.english: In light of your thaumaturgical research, you have come to the conclusion that Greatwood is, in fact, a great material for constructing a resilient boat. Utilizing this material to its fullest potential has allowed you to construct a boat that is slightly faster and will never break on collision.
rows.note: 第1436篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.after: 基礎飛行藥水
