rows.before: §6§l裂化石油
rows.after: §6§l裂化石油
rows.english: §6§lLet's Get Crackin!
rows.note: 第1783篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 在裂化石油餾分——例如輕燃油和重燃油——這方面，石油裂化機比化學反應釜更快、效率更高，產物量可以增加百分之25到百分之50（蒸汽裂化為50%%，加氫裂化為25%%，但消耗的氫減少20%%）。在蒸餾塔中處理裂化餾分，可以產出額外的副產物。考慮到之後的高階火箭需要用甲苯製取海量的工業TNT，建造這一多方塊機器是個明智的選擇。%n%n16個線圈在控制器方塊兩側構成2個豎直的環。兩環之間的機械方塊可以替換為輸入倉，用以輸入蒸汽或氫氣。能源倉和維護倉可替換任意機械方塊。輸入待裂化餾分和輸出裂化產物的倉室必須替換線圈環之外的機械方塊。%n%n提示：只可使用GT或RC的蒸汽，IC的蒸汽無效。可以直接用流體加熱器提供蒸汽，無需使用鍋爐。%n%n[note]請將程式設計電路放入控制器方塊。[/note]%n%n[note]PS：我在資料表格上列出了所有的裂化機配方，這樣你檢視起來會更加方便。現在你可以輕易地比較路線並選擇如何處理石油了！[/note]

rows.english:
Cracking oil products like light and heavy fuel with the oil cracker is faster and more efficient than using a chemical reactor, producing 25 to 50 percent more output, depending on which cracking method it's doing (steam does 50%, hydro does 25% but consumes 20% less hydrogen). Cracked products will result in additional by-products in the distillation tower. It is a smart idea to get this multiblock since you are going to need TONS of industrial TNT from Toluene for advanced tier rockets.

The 16 coils form 2 vertical rings of 8 on either side of the controller. The casings between the rings can be replaced with a hatch for steam/hydrogen input. Energy hatch and maintenance hatch can replace any of the casings. The input product hatch and output product hatch must replace one of the casings outside of the coils.

Hint: Only GT/Railcraft steam can be used, not ic2 steam. You can use a fluid heater to make it instead of a boiler.

[note]The circuit goes in the controller.[/note]

[note]PS: I listed all the cracker recipes on the spreadsheet for you to look at in a convenient format. Now you can easily compare which oil path to take![/note]

rows.english:
Do you want to automate your smeltery because you're planning to make stacks and stacks of glass blocks?

No problem, craft a large bronze pipe and place it under the faucet. Make sure to connect the pipe to the faucet using a wrench. Now the molten fluid will flow inside the pipe. Under or next to the pipe you have to place the casting basins or tables.

A hopper and a chest underneath will auto-output products from the casting blocks.

NOTE: Faucets will output precisely 144L each activation if you toggle it off immediately. That's going to have some uses later on...

[warn]Note that this will generate twice as much pollution in total - consider moving them further away.[/warn]

rows.before: 你的磚高爐的炭用量大得要命，蒸汽鍋爐也是？好吧，是時候建造更多焦爐然後將它們自動化了。焦爐倉、木製流體管道以及錫物品管道會助你一臂之力。%n%n它是一臺GT多方塊，自然可以共享焦爐磚和倉室。這個任務需求的量是建造10臺共享結構方塊的焦爐的最小磚塊量。%n%n記住你得用鋼製及以上的扳手才能拆卸錫物品管道。%n%n[note]搜尋NEI，找找製造焦爐磚的更優方式。[/note]%n%n[warn]整個焦爐工作產線會產生大量汙染--最好考慮把它們搬遠點。[/warn]

rows.english:
Your bricked blast furnace uses coal like hell and your steam boilers do too? Well it's time to make more coke ovens and automate them a bit. Wooden fluid pipes and tin item pipes will help you reach your goal. You can use either faucets with redstone clocks or LV pumps to empty the creosote. For the charcoal, hoppers are easy to get once you have an assembler.

Unlike GregTech multiblocks, coke ovens must have 1 space separating each oven.

Search NEI for a more efficient way to make coke oven bricks.

Remember that tin item pipes require a steel wrench to dismantle them.

The whole coke-oven process generates a lot of pollution, so consider putting it further away.

rows.before: 這是獲取木炭、雜酚油（比焦爐快50倍），以及其他副產物的最佳途徑。你需要大量的青銅、鐵和鋼來建造它，但這都是值得的。終於能拆掉木炭堆了。%n%n使用白銅合金線圈時，速度會稍微慢一些。每個線圈等級都能加速木炭的生產速度。

This oven is the best way to get charcoal and creosote (x50 faster than Railcraft's coke oven) and other byproducts. You will need tons of bronze, iron and steel to build it, but it's worth it. Finally, it will be possible to dismantle the charcoal pit.

With Cupronickel coils the oven is a bit slower. Each coil tier speeds up the charcoal production.

rows.before: §6§l該製造更多蒸汽了
rows.after: §6§l該製造更多蒸汽了
rows.english: §6§lIt's Time to Get More Steam
rows.note: 第1790篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。結構3x6x3／3x3x5、用水160／150及倉室位置有版本差異，不照舊英文覆寫。

rows.before: 在你有能力儲存大量的能源後，尋找生產大量能源方法的必要性就開始顯現出來了。你需要一臺大型青銅鍋爐。但為了製造這個鍋爐，你需要像山一樣多的青銅。這個鍋爐每tick能產生800L的蒸汽，這足以供應10臺基礎蒸汽輪機運作了。%n%n大型鍋爐既可以用水也可以用蒸餾水。每產生160L蒸汽，會消耗1L水。%n%n大型青銅鍋爐的整體尺寸為3x6x3，內部三格為青銅管道機械方塊。最下層需要包含1個輸入倉、1個輸出倉、5個燃燒室、1個消聲倉和1個維護倉，不能含有鍍銅磚塊。%n%n§c警告： 不同於其他鍋爐，大型鍋爐在執行時必須全程保持有水。執行中任意時刻缺水，都會導致爆炸。
rows.after: 在你有能力儲存大量的能源後，尋找生產大量能源方法的必要性就開始顯現出來了。你需要一臺大型青銅鍋爐。但為了製造這個鍋爐，你需要像山一樣多的青銅。這個鍋爐每tick能產生800L的蒸汽，這足以供應10臺基礎蒸汽輪機運作了。%n%n大型鍋爐既可以用水也可以用蒸餾水。每產生160L蒸汽，會消耗1L水。%n%n大型青銅鍋爐的整體尺寸為3x6x3，內部三格為青銅管道機械方塊。最下層需要包含1個輸入倉、1個輸出倉、5個燃燒室、1個消聲倉和1個維護倉，不能含有鍍銅磚塊。%n%n§c警告： 不同於其他鍋爐，大型鍋爐在執行時必須全程保持有水。執行中任意時刻缺水，都會導致爆炸。
rows.english:
As soon as you have the ability to store energy in large quantities, it would be necessary to have a way to generate energy in large quantities. You need a large bronze boiler. But in order to make this boiler, you will need a mountain of bronze. This boiler produces 800L of steam per tick. This is enough to run 10 basic steam turbines.

The large boiler can use either water or distilled water. Water is consumed at a rate of 1L of water per 150L of steam.

To make a large boiler you must make a 3x3x5 structure with Bronze Pipe Casings in the center of the middle 3 levels. The lowest level must contain at least 1 or 2 input hatches, 1 or 2 input buses, 3 or 4 fireboxes, 1 muffler, and one maintenance hatch. The lowest level can not contain any plated bricks. All hatches, buses, and mufflers must have their back side touching a firebox. The output hatch can be placed on any of the upper 4 levels.

§cWarning: Different from other boilers, Large Boilers must contain water at all times while active. If at any point the Boiler runs out of water while it is active, it will explode.

rows.before: 大型鈦鍋爐是青銅鍋爐和鋼鍋爐的遠房表哥，它們有著顯著的差異。鈦鍋爐只支援特定種類燃料並拒收其他燃料。檢視相應的NEI標籤頁，即可獲知其接受的燃料，不過固體超級燃料保證能用。%n%n這是一個很大的缺點，不過作為交換，這些高階鍋爐在各自階段都可以輸出相當可觀的能量。無需任何其他輸入，鈦鍋爐可以輸出相當於4000EU/t的過熱蒸汽（渦輪效率100％）。如果是150％的渦輪，同樣的蒸汽輸出可以產生6000EU/t，幾乎和大型內燃引擎的增壓模式一樣！%n%n不過，想要完整轉化鍋爐產出的能量，還需要高壓蒸汽渦輪，再配合普通蒸汽渦輪，如果蒸汽流量相對你選擇的渦輪轉子太大了，你還得多配幾對渦輪才行。記得迴圈利用蒸餾水！

rows.english:
The Titanium Large Boiler is a distant cousin to the Bronze and Steel Boilers, and it has a significant difference. Instead of accepting just about any burnable fuel, it will only accept specific ones and reject all others. You can see which ones are accepted by looking at the appropriate NEI tab, but the Solid Super Fuels are guaranteed to work.

This is a big downside, but the upside is that these boilers output respectable power even in these tiers. Without any other inputs, this boiler produces Superheated Steam at a flow rate matching 4000 EU/t, on turbines running at 100% fuel efficiency. If this becomes 150%, then the steam output will produce 6000 EU/t, almost the same as a boosted Large Combustion Engine!

To get all the power from this, though, you will need an HP Steam Turbine, followed by a regular Steam Turbine, or more than one of each if the flow rate is too big for the turbine material you've chosen. Make sure to send the Distilled Water back to the boilers!
rows.note: 第1792篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §6§l還要更多蒸汽？你確定嗎？
rows.after: §6§l還要更多蒸汽？你確定嗎？
rows.english: §6§lEven More Steam? Are You Sure?
rows.note: 第1793篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 在四種鍋爐中，大型鎢鋼鍋爐是最大也是最強的。它與鈦鍋爐類似，只接受特定燃料，主要就是固體超級燃料，不過它輸出過熱蒸汽的速度相當於100%%效率下的16000EU/t。如果你有更好的渦輪轉子材料，比如奧利哈鋼，那麼你就能獲得遠超這個數字的功率輸出，約為24000EU/t或是更高。%n%n你建造的大型鍋爐數量，決定了你可能需要大量的大型渦輪。而為了解決這個問題，你可以考慮讓每臺渦輪進入超載狀態，或者直接切換到松模式，不過只有在松模式下匹配最佳流量，這才算是個不錯的選擇。
rows.after: 在四種鍋爐中，大型鎢鋼鍋爐是最大也是最強的。它與鈦鍋爐類似，只接受特定燃料，主要就是固體超級燃料，不過它輸出過熱蒸汽的速度相當於100%%效率下的16000EU/t。如果你有更好的渦輪轉子材料，比如奧利哈鋼，那麼你就能獲得遠超這個數字的功率輸出，約為24000EU/t或是更高。%n%n你建造的大型鍋爐數量，決定了你可能需要大量的大型渦輪。而為了解決這個問題，你可以考慮讓每臺渦輪進入超載狀態，或者直接切換到鬆模式，不過只有在鬆模式下匹配最佳流量，這才算是個不錯的選擇。
rows.english:
The Large Tungstensteel Boiler is the biggest and baddest of the four. Like the Titanium one, it is a specialized boiler that only accepts specific fuels, mainly the Solid Super Fuels, but it will produce Superheated Steam at a rate equivalent to 16000 EU/t, at 100% fuel efficiency. If you have good Steam Turbines, especially Oriharukon ones, you will get much more power than that, around 24000 EU/t or more.

Depending on how many of these you build, you might need a huge amount of turbines. To solve that problem, consider going a bit above the optimal flow on each turbine, or even switching to Loose mode, although this is only a good choice if you can match the optimal flow in that mode.

rows.note: 第1794篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。新增超凡玻璃進出與內建超淨間細節未實作核對。

rows.before: 更加先進（也更加潔淨！）的電路板需要在無塵環境下才能製作。為了得到無塵環境我們需要超淨間。超淨間是個有趣的多方塊結構，因為你將在它的§o內部§r放置其他機器！%n%n超淨間是整體大小在3x4x3到15x15x15之間的中空多方塊結構。超淨間的底部並不需要是正方形，長方形也可以。頂層由過濾機外殼構成，除了邊緣，它是塑膠混凝土方塊。控制器必須位於頂層的中心。如果超淨間的長或寬是雙數，那麼控制器可以放在中心兩塊（或四塊）中的任意一塊。結構的其餘部分均由塑膠混凝土方塊搭建而成。%n%n其中最多30%%的塑膠混凝土方塊可以用其它的方塊或材料代替：%n%n一扇防爆門可以讓你進出無塵室。請確保門是關著的，否則超淨間會迅速失去潔淨度。旅行錨和電梯也可以使用，如果需要，甚至可以將它們嵌入地板中。如果你喜歡的話，也可以使用超凡玻璃作為“門”。%n%n你可以使用線纜二極體或機器外殼，來自動透過牆壁輸送電力和材料。但是在為你的內部機器更新換代時你要萬分小心。務必拆下舊的機器外殼和線纜二級管，然後用新的更高電壓的替換，否則你一定會很傷心的。如果只是用於傳輸物品，那就不用管等級的事。%n%n如果你想看到內部，可以使用任何EV級別以上的玻璃，例如防爆玻璃、魔力玻璃和超凡玻璃。如果超淨間沒有成型，請注意30%%的限制：問題往往由你放置了太多玻璃導致的。%n%n最後，超淨間本身還需要維護倉和能源倉來運轉。這個多方塊結構的耗電量有點不同尋常，一開始是40EU/t，然後逐漸降低。但即使是在使用40EU/t的情況下，要給它足夠的電，單個LV能源倉就足夠了，因為它接收2A-LV。請記住，這隻適用於超淨間，並不是一個普適規則。%n%n讓我們現在先造一個5x5x5大小的超淨間，你以後可以根據需要對它進行擴建。給它通電，讓它執行，直到潔淨度達到100%%。如果潔淨度低於100%%，超淨間內的機器就有機率吞掉在其中製作的物品，因此您要讓超淨間始終保持執行狀態！%n%n任何維護問題都會使潔淨度上限降低10%%。你可以使用行動式掃描器手動監控超淨間，或是使用工業資訊屏或維護提示覆蓋板配上紅石燈或蜂鳴報警器來自動監控。%n%n[note]多方塊機器，如大型化學反應釜或是高強度雷射蝕刻機，都可以提供無塵環境，所以這些機器無需放入超淨間。不過，你在使用其他機器，例如生物實驗室時還是會需要超淨間的。[/note]%n%n[note]其它有用的提示：你可以使用AE的無線接入器或向量變換介面，來跳過機器外殼，進行物品運輸，你還可以使用更高階的能源倉以更快地達到100%%的潔淨度。[/note]%n%n[warn]請注意：你不能在超淨間內使用任何會產生汙染的機器，否則超淨間會停止工作。[/warn]

rows.english:
If you want to make more advanced (and cheaper!) circuits, you will need a Cleanroom. The Cleanroom is an interesting multiblock, because you will be placing other machines §oinside§r of the room!

The cleanroom is a hollow multiblock between 3x4x3 and 15x15x15 (WxHxL) blocks. The base does not need to be a square; a rectangular shape is fine. The top layer is built out of Filter Machine Casings, except for the edges, which are Plascrete Blocks. The controller needs to be in the center of the top layer. If the width or length of the room are even, then it can be any one of the two (or four) middle blocks. The rest of the structure is built out of Plascrete Blocks.

Up to 30% of those Plascrete Blocks can be replaced by other valid blocks or materials:

A Reinforced Door lets you get in and out of the cleanroom. Make sure to keep the doors closed, or the cleanroom will rapidly lose efficiency. Travel Anchors and Elevators also work, you can even embed them in the floor if you want to.

In order to automate power and item transport through the walls, you can use Cable Diodes or Machine Hulls. Just be really careful when upgrading your machines to a higher voltage. Be sure to remove the machine hulls and diodes and replace them with the new power tier, or else you will be very sad. You don't need to do this for ones you only use to pass items through.

If you want to see inside, you can use any EV+ tier glass (for example, Reinforced Glass or Managlass). If the Cleanroom does not form, mind the 30% limit: often the problem is that you added too much glass.

Finally, the Cleanroom itself will need a Maintenance and Energy Hatch to run. The power usage of this multiblock is a bit unusual. It starts out at 40 EU/t and then gradually goes down. But even when it uses 40 EU/t - which is usually MV - a single LV energy hatch suffices, as long as you give it enough power. Just keep in mind that this makes the Cleanroom an exception, not the rule.

Let's build a 5x5x5 room for now. You can expand it later as needed. Give it power and let it run until it reaches 100% efficiency. Below 100% efficiency, machines inside the cleanroom have a chance to void outputs, so you want to keep the cleanroom running at all times!

Any maintenance issue reduces the maximum efficiency by 10%. Monitor your cleanroom with a Hand Scanner, Industrial Information Panel, or using a Needs Maintenance Cover and a Redstone Powered Light or Howler Alarm.

[note]Multiblocks such as the Large Chemical Reactor or Hyper-Intensity Laser Engraver don't need to be in a cleanroom. However, you will still need the cleanroom later on for other machines, like Bio Labs.[/note]

[note]Other helpful hints: you can use an AE Wireless Connector or a Transvector Interface for item transport to avoid machine hulls, and use a higher tier energy hatch to reach 100% efficiency faster.[/note]

[warn]Keep in mind that you can not use anything in the cleanroom that causes pollution, or the cleanroom will stop working.[/warn]

rows.before: 這個便攜掃描器是一個非常有用的工具，他可以掃描遊戲中幾乎每一個方塊並且顯示很多有用的資訊。 這個工具首先你需要給它充電。它可以接受MV級別128EU/t的充電速率，並且可以儲存400kEU的電量。%n%n它可以右鍵掃描在作物架上面的作物。%n%n它可以掃描GT的各種機器，能看到當前工作的進度，儲存的能量、效率、CPU負載等。%n%n對於遊戲中任何方塊，它都會獲得它的ID、後設資料、位置及硬度值。 並且還可以掃描當前區塊的汙染數值！%n%n除此之外還可顯示超淨間內的潔淨水平。
rows.after: 這個便攜掃描器是一個非常有用的工具，它可以掃描遊戲中幾乎每一個方塊並且顯示很多有用的資訊。 這個工具首先你需要給它充電。它可以接受MV級別128EU/t的充電速率，並且可以儲存400kEU的電量。%n%n它可以右鍵掃描在作物架上面的作物。%n%n它可以掃描GT的各種機器，能看到當前工作的進度，儲存的能量、效率、CPU負載等。%n%n對於遊戲中任何方塊，它都會獲得它的ID、後設資料、位置及硬度值。 並且還可以掃描當前區塊的汙染數值！%n%n除此之外還可顯示超淨間內的潔淨水平。
rows.english:
The portable scanner is a tool capable of showing advanced information about almost every block in the game. In order to function, the tool needs to be charged first. It can hold up to 400k EU and accept 128 EU/t or less. This is MV tier.

It can scan crops by right-clicking it to fully scan it, unlike a cropnalyzer which needs a seed bag in your inventory, and takes multiple goes. Crops that were scanned in the world will drop a scanned seed bag.

It can scan machines from GregTech, giving information about current progress, the stored energy, efficiency, problems and CPU-load - be sure to check the full chat window for additional details.

For any block in the game it scans, it gives information about its ID, Metadata, position in the world and hardness value. It also gives information about pollution level in the chunk the scanned block belongs to.

In addition it shows when the cleanroom has reached its 100 percent efficiency level.

rows.before: §6§l監控你的工業高爐
rows.after: §6§l監控你的工業高爐
rows.english: §6§lEBF Info
rows.note: 第1797篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 以前你可能會不停地用掃描器來檢查你工業高爐的生產進度。而現在你可以使用工業資訊屏來實時監控這些資訊了。製作一個GT感測器工具，掃描一下你的工業高爐，將感測器卡片放到資訊屏的控制方塊內，最後提供一個紅石訊號。%n%nGT感測器卡片可以監控所有GT機器，比如工業高爐、渦輪、熱解爐等。這可以讓你很方便地關注這些多方塊機器的維護問題（尤其是超淨間！！！）。%n%n如果資訊屏離需要監控的機器較遠，就需要範圍升級。%n%n[note]它還有一個更高階的版本。[/note]
rows.after: 以前你可能會不停地用掃描器來檢查你工業高爐的生產進度。而現在你可以使用工業資訊屏來實時監控這些資訊了。製作一個GT感測器工具，掃描一下你的工業高爐，將感測器卡片放到資訊屏的控制方塊內，最後提供一個紅石訊號。%n%nGT感測器卡片可以監控所有GT機器，比如工業高爐、渦輪、熱解爐等。這可以讓你很方便地關注這些多方塊機器的維護問題（尤其是超淨間！！！）。%n%n如果資訊屏離需要監控的機器較遠，就需要範圍升級。%n%n[note]它還有一個更高階的版本。[/note]
rows.english:
You can use a scanner to manually check how your EBF works, or you can make an information panel from nuclear control and always see the status. Make a GT sensor kit and use it on the EBF controller. Place the sensor card in your info panel. Enable it with a redstone signal.

The GregTech sensor card can monitor GregTech machines like the EBF, Turbines, and Pyrolyse ovens. This is handy for keeping an eye on maintenance issues for multiblocks.

If you want to put the panels far from the machines they are monitoring, you will need range upgrades.

[note]There's also a more advanced version.[/note]

rows.before: §6§l裝配線
rows.after: §6§l裝配線
rows.english: §6§lAssembly Line
rows.note: 第1798篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。裝配線層級方塊名稱與額外wiki註未逐一實作驗證。

rows.before: 裝配線（Assembly Line，簡稱‘Assline’）是製作LuV級及以上的高階部件的重要機器，用於製作馬達，活塞，機械臂，泵等等。%n%n裝配線可長5-16方塊。所需的最小長度取決於其製作的配方所需的部件和流體的數量。11格長適合GTNH中80％的配方。%n%n底層的所有輸入倉（4個）必須位於同一外側，在底部中間層是用於物品的輸入匯流排（10個），以及末端1個輸出匯流排。底部外層也必須有一個維護倉。其餘的是脫氧鋼機械方塊。%n%n第二層的左右外側是防爆玻璃，中間是裝配線方塊。%n%n第三層左右側是格柵機械方塊，中間是裝配線外殼（注意不是裝配線方塊！）。裝配線的控制器方塊和資料存取倉位於輸入倉的對側一端--而不是輸出匯流排的那端。%n%n第四層是中間一排脫氧鋼機械方塊（11個），用兩個能源倉供電。搭建成功之後，你就可以用一個LuV能源倉替換原來的兩個IV能源倉。%n%n裝配線自動化是GTNH自動化的巔峰技術之一。你可以使用較為先進的SFM（史蒂夫工廠）或者OC（開放式電腦），不過也可以嘗試使用EIO或僅用AE2實現。%n%n想要獲知關於裝配線的更多細節，訪問這個wiki頁面https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Assembly_Line%n%n[note]順便一提，ULV輸入匯流排可以幫助簡化自動化，不過你要是不打算自動化裝配線的話，用更高階的匯流排也可以，這不像電路裝配線限定必須ULV匯流排。[/note]%n%n[note]一臺滿長裝配線可以裝上16個輸入匯流排，此時位於最後的輸出匯流排需要置於側面。[/note]%n%n[note]在使用超過ULV等級的輸入匯流排時，它會先從左上角的格子開始讀取，一直到右下角的格子[/note]%n%n[note]中文wiki 裝配線：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/141[/url]§r[/note]

rows.english:
The Assembly Line (or 'Assline') is an important machine for high tier components in LuV tier and above for making Motors, Pistons, Robot Arms, Pumps and many more.

The multiblock can be 5-16 blocks long. The minimum length required depends on the number of components and fluids required by the recipe it's crafting. A length of 11 blocks will fit 80 percent of all recipes in GTNH.

The bottom layer must have on one outer side all the Input Hatches for fluids (4), in the bottom middle layer Input Buses for items (10), and on the end 1 Output Bus. Also on the bottom outer layer must be one Maintenance Hatch. The rest is Solid Steel Machine Casings.

The second layer on the outer sides left and right are Reinforced Glass and in the middle center Assembly Line Casing.

The third layer has on the left and right Grate Machine Casings and in the middle Assembler Machine Casings (Note the name change!). The Assembly Line control block and Data Access Hatch are on the opposite edge from the Input Hatches - not at the end with the Output Bus.

The fourth layer is a single line of Solid Steel Machine Casings in the middle (11), with two Energy Hatches for power. Once you have it built, you can replace the two IV energy hatches with 1 LuV energy hatch.

Automating the assline is a difficult challenge! You can use advanced tools like SFM or OpenComputers, but maybe you can figure out how to do it with EnderIO or just AE2.

For more details on using the Assembly Line, check out the wiki page [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Assembly_Line[/url]

[note]BTW the input buses are ULV to help with your automating, if you don't want to automate it, you can use higher tier ones, unlike the CAL.[/note]

[note]You can have up to 16 input buses. If you use the full 16 you should put the output bus to the side.[/note]

[note]When using buses of a higher tier than ULV it will look for items starting at the top left slot, down to the bottom right slot.[/note]

rows.before: 如果你想要讓裝配線進行一個以上配方的合成，那就需要資料存取倉。 資料存取倉有3+1種不同版本。%n%n資料存取倉：可存入4個快閃記憶體，所以支援4種配方。%n%n進階資料存取倉：可存入16個快閃記憶體。就是貴一點，不過你現在就能製造它。%n%n自動資料存取倉：這是UV階段才能製造的，它支援輸入/輸出快閃記憶體。一般沒人做。%n%n多方塊結構--資料庫：這連線到多個裝配線，可裝配1個以上的資料存取倉。非常好用，可以說等你能製造它時，它就是最佳方式了。 請檢視ZPM階段的任務。%n%n[note]只需要製作其中之一即可完成任務.[/note]

rows.english:
So, if you want to do more than one recipe in your Assline, you want a Data Access Hatch. There are 3+1 versions.

Data Access Hatch: It holds 4 data sticks, so 4 recipes.

Advanced Data Access Hatch: It holds 16 data sticks. Ironically, you can make this right away.

Automatable Data Access Hatch: It's UV, but it allows I/O of the sticks. Skip it.

The Data Bank Multi: Can be connected to multiple Asslines, and can contain more than 1 DAH. This is the best way, when you can do it. Look in ZPM for the quest.

[note]You only need to make one.[/note]

rows.before: §6§l鑽礦時間到！
rows.after: §6§l鑽礦時間到！
rows.english: §6§lTime to Drill For Ore!
rows.note: 第1800篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。MV以上／至少MV、144半徑及貧瘠礦fortune起始4等差異保留。

rows.before: 自動採礦機很不錯，但你想要更更更更更多的礦石。 這個多方塊機器將有助於此，但你需要先使用地震勘探者或高階探礦儀搜尋礦石。 它還會直接打碎你的礦石，並給你一些粉碎的礦石。%n%n更高的電壓等級將使其更快地鑽探。 你需要按電源等級對應地升級能源倉。 還需要輸入倉和輸出匯流排-MV以上自選。%n%n稍後你還可以升級採礦場，使其有效半徑超過48格（最高能達到144格）。如果你不想採到太遠的礦，可透過螺絲刀調整採礦範圍。  採礦場控制器每升一級都會對貧瘠礦多提供1增產。到了三階採礦場，你可能就需要壓縮箱子陣列才能放下你所有的財富了。%n%n多方塊採礦場已升級為自帶載入版本。執行時可自動載入被開採區塊，但它們無法載入自己。 它們會在本區塊按普通模式一路§o向下§r開採到底，然後再開始開採範圍內§o上方§r的其他區塊。%n%n你需要在控制器方塊或輸入匯流排中放入採礦管道並在流體輸入倉中放入鑽井液。  並且需要製造大量的鑽井液。64是剛剛入門的極少量！ 準備造個幾千桶再說！ -可以現場製造，或是透過長距離流體管道泵送。%n%n這些採礦場和發電機都是GT機器，所以別忘了防雨（防隕石！）。然後在旅行地圖上標記好位置，這樣你就再也不會忘記自己把採礦場放哪了！%n%n§4提示：%n§4如果你的採礦場需要鑽探超過64格深處的礦物，你可以新增一個輸入匯流排，放入一些採礦管道即可。%n%n譯者注：當採礦管道碰到基岩後，若開採範圍內沒有可開採礦石，採礦場將自動回收採礦管道，超出64部分將在輸出匯流排輸出。

rows.english:
Auto Miners are nice but you're going to reach a point where you will want MOOOOOOOOOOOOORE ores. This multiblock will help with that. It will also pre-macerate your ores and give you a little bonus crushed ores as well.

Higher tiers of power will drill faster. You need to upgrade the energy hatch corresponding to the power tier. You will also need an energy hatch, an input hatch, and an output bus - at least MV but you can choose.

Later you can upgrade the ore drilling plant so it extracts from more than a 48 block radius. If you don't want to mine that far away, adjust the range with a screwdriver. Each tier of the controller also gives 1 bonus fortune for small ores starting at 4. At tier 3 you'll want to spread the wealth to multiple compressed chests!

The multiblock miners have been upgraded so that they will chunkload the area they dig in. They will NOT chunkload themselves however. They will dig §odown§r in the chunk they're in like normal, and then dig §oup§r one chunk at a time in other chunks within its range.

You need mining pipes in the controller and drilling fluid in the fluid hatch. You can also feed mining pipes into an input bus.

You'll need to make lots of Drilling Fluid. 64 is a tiny amount to get started with! Plan to make thousands of buckets - perhaps onsite, or pumped in via Long Distance Fluid Pipes.

These are GT machines, so remember to protect them (and their power sources!) from rain (and meteors!) on any side. And set a waypoint with JourneyMap so you don't forget where you placed it!

rows.english: Thermal Boiler - Lava you long time
rows.note: 第1801篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 如果你想獲得岩漿中的能量和副產物，地熱鍋爐是完美的解決方案。它可以極快地處理岩漿併產生蒸汽，並且岩漿濾網會提供離心出的岩漿副產物。副產物可以提供大量的銅、銀、金、錫、鉭和鎢酸鹽。這相比現在常規的岩漿離心處理，可以產出更棒的產物。%n%n與大型熱交換機配合可獲得更高的效率。  大型熱交換機可以將普通岩漿轉化成熔岩岩漿，而熔岩岩漿可以在地熱鍋爐裡產出蒸汽以及副產物，一舉兩得！
rows.after: 如果你想獲得岩漿中的能量和副產物，地熱鍋爐是完美的解決方案。它可以極快地處理岩漿併產生蒸汽，並且岩漿濾網會提供離心出的岩漿副產物。副產物可以提供大量的銅、銀、金、錫、鉭和鎢酸鹽。這相比現在常規的岩漿離心處理，可以產出更棒的產物。%n%n與大型熱交換機配合可獲得更高的效率。  大型熱交換機可以將普通岩漿轉化成熔岩岩漿，而熔岩岩漿可以在地熱鍋爐裡產出蒸汽以及副產物，一舉兩得！
rows.english:
If you want energy from Lava and the byproducts, the Thermal Boiler is the perfect solution. It processes Lava super fast for Steam, and with a Lava Filter will provide some centrifuged lava byproducts as well. A great source of Copper, Silver, Gold, Tin, Tantalum, and Tungstate, better outputs than regular lava processing in a Centrifuge.

You can get even better efficiency pairing it with a Large Heat Exchanger. The LHE will turn normal vanilla Lava into Pahoehoe Lava, which will provide Steam and byproducts in the Thermal Boiler. Win/Win/Win!

rows.before: 風車可以用風的力量研磨物品和方塊。用它研磨礦石時每塊礦石有時只能獲得一個粉碎礦石。但當你嘗試研磨些別的東西時，可能還會有增產。這種增產與放入的物品有關，比如研磨地獄岩有機會獲得雙倍粉末，還有研磨小麥總會獲得1.25個麵粉。%n%n發射器可以取代牆上的黏土方塊。把你喜歡的東西放進風車內部-床、樓梯、火把等等。%n%n同樣適用普通多方塊的規則-不要跨區塊。%n%n如果這是你的第一臺多方塊結構，那麼你要知道，此後的所有多方塊結構都一樣-需要用軟錘敲擊控制器方塊才能啟用機器。%n%n如果你使多方塊結構成型的過程中遇到了困難，嘗試破壞控制器方塊並重新放置它。%n%n為了一次批次處理，可以透過漏斗之類的裝置向控制器方塊通入物品。只是記得別讓發射器滿了，否則它會銷燬之後的輸出物。%n%n即使控制器方塊停了或者沒有配方，轉子還是會繼續執行。所以在你不用時，移除轉子，否則它很快就會耗盡耐久。%n%n速度和輸出將受到風速，配方和轉子的影響。%n%n一次可處理16個物品。%n%n高風速將減少輸出。%n%n耐久將根據風速減少。

rows.english:
The Windmill is a grinder that uses the force of wind to macerate Items and Blocks. You will only get one crushed Ore from it sometimes. However it does give a bonus when you try to macerate other things. That bonus depends on the item inserted, for example Netherrack has a chance to give two instead of one dust and Wheat will always give one and a quarter flour.

The dispensers replace a clay block in the walls. Put anything you like in the interior - a bed, stairs, torches, etc.

Normal multiblock rules apply - do not cross chunk boundaries with this multiblock.

If this is your first GregTech multiblock, as with all the rest you will need to whack the controller with a soft mallet to activate it.

If you have troubles forming the multiblock, try breaking and replacing the controller block.

The controller can be fed items via hoppers etc. to allow for larger batches. Just don't allow the dispenser to fill up or it will void outputs.

The rotor blades will run if the controller is disabled or has no recipe. Remove the blades when not in use or else they'll be used up.

Speed and output will be affected by wind speed, recipe, and rotor.

Macerates 16 items at a time.

High wind speeds will decrease output.

The durability will decrease according to the wind speed.

rows.before: 高階超導導線和能源倉需要用到氦。  壓縮空氣然後將其冷凍液化，然後離心再離心，用這種方法生產9個氦單元需要用1802個壓縮空氣單元。 更明智的做法是從末地石或者月球上的獨居石中獲取氦。另一個選擇是檢視你的原油處理，並看看你如何能從那裡獲得氦氣。%n%n[note]PS：電解暮色冰雪女王的宮殿的極光塊與極光柱可1:1得獲取氦，你需要解決的就是開採問題，建議初期使用更替核心，後期直接用終界採石場。 至於冰雪女王……她不會介意的。[/note]%n%n譯者再注：現在可以蒸餾裂化煉油氣獲取大量的氦。

Higher tier superconducting wires and energy hatches will require helium. Compressing air and liquefying it requires 1802 compressed air cells to get 1 He cell. It's probably better to get it from end stone dust or monazite from the Moon. Another option is to have a look at your oil processing and see how you can get Helium from there.

[note]PS: If you've progressed far enough in the TF, you can also chip off parts of the snow queen's lair. She won't mind, right?[/note]

rows.before: 該設施將為你處理稍後需要的某些化學配方。比如火箭燃料。 注意，只有達到配方所需化工廠等級才能執行相應配方。%n%n而且化工廠需要大量資源，開始採礦吧！ 某些配方需要催化劑，將它們放在催化劑倉內。 催化劑消耗耐久，包括看起來沒有耐久的。%n%n[note]碳化矽可在攪拌機中獲得，不一定需要合金冶煉爐。[/note]%n%n可用的固體外殼：（決定化工廠可執行的配方等級）%n1 強化青銅機械方塊%n2 脫氧鋼機械方塊%n3 強化鋁機械方塊%n4 潔淨不鏽鋼機械方塊%n5 加強鈦機械方塊%n6 強化鎢鋼機械方塊%n7 強化勞倫姆合金機械方塊%n8 強化博特姆合金機械方塊%n%n可用的機械方塊：（決定倉室/匯流排的等級上限）%nULV-UHV機械方塊（UHV即可解鎖所有倉室/匯流排）%n%n可用的管道方塊：（從2並行，100％催化劑消耗機率開始，每級管道方塊提升+2並行，-20％催化劑消耗機率）%n青銅%n鋼%n鈦%n鎢鋼%n%n從白銅線圈到永恆線圈，所有等級線圈都可用。每個等級提速+50％，初始速度（白銅線圈）為50％。%n%n[note]另外：使用覺醒龍及以上等級的線圈+鎢鋼管道方塊，不會消耗催化劑耐久。[/note]%n%n[note]中文wiki 埃克森美孚化工廠：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/182[/url]§r[/note]

rows.english:
This facility will process certain chemical recipes you'll need later on, like Rocket Fuels. Keep in mind that recipes can only be made after meeting the required Chemical Plant tier.

It will need a minecart load of resources, so start mining!

Catalysts are needed in some recipes, place them in the Catalyst Housing. They use durability, this includes ones that don't look like it.

[note]You can make Silicon Carbide in the mixer, you don't need the ABS.[/note]

Valid solid casings: (Determines CP Tier for recipes)
1 Strong Bronze Machine Casing
2 Solid Steel Machine Casing
3 Sturdy Aluminium Machine Casing
4 Clean Stainless Steel Machine Casing
5 Stable Titanium Machine Casing
6 Robust Tungstensteel Casing
7 Vigorous Laurenium Machine Casing
8 Rugged Botmium Machine Casing

Valid machine casings: (Determines maximum hatch/bus tier)
LV-UHV Machine Casing, UHV unlocks any hatch/bus.

Valid pipe casings: (+2 Parallels, -20% chance to consume catalyst durability per pipe casing starting with 2 parallels and 100% chance for the first one.)
Bronze
Steel
Titanium
Tungstensteel

All coils from Cupronickel to Eternal are valid. Each one increases speed by +50%, starting at 50% speed for Cupronickel.

[note]Additionally: If you have at least Awakened Draconium Coils and Tungstensteel pipe casings, then no catalyst is consumed at all![/note]

rows.before: 細菌培養缸是一種獨特的多方塊機器，有其專屬的配方，也可以執行很多進階版的釀造室配方。%n%n在當前階段，細菌培養缸並非必不可少的機器，但它有許多有用的配方，並且之後你會需要它的，所以讓我們搭一臺吧！%n%n所有配方都需要（裝在培養皿中的）§c培養菌§r，某些配方對§c玻璃等級§r有要求。%n%n培養菌在生物實驗室中製得，需要§l放入細菌培養缸的控制器方塊§r。%n%n玻璃等級按LV玻璃=1階玻璃計算，而此任務要求你製作3階玻璃。%n%n[note]中文wiki 細菌培養缸：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/1381[/url]§r[/note]

rows.english:
The Bacterial Vat is a unique multiblock machine with its own recipes. But it also has advanced versions of many brewery recipes.

The Vat isn't mandatory in this tier, but there are many useful recipes and you'll need it later on, so let's build one!

All recipes require a §cculture§r, some recipes require a specific §cGlass-Tier.§r

The culture is made in a BioLab and §lput in the controller.§r

The Glass-Tier is calculated as LV = Tier 1, so this quest requires you to make tier 3 glass.

rows.before: 某些培養缸配方要求一定的輻射劑量（Sievert-Value）。 所以你需要為你的細菌培養缸新增放射倉用以輸入放射性材料！%n%n放射倉可容納放射性材料製成的桿或長桿，然後用它們提供輻射劑量。 輸入的物品決定SV值、持續時間。 在放射倉中的物品會隨時間而消耗（即使機器未啟動），所以最好在合成前再放入。%n%nSV值和持續時間可透過三錄儀掃描放射倉獲知。%n%n某些配方需要[warn]精確的[/warn]輻射劑量，手持螺絲刀右鍵放射倉可以進入輻射閘門控制介面以精確設定需要抑制的SV值。 比如說，你需要100SV來製取海藻基質，使用矽岩桿，然後抑制30SV。%n%n桿屬性：%n材料-SV-持續時間。%n鉍-83sv-198s%n鈾235-92sv-80s%n鈾238-92sv-80s%n鈽239-94sv-66s%n鈽241-94sv-66s%n矽岩-130sv-14.5s%n富集矽岩-140sv-10.5s%n超能矽岩-150sv-8s%n%n放射性材料還有很多，不過這些都是常用材料。%n%n[note]譯者注：現在可以直接在NEI中搜尋放射性材料檢視相關的屬性，或者搜尋放射倉檢視所有放射性材料列表。[/note]

rows.english:
Some Vat recipes require a certain Sievert (radioactivity) value. So attach this Radio Hatch to your Vat to input radioactive material!

The Radio Hatch holds rods/long rods of radioactive material and uses them to produce Sievert. The input item determines the Sievert value and how long it lasts. Items stored in the hatch will be used continuously even if machine not active, so make sure you want to craft something before putting items in.

You can check the stats of an inputted item with a portable scanner. Higher tiers of hatch hold more, from 1kg (HV) to 6kg (UV). Rods are worth 1kg, while long rods are 2kg.

Some recipes require [warn]exact[/warn] sievert, you can use the screwdriver to access the radiation shutter control to adjust how much sv is blocked from being sent to the vat. For example, you need 100sv to make Seaweed Broth, so you'd use Naquadah rods, and block off 30sv.

Rod Stats:
Material-Sievert-Apprx. time until used up
Bismuth                 83sv   198s
Uranium 235           92sv    80s
Uranium 238           92sv    80s
Plutonium 239         94sv    66s
Plutonium 241         94sv    66s
Naquadah             130sv   14.5s
Enriched Naquadah 140sv   10.5s
Naquadria            150sv     8s

There are more radioactive materials than these, but these are the main ones.

rows.after: §6§l讓培養缸更有效率！
rows.english: §6§lMaking the Vat More Efficient!

rows.before: 檢視培養缸的合成表時，你可能會覺得每次執行產生的流體實在太少。不用擔心！ NEI中顯示的流體消耗和產量僅僅是最低效率的基準。輸出倉內的流體量決定了培養缸的效率。%n%n隨著輸出倉內流體增多，培養缸的效率會隨之上升，直到輸出倉§c精確半滿§r時達到最大效率。超過一半繼續增加時，效率會再次降低，所以嘗試保持其中流體儘量靠近半滿！最高效率時，單次執行的流體消耗和產出是NEI顯示基礎值的1001倍，而物品消耗和培養皿不受影響。%n%n有許多不同的方法可以保持輸出倉半滿，包括OC（但不包括SFM，它對Bartworks的流體不太感冒），流體探測+機器控制覆蓋板，或者流體校準器，還有一些在機器壁上做文章的方法比如框架或者方塊共用。如果你選擇覆蓋板這種方法，記得用一個大一點的輸出倉，這樣更容易靠近半滿狀態。

rows.english:
Looking at the Vat's recipes you are likely discouraged by the small amount of fluid being produced per recipe. Don't worry! Fluid consumption and production shown in NEI are just the baseline for the lowest efficiency. The efficiency of Vat depends on the amount of fluid in the Output Hatch.

The efficiency gradually increases as the output hatch fills up and reaches maximum efficiency when it is §cexactly half-filled§r. If the hatch fills even more, the efficiency goes down again, so try to keep it close to half! At maximum efficiency the amount of fluid consumed and produced per recipe is multiplied by 1001. The items and culture are not affected.

There are different means to keep it at half, including OC (not SFM, it doesn't like BW fluids), fluid detector+machine controller, or a fluid regulator, as well as more off the wall ones such as frames or block-sharing. If you choose the fluid detector route, remember that using a larger output hatch will make it easier to keep it close to half-filled.

rows.before: 虛空採礦場幾乎和普通採礦場一樣，只不過它是從所在維度的整個礦石池內直接提取礦石，且並不需要附近真的有這種礦石。此外，你可以透過提供氖、氪、氙或鿫來提高產量。%n%n羅斯128ba上的Bartimaeusnek礦石中可以很容易地獲得氖。氪和氙可以透過離心燃料棒獲得。這三種氣體都可以透過EV液態空氣蒸餾獲得。記得裝上液態空氣倉以提供足量的液態空氣。同樣輸出最好選用巨型輸出倉，否則前4種氣體產物將會損失一部分。%n%n而想要獲得鿫，你需要MK3核融合反應爐。%n%n這四種流體均可複製，這可能也是最終的量產選擇。%n%n[note]想要在漆黑世界獲得礦石，虛空採礦場是必不可少的。[/note]%n%n[note]中文wiki 虛空採礦場：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/1129[/url]§r[/note]

rows.english:
Void Miners are basically the same thing as regular ones, except that they draw from the whole pool of ores for the dimension without there having to be any nearby. In addition, you can speed them up by supplying Neon, Krypton, Xenon, or Oganesson.

You can get Neon reasonably easily from Bartimaeusnek Ore from Ross 128ba. Krypton and Xenon can be produced from centrifuging fuel rods. All three can be produced from the EV liquid air distillation method. Remember you need the Liquid Air Fluid Hatch to actually put in enough liquid air. If you want all the produced gasses from the first 4 slots, you'll need to use the Giant Output Hatch.

To get Oganesson, you'll need mk3 fusion.

All four fluids can be replicated, so you'll probably end up doing that.

[note]If you want the Deep Dark's ores, you HAVE to use a Void Miner.[/note]

rows.english:
The TFFT is very useful if you don't want to have a bunch of Super Tanks, it also has a modular structure so it can be up to x4.33 times bigger than numbers in this quest.

With the tier I storage field block, it consumes 27 EU/t but only has about 0.27x the storage capacity of a Super Tank I per fluid.

With the tier V storage field block it consumes 1134 EU/t and has about 0.54x the storage capacity of a QT III per fluid.

With the tier X storage field block it consumes 0EU/t (only tier X uses 0) and has about x3.3 capacity of T7 YOTTank (divide by 25 to get per 1 fluid)

You can use the multi hatch to access all the fluids at once with an ME Fluid Storage Bus or Fluid Ender Conduit.

[note]Remember to turn auto-voiding on if you need it.[/note]

rows.english:
Right-click the controller while sneaking will invoke an action called §osurvival autoplace§r. This will attempt to build the multiblock with items from your inventory, provided the area this multi occupies is clear of obstacles. Again, like hologram spawning, multiblocks that accept multiple types of tiered components or has variable length, the number of MSHPs you hold in hand will decide which tier of blocks will be placed. It will place correct amount of hatches for you, but will usually orient the hatches towards you, not perpendicular to the surface. It will just place casings for you if you don't have any hatches in inventory, unless this spot requires the use of a hatch (e.g. the top center spot of EBF).

Survival autoplace can also take from your alternative inventories, or items that contain/link to an inventory. Currently, this includes:
- adventure backpacks, either worn or as an item in inventory
- AE2 portable cells
- ME networks connected via any AE2 wireless terminal with item access capabilities
- Forestry backpacks
- ender chest inventory, if you have the Ender Backpack from Backpacks mod. Note: ordinary backpacks from the Backpacks mod are NOT supported at the moment.

rows.english:
The ability to rotate MBs and view a structure hologram has been sto-§oborrowed§r from §9Tec§1Tech§r, giving you greater freedom to build the way you want! §5(until we nerf wallsharing at least)§r

Unlike TT, you can use a normal wrench for this, just aim at the front center of a controller (or one of the other sides if you want to. You just need to aim for the part of the grid with the mark) and right-click or shift-right-click. The first rotates it clockwise, the latter flips it. If you want to change the facing of the controller itself, do that the normal way.

Use a Multiblock Structure Hologram Projector or MSHP to visualize the structure, pay attention to the bottom left for structure details. For multiblocks that accept multiple types of tiered components or have a variable size, the number of MSHPs you hold in your hand will decide which tier is shown in the hologram.

[note]If you don't get it, try placing a controller, wrenching it, and using the MSHP on it.[/note]

While it's now possible to build a sideways EBF, or even build one into the floor, not everything can be rotated. Exceptions include: LSC, Charcoal Pile Igniter, BBF, DT, Miners, Industrial Washing Plant, Algae Farm, Bacterial Vat, DEHP, the MVF can, but the MBF cannot.

[note]PS: We did get permission, that was just a little joke.[/note]

rows.before: 中子活化器是一種獨具特色的機器。之後你需要用它處理矽岩，以及矽岩燃料（如果你選擇製作它的話）。%n%n與使用能源倉的傳統機器不同，它需要使用中子加速器，後者需要用中子感測倉來調控。§3（中子加速器仍然需要供電，和能源倉類似）§r%n%n中子加速器會提高中子動能（NKE）。當中子動能位於合適區間（見NEI）內時，活化器就會正常工作並輸出正確的產物。但是，如果你在中子動能不符要求時啟動活化器的話，它仍然會消耗你輸入的原材料，但產出垃圾。因此，使用活化器時請留意中子動能。%n%n當所有中子加速器都不執行時，中子動能會以每秒72keV的速率衰減。%n%n§d你可以用剪線鉗啟動批處理模式。§r%n%n[note]機器的高度越高、高速管道方塊越多，EU->eV的轉換效率就越低，使得你需要輸入更多功率。機制如下：高度每比4高一格，配方時間就乘以0.9，而單位功率獲得的eV乘以0.95。[/note] %n%n[note]中文wiki 中子活化器：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/1153[/url]§r[/note]

rows.english:
The Neutron Activator is a unique machine that you will use for processing Naquadah, and eventually Naquadah Fuel should you choose to do so.

Unlike traditional multis, instead of using a regular energy hatch, this machine relies on a Neutron Accelerator that will need to be regulated by a Sensor Hatch. §3(The Neutron Accelerator needs to be provided power just like an energy hatch)§r

The accelerator will increase its Neutron Kinetic Energy (NKE) and when the NKE is between the requested number which you can see in NEI, the machine will work and output the right products. However, if you turn on the Neutron Activator when NKE doesn't meet the requirement, it will still consume your input material but output trash. So be careful with the NKE when you run this machine.

When all Neutron Accelerators aren't running, NKE will decrease 72keV/s.

Neutron Activator will explode when NKE is over 1200MeV.

§dYou can enable batch mode with wire cutters.§r

[note]The more height/speed casings you have, the more inefficient the EU->eV conversion becomes, so you then need more power. The math is as follows: Multiply recipe time by 0.9 for each height above 4 and multiply eV you get from your input power by 0.95 for each height above 4.[/note]

rows.before: 大型空氣過濾機%n%n這種超棒的多方塊機器有3個版本：LV階段解鎖的T1，HV階段後期解鎖的T2，和IV階段解鎖的T3。%n%n它有兩種模式：%n%n- 普通模式：每次汙染清理週期中，按順序清理工作範圍內一個區塊的汙染。%n- 隨機模式：每次汙染清理週期中，在工作範圍內的所有汙染區塊中隨機選取一個區塊進行清理。%n手持螺絲刀右鍵控制器方塊即可在兩種模式之間切換。%n%n手持螺絲刀Shift+右鍵點選控制器方塊可以調節工作範圍，從1x1區塊到(2*等級+1)x(2*等級+1)區塊可調。預設工作範圍即為最大工作範圍。%n%n預設設定下，汙染清理值=30*機器等級係數*消聲倉數*渦輪效率*機器效率*2.5^有效等級。其中：%n%n- 機器等級係數：機器等級提供的增益係數，T1=1（0%%增益）、T2=1.05（5%%增益）、T3=1.10（10%%增益）%n%n- 消聲倉數：字面意思，至多為8。%n%n- 渦輪效率：用於執行該機器的渦輪效率值。若控制器中沒有渦輪，則大型空氣過濾器無法工作。%n%n- 機器效率：無維護問題時為100%%，每有一個維護問題-10%%。%n%n- 有效等級：電壓等級與消聲倉等級的較小者。%n%n，預設設定下，使用吸附過濾網可以使汙染清理效率翻倍。將其放入輸入匯流排後，吸附過濾網會被消耗並供接下來的30次成功的汙染清理週期使用。汙染低於10k單位的區塊會被該機器視為無汙染。清理無汙染區塊的汙染清理週期不計入“成功的汙染清理週期”次數。30次成功的汙染清理週期後，輸出匯流排中會生產出一個髒的吸附過濾網。%n%n對控制器方塊使用行動式掃描器，即可獲知其是否在使用吸附過濾網，以及吸附過濾網的剩餘週期數。%n%n一個汙染清理週期持續10秒，汙染清理每秒進行一次。%n%n[note]PS：如果你鴿了這個任務並做了T2或者T3版本作為代替，這個任務也會完成！[/note]%n%n譯者注：渦輪不會損耗，這是個bug。

rows.english:
Electric Air Filter

This wonderful multiblock comes in 3 versions: T1 for LV, T2 for late HV and T3 for IV.

It has 2 modes:

- a normal mode, where one chunk is processed at a time in the working area, in order, per pollution cleaning cycle.
- a random mode, where the chunk being cleaned is picked randomly between all the polluted chunks in the working area.
 To cycle between the modes, right-click on the controller with a screwdriver.

The controller can change its working area from 1x1 to (2*tier+1) x (2*tier+1) chunks. To do that, right-click with a screwdriver on the controller while sneaking. The default size is the maximum working area.

The pollution removal calculation is equals (by default) to 30 * bonusMultiTier * Muffler Hatches * Turbine Eff * Multiblock Eff * 2.5 ^ Effective Tier where:

- BonusMultiTier is a boost given by the multiblock tier. T1 is 1 (0%), T2 is 1.05 (5%) and T3 is 1.10 (10%)

- Muffler Hatches is the amount of muffler hatches on the multiblock (up to 8)

- Turbine Eff is the efficiency of the turbine chosen to run the multi. It won't run if there is no turbine in the controller.

- Multiblock Eff is the efficiency of the multiblock (100% when no maintenance issue, -10% per issue)

- Effective Tier is the Effective Tier of the multi: the minimum tier between the electric tier of the multi and the tier of the muffler hatches.

The pollution cleaning is boosted by two (by default) when using an Absorption Filter. When added in the input bus, it will be consumed and used for 30 (by default) successful pollution cleaning cycle. If a chunk with no pollution in it is processed, that doesn't count as successful, and the multi decides that a chunk has no pollution if the pollution is below 10k gibbl (by default). After the 30th successful pollution cleaning cycle, the output bus will give a Dirty Absorption Filter.

To know if an Absorption Filter is present and how many remaining cycles there are, use a portable scanner on the controller.

A pollution cycle lasts 10s, and the cleaning is done every second.

rows.english:
Building a smeltery from the ground up can be really tedious and time consuming. How about borrowing one from the locals? They will surely be happy to share it with an unfriendly adventurer that just dismantled their bricked railway station.

The villagers are so dumb that they spent all their seared bricks without adding a few key components like faucets or drains. You still need to craft some smeltery bricks yourselves...

Totally not useful tip: if you hold off building this long enough, you will be able to break down seared brick blocks into seared brick items with a forge hammer or extractor.

[note]Unfortunately, going down this path means we will not give you quest rewards, since you are already getting this important multiblock for free. Check the checkbox to signify your consent.[/note]

rows.before: 這一機制是完全可選的，且從不用於合成。不過，當並行數很高，或者需要製作解鎖更高等級的獨特物品時，它十分有用。“聚焦”---總的來說，就是提高量子操縱者的產物輸出機率。有兩種可選的聚焦方式。每種聚焦方式都需要一種新的電漿，分別是錼電漿和鐨電漿。它們需要在MK4核融合中由其他電漿制作。兩種電漿可以單獨也可以同時使用。%n%n當供應錼電漿時，你可以指定當前配方中的一種產物作為聚焦產物；這一產物需要在輸入匯流排中使用程式設計電路指定（這也是程式設計電路對該多方塊的唯一作用），程式設計電路1代表NEI中的第1種產物，電路2代表NEI中的第2種，以此類推。玩家可以選擇他們最需要所有產物中的哪一種；正因這一機制的存在，所有的配方都有多種不同的輸出。%n%n當一種產物由錼電漿聚焦時，該產物的產出機率上升，同時其餘所有產物的產出機率下降。其改變機制如下：%n%n->當沒有聚焦時，每種產物的機率均為100/產物種類數；%n當聚焦時，%n->若結構等級與配方等級一致，其餘所有產物的機率將減半，減少部分的機率轉移到聚焦產物機率上（例如，20/20/20/20/20變為60/10/10/10/10）；%n->若結構等級比配方等級高1，其餘產物機率將再次減半（例如，60/10/10/10/10將進一步變為80/5/5/5/5）；%n->若結構等級比配方等級高2或3，聚焦產物機率變為100%%而其餘所有產物機率變為0%%。%n%n總的來說，使用錼電漿聚焦並不能增加總產量，留著用來增產那些稀有的、隨該多方塊一起新增的物品吧；相對的，透過選擇聚焦產物，它允許玩家自己選擇、並用更有用的產物替代不那麼有用的產物。%n%n當提供鐨電漿時，當前配方的所有產出機率將全部增加，除非機率已經是100%%。鐨電漿提供的增幅隨著增幅前的機率減少而增加，在產出機率為0%%（高等級結構並使用錼電漿聚焦）時達到最大。%n%n使用鐨電漿聚焦時，其機率的變化由它與100%%的距離決定；這一增幅同時應用於所有產物，其機制如下：%n%n->若結構等級與配方等級一致，每種產物機率增加其“失敗”機率的1/4（例如，一種50%%機率產出的產物有50%%機率失敗，因而它會獲得12.5%%增幅，變為62.5%%）。%n->若結構等級比配方等級高1，每種產物機率增加其“失敗”機率的1/3。%n->若結構等級比配方等級高2或3，每種產物機率增加其“失敗”機率的1/2%n%n如果同時提供兩種電漿，並使用比配方等級高2或3級的結構，一個5種產物的配方的產出機率將從20/20/20/20/20變為100/50/50/50/50。%n%n許多後期多方塊機器都有並行功能，即它們能同時處理多次同一配方，但也需要更多的EU；這使得功率成為這些多方塊結構的最大限制，而對量子操縱者來說也是一樣，特別是它的配方輸入都相當簡單便宜：功率越高，產量越多。%n%n也就是說，想要量子操縱者執行更快的玩家會做更多的催化劑來解鎖更高的並行，但這種方式最多隻能達到64並行。而聚焦能改變產物的產出機率，從而顯著增加每次執行的產物數量。按產出速率計算，如果用錼電漿聚焦得到100%%產出機率，64並行的4產物配方對聚焦產物能達到相當於256並行的速率。%n%n對高等級、高並行的量子操縱者而言，這將節省大量的EU；這將是聚焦的主要使用原因，兩種聚焦方式在這裡都很有用。不過，電漿的使用量並非與並行數無關，而是與配方催化劑數，也即並行數的平方根成正比。%n%n聚焦對3種用於升級結構等級的物品格外有用：因為產出機率比一般情況小得多，聚焦時它們能獲得更多的加成，以激勵玩家在升級多方塊時更多地使用聚焦機制。

rows.english:
This mechanic is completely optional, and never required for crafting. However, it's greatly incentivized when the number of parallels is high and when crafting the unique items that unlock higher tiers. “Focusing”, in general, means to increase the chances of the outputs in a QFT recipe, and it can be done in two ways, possibly both at the same time. Each method uses a new plasma, both of which are crafted in a T4 Fusion Reactor by using other plasmas as the inputs, including one T3 plasma for each. These plasmas are Neptunium and Fermium and they can be used together, or individually.

When Neptunium Plasma is present, the current recipe can have one of the outputs focused. The specific output is chosen with a circuit in the input bus (this is the only thing circuits do for this multi), where circuit 1 is for the 1st output visible in NEI, circuit 2 is for the 2nd output, and so on. It is up to the player to choose which output they want the most out of all the existing ones, and the fact that every recipe has multiple outputs is because of this mechanic.

When an output is successfully focused with Neptunium, its chance increases by reducing the chance of all the other outputs. The logic for this change is as follows:

-> Without focusing, the chance of each output is 100 / number of outputs;
-> If the casing tier matches the recipe tier, the chance of all other outputs is halved and the sum of those halves is added to the focused output (for example, 20/20/20/20/20 becomes 60/10/10/10/10);
-> If the casing tier is +1 over the recipe tier, halve the other outputs' chance again (for example, 60/10/10/10/10 becomes 80/5/5/5/5);
-> If the casing tier is +2 or +3 over the recipe tier, set the focused output to 100% and the rest to 0%.

In general, this type of focusing doesn't increase the total amount of outputs, save for the new items added with this multi that will come out in smaller quantities. Instead, it allows the player to replace less useful outputs with the more useful ones, and this choice is completely up to them, as is the choice of focusing at all.

When Fermium Plasma is present, the current recipe will have all of its output chances boosted, unless the chance for one of them is 100%, in which case that chance is unchanged. This happens because the boost increases if the output chance before ferm focusing is smaller, and the maximum boost is achieved when the chance is 0%, which happens with high-tier nep focusing.

When an output is successfully focused with Fermium, its chance increases based on how far it is from 100% chance. This applies to all the outputs at once, and the logic for this change is as follows:

-> If the casing tier matches the recipe tier, each output gets increased by 1/4 of the "failure" chance (for example, a 50% chance output has a 50% chance of failure, so it gets boosted by 12.5%, becoming 62.5%)
-> If the casing tier is +1 over the recipe tier, each output gets increased by 1/3 of the "failure" chance
-> If the casing tier is +2 or +3 over the recipe tier, each output gets increased by 1/2 of the "failure" chance

With the two plasmas combined and a +2 or +3 over recipe tier, a 5-output recipe would normally have 20/20/20/20/20 chances, but it becomes 100/50/50/50/50.

Many lategame multis have parallels, which means they complete the recipe several times at once every time the recipe time is completed, instead of only one, but they require extra EU to achieve this. This makes power the biggest constraint for those multiblocks, and the same happens with the QFT, given that recipe inputs are generally very cheap and simple. Throwing more power at the machine means more outputs, in general.

Given that, a player that wants a faster QFT will make more catalysts to unlock more parallels, but each added parallels adds to the other ones, to a cap of 64. Focusing, instead, changes output odds, which effectively multiplies the number of outputs per cycle. In terms of speed, a recipe with 4 outputs and 64 parallels runs at the speed of 256 parallels for the focused output if it's nep focused to the maximum of 100%, since it was 25% originally.

This is a lot of saved EU for high-tier, high-parallel QFTs, so it is the main reason for focusing, and both plasmas are useful here. However, plasma consumption is not the same regardless of parallels, it instead scales with the square root of the number of correct catalysts for the recipe, which is to say, the number of parallels.

This further applies to the 3 new items that are needed to upgrade the casing tiers. Since their output amount is much smaller than usual, they could get a further boost if focusing is being used, to incentivize the plasma mechanic when upgrading the multi.

rows.english: Catalyzing Miracles
rows.note: 第1834篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 量子操縱者使用化工廠也使用的那種催化劑。然而，就像擁有覺醒龍或更高等級線圈的化工廠一樣，它不會在配方完成時消耗催化劑的耐久，更像是現實化學反應中的催化劑，它們在反應結束後會被重新生成為最初的物質。這使得這裡使用的催化劑的製作成本更高，就像與高等級線圈配合來製作突變活性焊料的無限突變催化劑一樣。%n%n鑑於沒有耐久損失，似乎只需要製作一次催化劑。然而，兩個原因使得你需要製作不止一份催化劑：首先，每個量子操縱者配方使用不同的催化劑；其次，量子操縱者透過計算大宗催化劑倉中所含催化劑的數量來確定並行（上限為2,147,483,647）。這套系統使你只製造一份催化劑就可以解鎖配方的使用，但最好多製作一些。而且多份催化劑只會改變配方的執行速度，前提是你要提供足夠的EU。%n%n每個能夠使你跳過某個生產線的催化劑都需要該產線解鎖的材料來製作。也就是說，必須使用原始加工線才能跳過它們。量子操縱者的每個配方都是如此。%n%n為了提高處理的總體速度，你的一種選擇是新增更多催化劑來增加量子操縱者的並行。另一種更復雜的方法是透過向系統新增更多能量來增加成功輸出的機率，但以一種特殊的方式：不是直接使用EU，而是生成大量的電漿來提高量子處理過程。%n%n不同的電漿有不同的功能。你也可以透過升級結構中的方塊來增強量子操縱者。這些升級依賴於更高階和更強大的材料，主要來自於超維度電漿鍛爐。然而，僅靠那些材料是不夠的，因為這些常規來源的物質無法維持量子穩定性。幸運的是，量子操縱者本身就可以生產你所需要的這些奇異材料。你在嘗試跳過一些生產線時發現了它們。因此，量子操縱者允許你更簡單的生產現有材料，在這個過程中，它產出了一些全新的材料，供你升級結構本身。%n%n你總共發現了三種新物質，機器也就有了四個層級。第一級是初始層級，之後的每個層級都需要這些新物質來建造。在現實生活中，這些物質只是理論上的理想材料。它們的特性都neta自其對應的跳過的產線。%n%n你升級量子操縱者所需要的第一種奇異物品是超穩態自修復黏合劑。要製作這種材料，請使用黏合促進催化劑執行膠水/焊料配方。此外，製作其他催化劑來證明您在量子領域之旅中已經準備就緒。

rows.english:
The QFT uses the kind of catalyst that the Chemical Plant also does. However, like the plants that have Awakened Draconium coils or higher, it does not consume the catalyst's durability on recipe finish, behaving more like a real-life catalyst that is regenerated after being used. This makes the catalysts used here more expensive to craft, as was the case with the Infinite Mutation Catalyst for Mutated Living Solder, which is meant to be used only with those coils that make it last forever.

Given that there is no durability loss, it would seem only one catalyst needs to be crafted. However, there are two reasons for this to not be true: firstly, each QFT recipe uses a different catalyst; secondly, the QFT checks for parallels by counting the amount of catalysts it has in its Bulk Catalyst Housing for the recipe in question (limit of 2,147,483,647). This system makes it so that crafting 1 of the correct type of catalyst is required to unlock a recipe, but making more is completely optional and only changes the speed at which the multi crafts, provided it gets enough EU input.

Every catalyst needs some of the materials that it unlocks in the QFT, which is to say, the original processing line will have to be used to craft the catalyst that allows the player to skip it in the QFT. This applies to every recipe, and in turn every line that can be skipped.

To improve the general speed of processing, your one options is to get more parallels with catalysts. The other, more complicated way is to boost the chances of a successful output by adding more energy to the system, but in a special way: instead of using direct EU, using it to create a powerful plasma works to improve the QFT processing.

If the correct plasmas are added, the boosting will work, but it is also possible to upgrade the structure itself to perform chemistry skips that are not possible with the base QFT. These upgrades rely on more advanced and powerful materials, mainly in the material progression of DTPF recipes. However, those existing materials are not enough, because the quantum stabilization can't be maintained with those “foreign” substances. Luckily, the QFT itself can produce the items needed to build the upgraded casings, and these items are outputs of some of the skips performed in the multi. It begins by allowing the much simpler production of already-owned materials but, in this process, it unlocks entirely new materials that are useful to improve the structure itself.

There are three new items and four tiers in the structure. The first tier can be built without them, but every new tier needs a new item crafted in the tier before. These outputs are related to the recipe where they can be obtained, and they possess unique characteristics that, in real life, are only theoretical.

The first item you will need to craft is the Hyper-Stable Self-Healing Adhesive. To craft this material, proceed with the Glue/Solder recipe by using the Adhesion Promoter Catalyst. Additionally, make these other catalysts to prove you're well set in your QFT journey.

Smelting with the ferocity of the universe itself.

This unbelievable material seemed impossible to manipulate into a coil block form, even though its properties made this desirable. It is incredibly stable even at extreme temperatures, but this also made it unable to pack together for coils.

However, the situation changed when you thought about using something more intelligent. By integrating a Wetware or better UHV circuit, the Infinity Coil became a reality, controlled by the ever-watching eyes of the circuitry you've spent months to create. From now on, these eyes will watch over your multiblocks.

Provides 11701K heat. You could upgrade your EBF, though at this point it's more likely to be for your MBFs or your DTPF.

rows.before: 超越時空，突破現實。你已窺見從未存在於世間的事物，將其化作流體，又凝為固體。克服重重困難之後，它終於穩定了下來。注視著它，你覺得你幾乎可以將整個宇宙握在手中。%n%n從前，你將幾乎所有材料結合為一，創造了永恆奇點，一個無限緻密的宇宙樣本。然而，想要將這一過程在超維度電漿鍛爐的量級上自動化是無比荒謬的，幾乎會使你的進度完全停滯，好在你發現了充能超立方體。想要在根本上展現出時空本身，你首先得展現出第四個空間維度，這就是超立方體的含義：一個四維的立方體。%n%n立方體！你周圍的一切幾乎都由立方體組成。僅僅是對四維世界現實的一瞥，便使你成功地利用它來凝結時空，將其隨心所欲地塑造成任何完整的永恆造物。無需多言，連生物電路也不足以維持這一極端緻密、無比穩定的多維材料。%n%n永恆線圈是目前最終極的升級，提供13,501K的基礎爐溫。讓你的超維度電漿鍛爐大放異彩吧!

rows.english:
Beyond spacetime, beyond reality. You have peered into what never existed and brought into a fluid, and then a solid. It has been stabilized, against all odds. When you look at it, you think that you could hold the entire universe in your hand.

In the past, you were able to combine almost all materials into one, through an Eternal Singularity, an infinitely dense sample of the universe. However, automating this at the scale of the DTPF proved ridiculous, which would have stopped your progress altogether if not for the discovery of the Energized Tesseract. To physically manifest spacetime itself, you first needed to manifest the fourth spatial dimension, and that is what the Tesseract is: a 4-dimensional cube.

Cubes! Almost everything around you is made out of cubes. You have only glimpsed at the reality of the 4-dimensional world, but you have successfully used it to condensate spacetime, which can be arbitrarily molded into the complete Eternal mixture. Needless to say, living circuits will not suffice to maintain an infinitely dense, infinitely stable, multi-dimensional material.

Currently, the final upgrade with 13501K. This really makes your DTPF shine!

rows.before: 可持續性。這並非一個遊戲的名字……但是它可以是！%n%n如果你曾希望僅僅從一個來源就能夠生產多種化學品，你可能已經看過了石油化工和苯環反應。然而，這裡還有一座藻類農場。%n%n從ULV（50s每批）到IV（25s每批），每個機械方塊等級都會將該結構進行一批藻類生產的時間間隔降低5秒；超出IV等級後，每個機械方塊等級會將該間隔減半。每次生產的時間仍然有可能隨機地翻倍甚至翻三倍，不過這種情況相對偶然。%n%n每個機械方塊等級同時也會提升單個生產迴圈生產的藻類數量和種類。每個生產迴圈會有一個精確的生產數量，以及10%%機率獲得的額外數量。藻類農場也接受堆肥輸入以提高一級等級，其中堆肥由產出的藻類加工而成。這在初期可能會比較昂貴，不過大多數情況下，這種做法是極度推薦的。ULV等級的機械方塊允許生產藻類生物質和綠藻生物質，HV等級額外允許褐藻生物質的生產，EV等級額外允許金褐藻生物質，而紅藻生物質則需要至少IV等級的機械方塊才能生產。儘管如此，對於高階的藻類生物質，在結構剛達到允許生產的機械方塊等級時，生產非常緩慢。%n%n要了解具體的產出數量和濕件，請查閱維基：[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/1696[/url]%n%n藻類可用於生產各種各樣的化學品，如甲醇、氨、硫酸、碳酸鈉、乙烯、氯化鋰甚至是一些可用於發電的流體。不過你通常會需要一臺化工廠以完成這些加工。在擁有IV等級的結構後，你也可以將綠藻生物質和螢光石粉合成夜光珊瑚，並從中製造陽光化合物。如果你對整條生產鏈很好奇，在NEI查閱他們吧！涵蓋這一生產鏈的任務，以及一些不依賴化工廠的加工配方，可能很快就會上線。

rows.english:
Sustainability. It's not the name of the game... but it could be!

If you've ever wanted to generate many chemicals from a single source, you've probably looked at Oil or Benzene. However there's also the Algae Farm. It's just a pond of sorts, so it doesn't need power to run. Since it also doesn't really follow normal recipes, you won't find any NEI recipe page for the Algae. The multi just produces them on a regular schedule.

The tier of the multi is given by the casings on the bottom layer of the multi, which all have to match to decide the tier. Each tier from ULV (starting at 50s per batch) till IV (which is 25s per batch) reduces the time it takes to produce Algae by about 5 seconds, and then beyond that each tier will cut the speed in half. Randomly the production speed can either double or triple the time it takes as well, but this happens relatively rarely.

Each tier increase also adds to the amount of Algae you get in a single cycle, as well as the type of Algae produced. Each cycle gives out an exact amount as well as a bonus amount 10% of the time. The Algae Farm also accepts Compost, that you can make from the algae itself, to boost the multi's tier by one. This might be expensive at the start, but it's heavily recommended in most cases. You can get regular Algae and Green Algae starting at ULV, Brown Algae starts appearing at HV, Golden-Brown Algae at EV, and Red Algae at IV, though most of the cases where they start appearing they start doing so in very small quantities.

To find out more about the exact output quantities and timings, please see the wiki: [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Algae_Farm[/url]

The Algae can be used for various chemicals like Methane, Ammonia, Sulfuric Acid, Sodium Carbonate, Ethylene, Lithium Chloride, and even some power-generating fluids. You typically need a Chemical Plant for that. In IV tier you can also combine Green Algae with Glowstone to get Glowing Coral and make Sunnarium from that. If you're curious about all the processing chains, look them up on NEI: quests to cover them are coming up, possibly with more recipes that don't need the chemplant.

After significant progression, you'll be able to upgrade the QFT to tier 2 by replacing the §3Neutron Pulse Manipulator§r casings with §3Cosmic Fabric Manipulator§r casings. Once installed, the QFT can perform the §6monaline skip§r, the §6first two naqline skips§r, and the §6netherite line skip§r.

Who knows what kinds of materials you’ll need after this?!

rows.english:
If you've built the Source Chamber already, you may have noticed that particles aren't produced as items, like GT++ ones are.

Instead they're transmitted through Beamline Pipes from multi to multi, similar to real life.

Each stream of particles transmitted, or "beam", has four properties:
- §6Particle§r: the type of particle carried by the beam
- §4Energy§r: the amount of energy the particles have
- §9Focus§r: out of 100, how focused the beam is
- §dAmount§r: a measure of the number of particles in the beam

Note that you can see info about a multi's input and output beams by using a Tricorder on the controller.

For the recipes you'll be interested in, i.e. the ones that actually produce items, there'll be a threshold for allowed input beam energy, a minimum focus value, and an amount value which determines recipe time (more on that in the Target Chamber quest).
Take a look some TC recipes for an example of this.

Have a photon. To hang on your wall.

rows.english:
To actually produce some light for photolithography, you'll need to accelerate your electrons in a Synchrotron. Like with the LINAC, providing it with coolant is necessary to keep it running.

You can increase the energy of the produced photons by increasing EU/t, or increasing the tier of all four Antenna Casings inside.

To improve focus, you can use a better coolant, and the output amount increases with both EU/t and antennae tier.

Yes, you need all four energy hatches.

rows.before: 線性加速器（LINAC）可以用於提高粒子束的能量，前提是粒子束的粒子是帶電的。你需要不斷地為其提供冷卻劑，否則每次冷卻劑耗盡時，你都會遇到維護問題。%n%n輸出能量可以透過增加EU/t（隨立方根比例增長）或增加長度（線性增長）來提高。然而，增加長度也會降低聚焦程度。%n%n聚焦程度可以透過使用更好/溫度更低的冷卻劑來提高（在tooltip中列出了選項）。%n%n請注意，粒子數量不會改變。

rows.english:
A Linear Accelerator (LINAC) can be used to boost the energy of your beam, provided the beam's particles are charged. You'll need to constantly provide it with coolant for it to run, otherwise you'll have maintenance issues every time it runs dry.

Output energy can be increased by increasing EU/t (scales with the cbrt) or increasing length (scales linearly). The latter also decreases focus, however.

Focus in turn can be improved by using a better/lower temperature coolant (options listed on tooltip).

Note that Amount remains unchanged.

rows.english:
Multiblock machines enforce input separation based on hatch color. Inputs from Input Buses and Input Hatches will only interact if they share the same color. Un-dyed inputs act as wildcards compatible with any color.

Color can be applied using a Spray Can and removed with a Spray Can Solvent. An Infinite Spray Can becomes available later in progression.

rows.english:
The Decay Warehouse stores a single type of radioactive isotope and allows it to decay over time. 

The decay speed of the isotope is §adependent§r on its half-life.

Isotopes will decay §9regardless§r of whether the warehouse is on or powered. 

The Warehouse's capacity equals the chest's capacity divided by §c400§r.

Capacity of the multiblock for each chest:

§6Super Chest I:§r §c10,000
§6Super Chest II:§r §c20,000
§6Super Chest III:§r §c40,000
§6Super Chest IV:§r §c80,000
§6Super Chest V:§r §c160,000
§6Quantum Chest I:§r §c320,000
§6Quantum Chest II:§r §c640,000
§6Quantum Chest III:§r §c1,280,000
§6Quantum Chest IV:§r §c2,560,000
§6Quantum Chest V:§r §c5,368,000§r

[note]Right click the controller with a §aScrewdriver§r to dump stored isotopes into an output bus.

Right click the controller with a §aPlunger§r to empty it. [/note]

rows.before: §6§l別把多方塊採礦場弄丟了！
rows.after: §6§l別把多方塊採礦場弄丟了！
rows.english: Don't Lose That Multiblock Miner!
rows.note: 第1852篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。來源及中文均寫NuclearCraft工業資訊屏，疑似原文也錯（Nuclear Control），待模組歸屬查證。

rows.before: 採礦場可容易弄丟了。你可是一名日理萬機的工程師，懂嗎？你不應當讓瑣碎的資訊填滿你的記憶，比如“我最後一次部署採礦場到底是在銀河系的哪個犄角旮旯？”你也可以用些無聊的方法，比如“寫下採礦場的位置座標”或是“在自己的礦物處理區掛個寫有採礦場座標的牌子”，不過現在有更好的方法了。%n%n資料發射器覆蓋板。將此覆蓋板貼上採礦場（或任意GT機器）時，將生成一張匹配該機器的GT高階感測器卡片。 將此卡片插入NuclearCraft的工業資訊屏，即可收到對應機器發回的執行資訊，也包括當前座標。另外，它還能傳回其低端版本——GT感測器工具——所能提供的各種資訊。與GT感測器工具不同的是，資料發射器覆蓋板§n可以在任意範圍內跨維度工作，無需範圍升級。§r另外，由於拆卸機器時覆蓋板仍然會保留在機器上，所以§n即便多方塊機器多次搬遷，匹配的感測器卡片仍然可以繼續工作，且無需重新校準。§r 這使其非常適合用於採礦場和油氣流體鑽機，這類需要部署在野外且經常搬遷的機器。%n%n但是，一如既往，這裡隱藏著一個陷阱。如果將資料發射器覆蓋板從主機上拆下，§n對應的感測器卡片將被摧毀。§r也許你不該在敏感的電子裝置周圍使用撬棍……

rows.english:
It's easy to lose Ore Drilling Plants. You're a busy engineer, you know? You can't be bothered to remember trifling things like "where, in what galactic backwater did I last place my miner." You could do something boring like "write down the location of the miner" or "put up a sign with the miner's location in my ore processing area," but there's a better way.

Enter the Metrics Transmitter Cover. This cover, when attached to a multiblock miner (or any GregTech machine), spawns in a GregTech Advanced Sensor Card paired to the host machine. This card, when inserted into a NuclearCraft Industrial Information Panel, will receive runtime information transmitted by the host machine, including its current location. Additionally, it returns the same information that its lower-tech sibling, the GregTech Sensor Kit, provides. Unlike the GregTech Sensor Kit, the Metrics Transmitter Cover §nworks interdimensionally and at any range without the need of range upgrades.§r In addition, since covers remain on machines when they are dismantled, the paired sensor card §nwill continue to work even if the host machine is relocated, and never needs to be recalibrated.§r This makes it perfect for the Ore Drilling Plant and Oil/Gas/Fluid Drilling Rig, which are deployed in the field and often have to be relocated.

However, like always, there's a catch. If the Metrics Transmitter Cover is detached from its host machine, §nthe paired sensor card will be destroyed.§r Maybe you shouldn't be using a crowbar around sensitive electronics...

rows.before: §6§l利用那些藻類
rows.after: §6§l利用那些藻類
rows.english: Using that Algae
rows.note: 第1853篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 很好！你已經制造了化工廠和一臺藻類農場。是時候好好利用它了，而不是把它們棄之不顧。你可以用藻類製作很多配方，但讓我們從一個簡單的開始。%n%n為此，你需要一些褐藻生物質和綠藻生物質。這意味著藻類農場底部至少需要HV機械方塊。HV藻類農場每35秒最多可生產8個褐藻生物質，而最差情況下每105秒只能生產2個，而EV藻類農場每30秒最多可生產20個，在最差情況下90秒只能生產12個。%n%n有了綠藻生物質和褐藻生物質後，將它們與蒸餾水一起放入二級化工廠（鋼製）就能得到硫酸。硫酸本身的生產成本很低，但這些機器做起來可有點貴！以後還可以使用另一種硫酸配方，但需要更高階的藻類生物質和更高等級的化工廠。
rows.after: 很好！你已經製造了化工廠和一臺藻類農場。是時候好好利用它了，而不是把它們棄之不顧。你可以用藻類製作很多配方，但讓我們從一個簡單的開始。%n%n為此，你需要一些褐藻生物質和綠藻生物質。這意味著藻類農場底部至少需要HV機械方塊。HV藻類農場每35秒最多可生產8個褐藻生物質，而最差情況下每105秒只能生產2個，而EV藻類農場每30秒最多可生產20個，在最差情況下90秒只能生產12個。%n%n有了綠藻生物質和褐藻生物質後，將它們與蒸餾水一起放入二級化工廠（鋼製）就能得到硫酸。硫酸本身的生產成本很低，但這些機器做起來可有點貴！以後還可以使用另一種硫酸配方，但需要更高階的藻類生物質和更高等級的化工廠。
rows.english:
So you've created the Chemical Plant, and an Algae Farm, excellent! Time to make some use of it instead of letting it sit there collecting. There's quite a few recipes you can make with Algae, but we'll start with a more simple one.

For this you'll need some Brown Algae and some Green Algae. This means you need at minimum HV machine casings for the bottom of the Algae Farm. HV will produce up to 8 brown algae every 35 seconds, but can at worst case produce 2 in 105 seconds, while EV will produce at best 20 every 30 seconds, and at worst 12 in 90 seconds.

Once you have some Green and Brown Algae, you'll have to put them in a tier 2 Chemical Plant (steel based) with some distilled water, and you'll get back Sulfuric Acid. Cheap to produce once you have it all set up, a bit expensive to get there though! There's another Sulfuric acid recipe you can use as well later on, but it'll cost higher tier Algae and a higher tier Chemical Plant.

rows.before: 既然你已經達到了ZPM，你就得采用普通雷射蝕刻之外的方法來滿足你的光刻需求了。%n%n當然，我們馬上就要大幹一場，需要一整套粒子加速器裝置來產生用於蝕刻更高階IC的超相干超高能光束。%n%n首先，你需要一個§6束流源室§r來產生電子（當然，能量極低）。在NEI 上檢視可用的配方，你會需要那個帶有手繪圖示的配方的。
rows.after: 既然你已經達到了ZPM，你就得採用普通雷射蝕刻之外的方法來滿足你的光刻需求了。%n%n當然，我們馬上就要大幹一場，需要一整套粒子加速器裝置來產生用於蝕刻更高階IC的超相干超高能光束。%n%n首先，你需要一個§6束流源室§r來產生電子（當然，能量極低）。在NEI 上檢視可用的配方，你會需要那個帶有手繪圖示的配方的。
rows.english:
Now that you've reached ZPM, you're going to have to resort to means other than mere laser engraving for your photolithography needs.

Of course, we're going overkill right away, requiring a full-on particle accelerator setup to produce the ultra-coherent ultra-high-energy light used to etch more advanced ICs.

To begin with, you'll need a Source Chamber to produce electrons (at pitifully low energies, of course). Check out NEI for the available recipes, you'll want the one with the hand-drawn icon.

rows.after: §6§l深層取水

rows.note: 第1856篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 集水器不夠用了嗎？你是否在乾燥的生物群系中建立了基地，急需更多的水？不用擔心，蒸汽水泵可以解決你的問題！只要用蒸汽餵飽這個多方塊結構（1500L/s），它就能產生大量的水。%n%n類似於其他蒸汽多方塊結構，你可以用鋼框架替換青銅框架來升級它。這將使水的產量翻倍，還不會增加額外的蒸汽消耗。%n%n§4然而，請記住這一點它依然依賴於你所在生物群系的濕度。§r%n%n§9提示：你可以在地獄找到貧瘠鉛礦石，或者足夠幸運的話，在地牢的最底層找到鉛錠！§r%n%n[note]注：可選任務目標的材料數量包括了控制器的消耗。[/note]
rows.after: 集水器不夠用了嗎？你是否在乾燥的生物群系中建立了基地，急需更多的水？不用擔心，蒸汽水泵可以解決你的問題！只要用蒸汽餵飽這個多方塊結構（1500L/s），它就能產生大量的水。%n%n類似於其他蒸汽多方塊結構，你可以用鋼框架替換青銅框架來升級它。這將使水的產量翻倍，還不會增加額外的蒸汽消耗。%n%n§4然而，請記住，它依然依賴於你所在生物群系的濕度。§r%n%n§9提示：你可以在地獄找到貧瘠鉛礦石，或者足夠幸運的話，在地牢的最底層找到鉛錠！§r%n%n[note]注：可選任務目標的材料數量包括了控制器的消耗。[/note]
rows.english:
Is the Water Tank not cutting it anymore? Have you set up in a dry biome and are in desperate need of more water? Fear not, for the Steam Water Pump can solve your issues! This Multiblock is able to produce large amounts of Water if fed with Steam (1500L/s).

Like other Steam Multiblocks, it can be upgraded by using Steel Frame Boxes instead of Bronze ones, which doubles the Water output at no additional Steam cost.

§4It is, however, still dependent on how humid the Biome you are in is, so keep that in mind.§r

§9Hint: You can find small lead ore in the Nether!§r

[note]P.S. The optional quest item count includes the cost for the controller. [/note]

rows.before: ……但是它們可以像蜜蜂一樣勤奮。這些新型的電動夥伴是多方塊結構的絕佳伴侶：維護，控制，管理——它們樣樣精通。%n%n§6§l維護§r%n§5§l無人機控制中心§r是一臺全新設計出的機器。它無需供能——只需要講一個無人機放入輸入匯流排，它就能開始執行。%n%n將多方塊結構上的維護倉替換為§l無人機下行模組§r，即可將其接入無人機網路。%n%n一旦啟動，無人機控制中心將會自動掃描在範圍內的所有下行模組，並且嘗試與其建立連線。只要無人機控制中心保持運作，所有已連線的多方塊結構將[bold]永遠[/bold]不再受惱人的維護問題困擾！%n%n[note]再見了，我那因維護故障損失的珍貴的256個超導粗胚錠……[/note]%n%n%n§6§l實體無人機§r%n無人機現在以實體形式存在，解鎖了多項新功能：%n%n- 當發生維護問題時，無人機會從下行模組出動，並繞受影響機器進行環形巡檢飛行。%n- 我們為無人機配備了攝像頭！點選 GUI 中的 §9§l觀察§r 按鈕，即可檢視無人機的實時影片畫面。只要您處於同一維度，無論距離多遠均可連線無人機。%n- 在觀察模式下，WAILA HUD 會顯示比平時更多的資訊。此外，將準星對準一臺機器並按下 §2§lG§r 鍵，即可遠端開啟其 GUI！目前支援所有 GT 機器及倉室。不過，由於無人機未配備機械臂，物品和流體槽位無法互動。%n%n%n§6§l分組控制與統計§r%n無人機控制中心提供了強大的機器管理介面，支援分組、遠端觀察、批次電源控制及機器重新命名：%n%n- 已連線的機器可被組織為最多 §664§r 個自定義分組。分組可重新命名，一臺機器可同時屬於多個分組。%n- 選中分組後，電源控制操作將應用於該分組內所有機器。具體而言，§6§l按住 Shift 點選§r 關機按鈕會將所有機器控制覆蓋板設定為“禁用”模式。%n- 啟用內建的 §5§l生產記錄器§r 後，無人機控制中心可收集所有已連線機器的實時統計資料，包括 EU 消耗、物品吞吐量和流體吞吐量。所有記錄資料均直接儲存在無人機控制中心內部。%n%n%n§6§l無人機等級§r%n[warn]無人機在執行過程中可能墜毀。墜毀機率從 T1 到 T3 逐級遞減，T3 和 T4 無人機永不墜毀。[/warn]%n%n不必擔心——如果輸入匯流排中有備用無人機，無人機控制中心會立即消耗它。%n%n使用更高等級的無人機會增加無人機控制中心的有效範圍：%n%n  §6•§r §l§3無人機（T1）§r%n    - 範圍：§6128 格§r%n    - 墜毀機率：§61/28,800 每秒§r（平均約 8 小時）%n%n  §6•§r §l§3無人機（T2）§r%n    - 範圍：§6512 格§r%n    - 墜毀機率：§61/172,800 每秒§r（平均約 48 小時）%n%n  §6•§r §l§3無人機（T3）§r%n    - 範圍：§64,096 格§r%n    - 墜毀機率：§2永不§r%n%n  §6•§r §l§3無人機（T4）§r%n    - 範圍：§64,096 格（自動）/ 無限（匹配金鑰）§r%n    - 墜毀機率：§2永不§r%n    - 跨維度：§2是§r%n%n%n要啟用 T4 無人機的跨維度連線，需在無人機控制中心和下行模組上配置匹配金鑰。%n%n下行模組可使用 §l快閃記憶體§r 複製匹配金鑰。%n%n&g&#FFD700&#FF4500我們的無人機現在可以跨其他星球操控機器……曲速引擎啟動！&r%n%n%n§6§l結構§r%n請參考 NEI 結構預覽來建造新的多方塊結構。中心還有一個全新的無人機模型！%n[note]漢麻混凝土可以是任意顏色！[/note]

rows.english:
...but they can be as industrious as bees. These new electric friends are great companions for Multiblock machines: maintenance, control, management—they can do it all.

§lThe Drone Centre is a newly designed machine. It doesn't need power; just put a drone into it and it will start running.
Once running, the drone will automatically scan for a '§lDrone Downlink Module§r' (replacing maintenance hatches on Multiblock machines) within a certain range and attempt to establish a connection with the host. If successful, you can remotely control this Multiblock machine from the Drone Centre GUI! Additionally, you can rename the machine for easier identification.

[note]You can rename it either by right-clicking the Drone Downlink Module or in the Drone Centre GUI.[/note]

Placing more advanced drones will increase the range of the Drone Centre, with no limit on the amount of drones.

[warn]Notice that drones may crash during operation—the probability decreases from Tier 1 to Tier 3, and Tier 3 Anti-Gravity Drones never crash.
Besides, If the machine host is too far from the Drone Centre, the GUI remote control function will be disabled, but the turn-on/off-all-button and maintenance functions will still work.[/warn]
§6§l
Maybe one day, our drone can control machines on other planets...drive engine online!

rows.english: §6§lOne Fluid Tank to Store it All!!
rows.note: 第1866篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 如果你覺得普通的超級缸或量子缸實在是太小了，那YOT儲罐一定對你胃口！%n%n相較T.F.F.T能儲存25種流體，YOT儲罐只能儲存一種。然而，不必與其他流體共享儲存空間也並非一件壞事。YOT儲罐同樣不需要能源和維護。%n%n如果你就是想大量儲存一種流體，YOT儲罐就是最佳選擇。該儲罐有專用的AE互動倉：YOT倉；儲存單元方塊部分結構上也是可擴充套件的。既可以升級流體單元方塊增加最大容量，也可以加高流體單元方塊部分的結構。%n%n因此，想要規整靚麗地儲存流體，YOT儲罐就是最佳選擇。%n%n[note]如果你在NEI中找不到流體單元方塊，可以試試搜：fluid cell block[/note]
rows.after: 如果你覺得普通的超級缸或量子缸實在是太小了，那YOT儲罐一定對你胃口！%n%n相較T.F.F.T能儲存25種流體，YOT儲罐只能儲存一種。然而，不必與其他流體共享儲存空間也並非一件壞事。YOT儲罐同樣不需要能源和維護。%n%n如果你就是想大量儲存一種流體，YOT儲罐就是最佳選擇。該儲罐有專用的AE互動倉：YOT倉；儲存單元方塊部分結構上也是可擴充套件的。既可以升級流體單元方塊增加最大容量，也可以加高流體單元方塊部分的結構。%n%n因此，想要規整靚麗地儲存流體，YOT儲罐就是最佳選擇。%n%n[note]如果你在NEI中找不到流體單元方塊，可以試試搜：fluid cell block[/note]
rows.english:
If you ever thought that the standard super tanks or quantum tanks were still too small then the YOTTank is the next option.

The YOTTank compared to the TFFT might only be able to store one fluid instead of 25 fluids. However it makes up for this downside by not having to share any of the fluid storage space with any other fluids. It also does not require any energy input or maintenance requirements.

If all you want to do is store a large amount of one fluid type then look no further then the YOTTank. It has a special ME input hatch for ae2 connections while having expandable storage blocks. The tank can be both upgraded with the fluid storage blocks and can be increased in height to hold any more fluid.

So if you want to store your fluid in style then look no further then the YOTTank.

[note]If you're having issues searching for the fluid storage blocks for the YOTTank in NEI then search for: fluid cell block[/note]

rows.before: §l終於，你做到了§r！現在你可以透過將§3無盡強化脈衝控制方塊§r替換為§3時空連續體撕裂方塊§r，將量子操縱者升級至最高等級。這次終極升級解鎖了所有產線跳過能力，包括跳過§6生物細胞、凱夫拉，以及拉多X+異氙§r的能力。%n%n即便完成了之前的各種升級，這最後一步仍遙不可及。對早期量子操縱者使用的基礎元件，如生物電路板，跳過其化學產線的能力始終無法實現——§o到目前為止§r。你需要一種遠超以往的全新材料才能達到量子操縱者的理論極限，它深藏在矽岩產線的後半段。%n%n你所需的材料將成為你的巔峰之作——§3超固態超能矽岩黑體§r。這種非凡物質既是完美黑體（能吸收所有輻射而無反射），又表現為超固態，能像零黏度的流體般流動。將這些特性結合於單一材料中，可確保在任何電壓等級（甚至包括MAX等級！）下都能實現穩定、毫不費力的量子能量流。%n%n憑藉這一突破，你的量子操縱者已完全解鎖，能夠製作高至UHV階段的元件。
rows.after: §l終於，你做到了§r！現在你可以透過將§3無盡強化脈衝控制方塊§r替換為§3時空連續體撕裂方塊§r，將量子操縱者升級至最高等級。這次終極升級解鎖了所有產線跳過能力，包括跳過§6生物細胞、凱夫拉，以及拉多X+異氙§r的能力。%n%n即便完成了之前的各種升級，這最後一步仍遙不可及。對早期量子操縱者使用的基礎元件，如生物電路，跳過其化學產線的能力始終無法實現——§o到目前為止§r。你需要一種遠超以往的全新材料才能達到量子操縱者的理論極限，它深藏在矽岩產線的後半段。%n%n你所需的材料將成為你的巔峰之作——§3超固態超能矽岩黑體§r。這種非凡物質既是完美黑體（能吸收所有輻射而無反射），又表現為超固態，能像零黏度的流體般流動。將這些特性結合於單一材料中，可確保在任何電壓等級（甚至包括MAX等級！）下都能實現穩定、毫不費力的量子能量流。%n%n憑藉這一突破，你的量子操縱者已完全解鎖，能夠製作高至UHV階段的元件。
rows.english:
§lFinally, you have done it§r! You can now upgrade your QFT to the ultimate tier by replacing your §3Infinity Infused Manipulator§r casings with §3SpaceTime Continuum Ripper§r casings. This final upgrade unlocks all skips, including the §6bio cell skip, the kevlar skip and the radox + xenoxene skip§r.

Even with all previous upgrades, the final leap remained out of reach. Chemical skips for foundational components used in the earlier stages of the QFT, such as bioware circuits, were still impossible - §ountil now§r. Reaching the theoretical limit of the QFT demands a material far beyond anything seen before, hidden deep within the second half of the Naquadah line.

The material you require will be your magnum opus - the §3Black Body Naquadria Supersolid§r. This extraordinary substance acts as a perfect black body - absorbing all radiation without reflection - and behaves as a supersolid, flowing like a fluid with zero viscosity. Combining these properties in a single material ensures stable, effortless quantum energy flow at any voltage level, even at the MAX tier!

With this breakthrough, your QFT is fully unlocked, capable of creating components up to the UHV tier.

rows.before: 藉助更先進的材料，你可以透過將§3寰宇強化脈衝控制方塊§r替換為§3無盡強化脈衝控制方塊§r，將量子操縱者升級至第三級。該階量子操縱者解鎖了兩項嶄新的強大能力：§6跳過矽岩線§r和§6跳過幹細胞線§r。%n%n這種新機械方塊需要更為尖端的材料，包括只能在2階量子操縱者中合成的§3複合稀土超導材料§r。與專注於結構完整性的§3超穩態自修復黏合劑§r不同，這種複合材料專為能量傳輸設計。由於自動修復功能已完全實現，我們現在可以將重點轉向提升元件間及多方塊機器內部的能流。%n%n普通超導體會在量子應力下失效，但這種複合材料徹底消除了外殼的所有電阻。其精密分層的稀土元素的平滑過渡，使量子流能夠無損耗、無失穩地自由流動。%n%n§o接下來，你還會發現什麼呢？！
rows.after: 藉助更先進的材料，你可以透過將§3寰宇強化脈衝控制方塊§r替換為§3無盡強化脈衝控制方塊§r，將量子操縱者升級至第三級。該階量子操縱者解鎖了兩項嶄新的強大能力：§6跳過矽岩線§r和§6跳過幹細胞線§r。%n%n這種新機械方塊需要更為尖端的材料，包括只能在2階量子操縱者中合成的§3複合稀土超導材料§r。與專注於結構完整性的§3超穩態自修復黏合劑§r不同，這種複合材料專為能量傳輸設計。由於自動修復功能已完全實現，我們現在可以將重點轉向提升元件間及多方塊機器內部的能流。%n%n普通超導體會在量子應力下失效，但這種複合材料徹底消除了外殼的所有電阻。其精密分層的稀土元素的平滑過渡，使量子流能夠無損耗、無失穩地自由流動。%n%n§o接下來，你還會發現什麼呢？！
rows.english:
With access to even more advanced materials, you can upgrade your QFT to tier 3 by replacing the §3Cosmic Fabric Manipulator§r casings with §3Infinity Infused Manipulator§r casings. This tier unlocks two powerful new skips: the §6final naqline skip§r and the §6stem cell skip§r.

This new casing requires even more advanced materials still, including the §3Superconductor Rare-Earth Composite§r, which can only be crafted in a tier 2 QFT. Unlike §3Hyper-Stable Self-Healing Adhesive§r, which focused on structural integrity, this composite is designed purely for energy transmission. With automatic self-repair now fully handled, we can shift our focus to increasing the energy flow between components and into the multi itself.

Standard superconductors break down under quantum stress - but this composite eliminates all resistance across the outer shell. Its precisely layered rare-earth elements create such gradual transitions that quantum flow moves effortlessly, with no losses or destabilizing effects.

§oWhat will you discover next?!
rows.note: 第1868篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §6§l藻類的更多用途
rows.after: §6§l藻類的更多用途
rows.english: More Algae Uses

rows.before: 現在你擁有了藻類池塘，為什麼不利用金褐藻來製造一些廉價的氨氣呢？每個金褐藻能製作50mb的氨氣。藻類農場在EV電壓下每工作60秒大約有90%%的機率獲得四個金褐藻生物質。%n%n這個過程不需要化工廠，最低僅需要MV等級的組裝機和MV等級的流體提取各一臺。
rows.after: 現在你擁有了藻類池塘，為什麼不利用金褐藻來製造一些廉價的氨氣呢？每個金褐藻能製作50mb的氨氣。藻類農場在EV電壓下每工作60秒大約有90%%的機率獲得四個金褐藻生物質。%n%n這個過程不需要化工廠，最低僅需要MV等級的組裝機和MV等級的流體提取機各一臺。
rows.english: Now that you have Titanium, why not make about 79 EV machine casings for some cheap Ammonia? The ratio is about 50mb to one Golden-Brown Algae. At EV you have a 10% chance to get 8 about every 30 seconds. It also does not require a Chemical Plant, but it will require an MV Assembler and an MV Fluid Extractor at minimum.

rows.before: §c§l一臺蒸汽驅動的離心機！
rows.after: §c§l一臺蒸汽驅動的離心機！
rows.english: A steam-powered whirl!
rows.note: 第1871篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 在蒸汽時代，如何離心分離稀有材料？答案當然是製造和使用大型蒸汽離心機！透過使用蒸汽產生旋轉力，這個多方塊機器可以快速且輕鬆地離心不同的材料。%n%n如果你覺得離心需要很長時間，那麼大型蒸汽離心機可以加速這一切！%n%n§3這個多方塊機器可以處理最高LV級別的配方，並且能夠處理需要輸出倉的配方。但如果你想處理需要流體輸入的配方，你將來可能需要建造一臺LV離心機。
rows.after: 在蒸汽時代，如何離心分離稀有材料？答案當然是製造和使用大型蒸汽離心機！透過使用蒸汽產生旋轉力，這個多方塊機器可以快速且輕鬆地離心不同的材料。%n%n如果你覺得離心需要很長時間，那麼大型蒸汽離心機可以加速這一切！%n%n§3這個多方塊機器可以處理最高LV級別的配方，並且能夠處理需要輸出倉的配方。但如果你想處理需要流體輸入的配方，你將來可能需要建造一臺LV離心機。
rows.english:
How does one centrifuge rare materials in the Steam Age? The answer is by building and using the Steam Separator, of course! By using steam to create a spinning force, this Multiblock can separate different materials quickly and easily.

If you think separation is taking forever, the Steam Separator will speed things up!

§3This Multiblock can process recipes up to LV Tier, and does accept an Output Hatch for recipes. But if you are looking to use recipes which require Fluid Inputs, you might have to build an LV Centrifuge in the future.
rows.note: 第1871篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

Making machines for every mold sounds tiring... fortunately, the Fluid Shaper multiblock can handle any number of molds by using §lSolidifier Hatches§r. This multiblock is also extendable, gaining more parallels if you add additional segments. Be sure to expand it if it's too slow!

[note]The Fluid Shaper also speeds up as it is running, making it more efficient to do large batches.[/note]

rows.before: 在你處理裂解燃料或熱解爐配方時，這個狠角色會極大地提高副產率。如此一來你就可以更有效率的製造工業TNT、塑膠、聚四氟乙烯，以及其他塑膠產品。你也需要這臺機器來完成你的鉑線。%n%n你需要在超淨間中製造EV電路板，然後才能製作這臺機器。%n%n至於倉室，你可以自由選擇。一個MV能源倉就可以勝任大多數有用的配方。兩個MV能源倉或者一個HV能源倉就可以覆蓋除了汙染物或丙酮外幾乎所有的配方。 你還需要一個輸入倉、至少五個輸出倉，以及一個輸出匯流排用於收集那些固體產出。%n%nNEI不太適合確定哪種裂化方案最佳，點選下面的石油裂化機wiki頁面連結來獲得一張方便又清晰的完整配置表格！%n%n[url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Oil_Cracking_Unit[/url]
rows.after: 在你處理裂解燃料或熱解爐配方時，這個狠角色會極大地提高副產率。如此一來你就可以更有效率的製造工業TNT、塑膠、聚四氟乙烯，以及其他塑膠產品。你也需要這臺機器來完成你的鉑線。%n%n你需要在超淨間中製造EV電路，然後才能製作這臺機器。%n%n至於倉室，你可以自由選擇。一個MV能源倉就可以勝任大多數有用的配方。兩個MV能源倉或者一個HV能源倉就可以覆蓋除了汙染物或丙酮外幾乎所有的配方。 你還需要一個輸入倉、至少五個輸出倉，以及一個輸出匯流排用於收集那些固體產出。%n%nNEI不太適合確定哪種裂化方案最佳，點選下面的石油裂化機wiki頁面連結來獲得一張方便又清晰的完整配置表格！%n%n[url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Oil_Cracking_Unit[/url]
rows.english:
This bad boy will tremendously boost the byproducts of your cracked fuel or pyrolyse oven. This way you can make industrial TNT, polyethylene, polytetrafluoroethylene and other plastics more efficiently. You'll also need this for the platline.

You'll need to make EV circuits in a cleanroom to build this machine.

For hatches, you can choose your own tier. 1 MV energy does most of the useful recipes. 2 MV energy or 1 HV energy hatch will cover almost all the rest.

You will need 1 input hatch, and at least 5 output hatches. An output bus will capture any solid outputs.

[note]PS: I listed all the DT recipes on the spreadsheet for you to look at in a convenient format. Now you can easily compare which oil path to take![/note]
rows.note: 第1880篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。現行額外污染物／丙酮例外及外部wiki連結與英文不同，保留。

rows.before: 已經厭倦使用小單元處理化學品了？建造一個大型化學反應釜吧，這樣你就能直接用管道輸送流體，或使用大型流體單元搬運流體。%n%n利用GUI內的銷燬模式按鈕，你可以設定大型化學反應釜在輸出倉室已滿時是否銷燬多餘的產物。%n%n大型化學反應釜有一些專屬配方，有時候你還可以跳過一兩步化學反應，記得多檢視配方表。%n%n此外，作為一個多方塊機器，大型化學反應釜可視為超淨間環境，可以執行超淨間配方。%n%n你還需要：%n1x維護倉%n1-2x能源倉%n0+輸入匯流排（如果配方需要輸入物品的話；搭建全自動產線時，你大概應當為每種材料準備一個輸入匯流排）%n0-1x輸出匯流排（如果配方會輸出物品的話）%n2+輸入倉（每種流體一個輸入倉）%n1+輸出倉（同上）%n%n對著輸出倉使用螺絲刀，可以迴圈切換其輸出模式。手持螺絲刀Shift+右鍵，可以直接切換到特定流體模式，再用單元鎖定輸出的流體，這樣自動化就方便多了。這一小技巧的適用範圍不止於大型化學反應釜。%n%n[note]你可以使用任何等級的線圈，但使用更高等級的線圈並不會帶來任何增益。[/note]
