rows.english:
Tired of using small cells to process chemicals? Build a Large Chemical Reactor and you can just pipe in and out fluids. Or use the glorious large fluid cells to deliver and remove fluids from the hatches.

You can decide if the reactor should void any extra products when the outputs are full or not by toggling the void mode in the GUI!

There are also recipes specific to only the LCR, sometimes even allowing you to skip a step, so keep your eyes open for that.

Additionally, as a multiblock, LCR also counts as a cleanroom for any cleanroom recipes.

You will also need:
1 Maintenance Hatch
1-2 Energy Hatches
0+ Input Bus (if a recipe has an item input. For full automation, you should probably use 1 for each material)
0-1 Output Bus (if a recipe has an item output)
2+ Input Hatch (use 1 for every fluid)
1+ Output Hatch (same as above)

You can use a screwdriver on an output hatch to cycle through its modes. Use shift-right-click to go directly to specific fluid mode, then lock the fluid with a cell for easier automation. This works on more than just the LCR.

Spinning around, getting hot - sounds like a dance. Or a thermal centrifuge. Build a large thermal refinery to get the most out of your ores.

You can use Noise Hazard Signs instead of Thermal Processing Casings, as long as you have at least 8 Thermal Processing Casings.

The muffler goes on the bottom layer.

rows.before: §r[warn]這個多方塊結構總是按照結構中能源倉的等級執行配方。如果機器沒有獲得足夠的能量供應，它將無法啟動。[/warn]%n%n雖然這個多方塊結構在IV階段就可以製作，但我們建議§n完成矽岩線之後再建造§r。%n%n%n該多方塊結構有3種不同模式：§3常規§r、§4工業高爐§r和§6礦石§r。%n%n%n在§3常規§r模式下，該多方塊結構會§3處理普通的電弧爐配方§r。%n%n在§4工業高爐§r模式下，該多方塊結構可以處理§4所有工業高爐配方，無視線圈等級需求§r。這項功能的代價是§l配方的基礎電壓等級提高2級§r。可執行配方等級由能源倉等級決定。%n%n在§6礦石§r模式下，這臺機器僅能處理可在普通熔爐中冶煉的礦石和粗礦，直接產出熔融金屬。%n%n%n除了這些模式外，這臺機器還有3個不同的處理階段。%n%n§l起弧階段：§r在開始執行配方前，機器需要花費6秒起弧。啟動耗能由安裝的電極引數決定：§6最大並行數§r × §2耗電倍率§r ×（1 + §4啟動懲罰§r）。啟動所需的電流以電極tooltip中的“§l啟動電流§r”引數形式展示。%n%n§l處理階段：§r在此階段，機器按安裝的電極的速度、並行、OC係數與耗電倍率執行配方。如果機器無法找到可用的配方，則會進入停機階段。%n%n§l停機階段：§r機器進入6秒鐘的階段，期間不處理任何配方，也不消耗任何能量。在停機階段之後，需要再次經過啟動階段才能處理配方。%n%n%n電極同樣具有耐久，並可能提供特殊效果。某些電極可以改變正常的起弧、處理和停機階段的行為，所以一定要經常檢視電極的tooltip。%n%n如果所用電極的耐久度降至§c25%%§r以下，則每次執行配方有§c5%%§r的機率引發一次電弧湧流，此時機器需要再次起弧。

The best source for hundreds of thousands of glass for...something? I dunno, think of something interesting and impress me!

This machine also does plasma arc furnace recipes.

[note]This multi is LuV and requires Thorium 232.[/note]

rows.before: 這些用於構建4臺7片的電路裝配線，足夠滿足一個系列的電路板製造。如果你僅需要某個系列中的一種電路板（比如微型處理器），那就把它除以4。%n%n假設你在LuV工作列已經獲得了所需的壓印電路，現在就可以開始製造晶體系列的電路裝配線了。我們一上來就要求4臺是因為每臺電路裝配線只能銘刻一次，無法移除銘刻。是的，你想用電路裝配線製造的每種電路板都需要一臺專用電路裝配線。%n%n作為裝配線，它與普通裝配線的工作方式一致，每個匯流排按順序提供原料，但由於是單臺專用，所以用起來就容易多了，同時合成表也便宜多了。%n%n電路裝配線使用“封裝”的原料，一次可以製造16個電路板（除了ULV和LV的），節約時間、EU還有焊錫（或鉍鉛合金）。在組裝機中使用16個對應物品和聚乙烯可以製造封裝元件。%n%n[note]順便一提，你可以選擇安裝更高階的倉/匯流排，不過合成時的原料順序還是得與NEI一致。另外，電路裝配線可以 4/4 超頻。[/note]
rows.after: 這些用於構建4臺7片的電路裝配線，足夠滿足一個系列的電路製造。如果你僅需要某個系列中的一種電路（比如微型處理器），那就把它除以4。%n%n假設你在LuV任務章節已經獲得了所需的壓印電路，現在就可以開始製造晶體系列的電路裝配線了。我們一上來就要求4臺是因為每臺電路裝配線只能銘刻一次，無法移除銘刻。是的，你想用電路裝配線製造的每種電路都需要一臺專用電路裝配線。%n%n作為裝配線，它與普通裝配線的工作方式一致，每個匯流排按順序提供原料，但由於是單臺專用，所以用起來就容易多了，同時合成表也便宜多了。%n%n電路裝配線使用“封裝”的原料，一次可以製造16個電路（除了ULV和LV的），節約時間、EU還有焊錫（或鉍鉛合金）。在組裝機中使用16個對應物品和聚乙烯可以製造封裝元件。%n%n[note]順便一提，你可以選擇安裝更高階的倉/匯流排，不過合成時的原料順序還是得與NEI一致。另外，電路裝配線可以 4/4 超頻。[/note]
rows.english:
You'll need all of this to create 4 CALs, enough for a single series of circuits. If you only want one (for the microprocessors for example), just divide by 4.

Assuming you got the necessary imprints on the LuV tab, you can now craft the CALs for the crystal processor series. We're starting with 4 since you'll need one per circuit, the imprint is not removable. And yes this means you need one for every circuit type you want to make with the CAL.

As an Assembly Line, it generally works like the normal one, with different items in each bus, but since it's only one item per CAL, it's far easier to use, and the recipe is cheaper too.

The CAL uses 'wraps' to make 16 of a circuit at a time (aside from ULV and LV circuits), saving you time, EU, and Soldering Alloy (or Indalloy). You make the wraps in an Assembler with 16 of the item and Polyethylene.

[note]BTW you can change out the Hatches and Buses for better ones, but you still need to keep ingredient order. Also CAL grants perfect overclock.[/note]

This is an upgraded version of your trusty ol' Steam Macerator. As a 3x3 Multiblock, it might seem expensive if you're in the Steam Age. However, the processing time per ore is so low that you can sustain your beginner's ore processing system with it!

The main reason to switch from this is the HV Macerator, which unlocks a slot for additional byproducts gained from the macerating step of ore processing. The Steam Grinder, in comparison, will only return the first item shown in the recipe output. However, this will do just fine until HV!

§3The Steam Grinder can only process recipes up to LV Tier.

rows.before: 巨型多方塊機器和GT++的邪惡結合一定是一些瘋子的傑作。它是一臺至多256並行的終極合金冶煉爐。使用更高階的線圈和玻璃同樣會提升處理速度並降低能量消耗。%n%n玻璃的等級限制了能源倉和配方的等級。和其他多方塊機器一樣,UEV玻璃可以解鎖所有等級，使用雷射倉需要UV玻璃。%n%n玻璃等級決定配方等級，例如UHV等級配方需要UHV級別的玻璃。
rows.after: 巨型多方塊機器和GT++的邪惡結合一定是一些瘋子的傑作。它是一臺至多256並行的終極合金冶煉爐。使用更高階的線圈和玻璃同樣會提升處理速度並降低能量消耗。%n%n玻璃的等級限制了能源倉和配方的等級。和其他多方塊機器一樣,UEV玻璃可以解鎖所有等級，使用雷射倉需要UV玻璃。%n%n玻璃等級決定配方等級，例如UHV等級配方需要UHV級別的玻璃。

This unholy union between Mega and GT++ must be the work of some madman. It is the ultimate metallurgical furnace to make your alloys with up to 256 parallels. Using better coils and glass also boosts its speed and reduces energy costs!

The glass tier limits both the energy hatch tier and the recipe tier. As with other multis, UEV glass unlocks all tiers and UV glass is needed for lasers.

Glass tiers gate recipe tiers, for example UHV recipes need UHV glass.

rows.after: §d§l另一臺多方塊化學反應釜？

rows.note: 第1907篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 迄今為止，你可能已經建造了許多臺大型化學反應釜。擁有強大4/4無損超頻的大型化學反應釜是最強多方塊之一。然而，如果這都無法滿足你的化工產線，怎麼辦呢？難道你已經使用了你能製作的最高等級的能源倉，就無法進一步提速了嗎？%n%n別擔心，我們為你提供瞭解決方案：巨型化學反應釜。它讓你可以使用256並行來執行大型化學反應釜配方！當然，如果你能提供足夠的能量，它同樣能夠進行超頻。%n%n由於需要7個核融合線圈方塊，所以LuV才能解鎖它。請檢視全息投影儀，獲知它的具體結構以及所需方塊。%n%n玻璃等級會限制可用的能源倉等級。你甚至可以用TecTech的多A能源倉！不過，如果你想用雷射倉的話，至少需要UV玻璃。

rows.english:
You probably have built a lot of Large Chemical Reactors by now. With the powerful 4/4 overclocking it is one of the strongest multiblocks there is. But what if even that is not enough to satisfy your chemical needs? You can't make it faster after using your best energy hatches available.

Fear not, we have a solution for you: The Mega Chemical Reactor. It lets you do 256 parallels for your LCR recipes! And you can still overclock after that if you provide enough power.

It only unlocks in LuV as it needs 7 Fusion Coil Blocks. Check with your hologram projector to see how it is built and what you need.

The glass tier limits the energy hatch tier that you can use. You can even use multiamp hatches from TecTech! If you want to use laser hatches however you need at least UV glass.

Definitely don't miss out on the Circuit Assembly Line or you'll be kicking yourself later.

Introducing the bigger (and better) Implosion Compressor, the Electric Implosion Compressor.

The Electric Implosion Compressor does not need any explosive and only needs electricity, isn't that very nice!

Furthermore it gains extra parallels 4^(Tier - 1) based on the containment block used in the middle.

Tier 1: Neutronium Block
Tier 2: Infinity Block
Tier 3: transcendent Metal Block
Tier 4: Spacetime Block
Tier 5: Universium Block

[note]While the structure preview shows holes in the middle, it requires the full 27 containment blocks to form, once formed the middle 5 blocks will disappear visually, but sometimes when breaking you will get them back (and sometimes you won't). [/note]

[note]The minimum allowed energy hatch tier is one tier below the recipe tier, so let's start with 2 UHV energy hatches for now.[/note]

How do you compress things in the Steam Age? Simple, putting a lot of steam in one place, under high pressure, can apply a force to compress things...

Upon reaching the land of IV machinery, you can put together even more multis and speed up your automation!

Many of the multiblocks from IV tier onwards use special alloys, which either need to be cooked like any ingots you've used before (in a Furnace or EBF), but there are also alloys which have to be made in the Alloy Blast Smelter (ABS), as a fluid, which then needs to be solidified.

The multis that need ABS alloys are further down. To unlock their quests, you will first need to craft the ABS itself. However, there is a large assortment of machines you can craft without it, just by having the respective IV singleblock equivalent and some other resources.

Those will be here... but you might be able to find some more, if you look closely through NEI. Good luck!

rows.before: 這是§6GigaGram§rFab新增的進階裝配線。%n%n這個裝配線支援流水線式操作，也就是說，它會像真正的裝配線一樣，一個一個消耗物品而非一次性全部消耗。實際上，它可以提供與該配方所需物品輸入數量相同的並行。你可以認為一條進階裝配線是由數個裝配片組成的，每個裝配片都可以獨立於其它片處理每一步。當輸入匯流排內物品與任意快閃記憶體吻合時，裝配線將開始工作。第一片將會消耗輸入匯流排#1內的物品。經過（配方時間/輸入物品種類數）時間後，第一片的工作完成，第二片開始工作。與此同時，第一片將會在輸入匯流排#1內尋找材料。如果材料足夠，則第一片將再次工作。%n%n終端片（第n片,n為配方要求輸入物品種類數）將會在完成工作時向輸出匯流排輸出產品，非終端片在工作完成後，將嘗試讓下一片工作。如果下一片的輸入匯流排中沒有足夠的材料，完成工作的片將會保持[warn]堵塞[/warn]狀態，並使裝配線進入掛起狀態。為方便定位[warn]堵塞[/warn]的裝配線，其控制器的正面指示燈將會變為橙色。%n%n啟用的片數乘以原配方所需EU/t即機器所消耗的EU/t。[warn]堵塞[/warn]片不會消耗能量。最低等級能源倉的輸入電壓，決定了配方等級和 2/4 超頻上限。安裝雷射倉可使其超頻到能源倉電壓以上，但會消耗比 2/4 超頻更多的能量。每§2雷射超頻§r一次，都會增加0.3倍的功率指數。一次§2雷射超頻§r使配方時間減少到50%%，使用430%%的能量。兩次§2雷射超頻§r使配方時間減少到25%%，使用1978%%的能量。機器會首先嚐試並行，然後嘗試 2/4 超頻，最後嘗試§2雷射超頻§r。

rows.english:
This is the advanced assembly line from §6GigaGram§rFab.

It supports item pipelining. That is, it will mimic a real assembly line by consuming ingredients one by one instead of all at start. In effect, it offers a parallelism up to however many item inputs this recipe requires. You can think of an advanced assembly line as a collection of slices which are capable of processing each step independently from other slices. It will start processing once the input bus contents align with any stored data stick. The first slice will consume the input in Bus #1. After (recipe time/number of inputs) time, the first slice's work is concluded and will start the second slice. At the same time, first slice will look for input in input bus #1. If there are still enough input there slice #1 will start working again.

The terminal slice (the n-th slice, where n is number of item input in recipe) will put the recipe output in output bus when it has concluded his work. Whenever a non-terminal slice finished its work, it will try to pass the work onto next slice. If the next slice cannot find the materials in its input bus, the just-finished slice will remain in [warn]STUCK[/warn] state and hang the assembly line. To help locate these [warn]STUCK[/warn] assembly lines, the controller's front face will have its status light turned orange.

The EU/t cost of this machine is number of slices active multiplied by the original recipe EU/t. [warn]STUCK[/warn] slices do not consume power. It will use the worst energy supplying hatch's input voltage for recipe tier calculation and normal imperfect overclock. With exotic energy hatches, it can overclock beyond usual voltage tier, but will consume even more power than usual imperfect overclock. Every §2laser overclock§r will 0.3 to power exponent. 1 §2laser overclock§r will have 50% recipe time and use 430% power. 2 §2laser overclocks§r will have 25% recipe time and use 1978% power. Will not overclock beyond 1 tick. Machine first tries to parallelize, then normal imperfect overclock, then §2laser overclock§r.

rows.before: 這臺多方塊機器是獲取大量木材的完美解決方案。您是否在為木炭或者苯發電時所需的大量木材發愁？您是否苦於無法獲取大量堅果來榨取種子油？亦或者因為裝飾性樹葉的來源而大傷腦筋？踏破鐵鞋無覓處，得來全不費工夫！%n%n原木擬生場可以種植遊戲內幾乎全部種類的樹木並且輸出你砍樹時會獲得的正常掉落。這一切都被整合在緊湊的空間中，無需忍受樹木真實生長時帶來的卡頓。%n%n首先，將任意一種樹苗放入控制器GUI中。其次，在輸入匯流排中放入你所需求的產物所對應的工具。最後，給機器通電，並且開啟它。接著你就準備好被產物所淹沒吧。%n%n樹的不同部分需要不同種類的工具。%n - 鋸對應木材%n - 剪枝器（GT）對應樹苗%n - 剪刀對應樹葉%n - 小刀對應水果%n高階工具（鏈鋸，剪枝器（林業），……）會提供更多產出！具體請檢視控制器的tooltip%n%n您甚至可以同時使用多個不同的工具，機器就能同時收穫多個不同的產品！%n%n請注意，使用的工具會緩慢失去耐久值。因此，為了長期執行，你可能需要設定一些自動更換功能。%n%n[note]在建造時你也可以用草方塊代替泥土。[/note]%n%n[warn]雖然這臺機器在IV階段就能製作，但在IV初期卻相當昂貴，需要16個 ZPM電路板和一些高階合金。[/warn]

rows.english:
This multiblock is the perfect solution to high-speed tree farming. Do you need wood for charcoal or benzene power? Nuts for seed oil? Leaf blocks for decoration? Look no further!

The Tree Growth Simulator can farm almost any tree in the game, and produces all the items you would get by chopping it down normally. All this in a compact 3x3x3 cube, without any lag from growing a real tree.

First, place any sapling in the controller slot of the multiblock. Then, insert tools appropriate to the part of the tree you want to harvest in an input bus. Give the machine power, turn it on, and be ready to get flooded by the outputs.

Different tools are required to gather different parts of the tree:
 - Saw for logs
 - Branch Cutter for saplings
 - Shears for leaves
 - Knife for fruit
Better versions of the tools (Chainsaw, Grafter, ...) will increase the yield! Check the tooltip of the controller block for details.

You can even use multiple different tools together, and the machine will harvest several different products at the same time!

Note that the tools used will slowly lose durability, so for long-term operation you might want to set up some automatic replacement.

[note]While this machine only requires IV, it is quite expensive to make early in the tier. You will need 16 ZPM circuits and some fancy alloys.[/note]

rows.before: 你現在應該累積了不少單方塊蒸汽機器。雖然這些機器可以處理少量材料，但總有一天你得處理大量物品。這就到了多方塊結構發揮作用的地方。%n%n雖然多方塊結構的材料成本遠高於單方塊，但它們也有一些優勢：它們使用的蒸汽更少，而且可以並行加工配方。也就是說，如果提供的蒸汽足夠，它們同一個配方週期可以製作多個物品。%n%n一些注意事項：%n%n-這些多方塊結構需要§4§l特定§r的I/O方塊，只能使用任務中的顯示的那些方塊%n-基礎級的結構使用青銅，但高壓級的要用鋼（檢視NEI中的多方塊預覽，它上面有不同的等級）；它們最多可以加工8件物品%n-看著控制器方塊時可以透過WAILA檢視機器的等級和並行處理的數量%n%n[note]完成了這個任務，你就正式開始了你的批次加工之旅。不過，先別高興得太早。雖然一些多方塊結構在蒸汽時代就可以製作，大多數的多方塊結構還是只有在EV或更高電壓等級才能解鎖，其中也包括這些蒸汽多方塊結構的加強版。[/note]

rows.english:
You should have quite the collection of single block Steam machines by now. While these may have gotten you through processing small amounts of materials, there will be a time when you will have to process a multitude of items. This is where Multiblocks come in.

While these Multiblocks have a material cost that is way higher than their single block counterparts, they have certain bonuses: they use less Steam, and they can process recipes in parallel, which means that a single recipe cycle can craft multiple items at once, if the Steam provided is enough to sustain it.

They do however have some quirks that need to be taken care of:

-These Multiblocks require §4§lvery specific§r I/O blocks, use only those that are part of the quest
-They process up to 8 items, where the Basic Tier is made of Bronze and High Pressure Tier is made of Steel (checkout the Multiblock Preview in NEI which will show you different levels of tiers)
-The Tier and amount of parallel processing can be seen via WAILA if you are looking at the Controller Block

[note]With this quest, you have started your journey with Mass Processing. However, don't get too excited quite yet. While there are some Multiblocks accessible in the Steam Age, most of them only unlock in EV or later, including better versions of these Multiblocks.[/note]

rows.english:
Sick of having to swap out lenses or make tens of laser engravers for your cleanroom? The Hyper-Intensity Laser Engraver is here for you. This multiblock can handle all of your engraving needs.

By using more powerful §lLaser Source Hatches§r in the structure, you can gain more parallels and run higher tier recipes.

[note]Laser source hatches are usually used for power transmission, but not here! No matter what laser hatch you use, it will NOT change the power input of HILE - it is determined by the standard energy hatch as usual.[/note]

rows.before: §8§lEV階段的多方塊機器
rows.after: §8§lEV階段的多方塊機器
rows.english: Extreme Voltage Multiblocks
rows.note: 第1934篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 你可能已經用上了蒸汽多方塊裝置或者工業篩選機。但在EV、IV以及之後的電壓等級中，你將解鎖許多多方塊機器，它們對應幾乎所有的GT單方塊機器。甚至還有更強大的裝置。%n%n它們中的大多數和你之前的GT的處理流程相同，但是速度更快。多方塊機器有三個好處：節省能源、更快的配方處理時間以及並行。並行意味著在能量供應足夠的情況下，配方單次的處理時間裡一次可以同時合成多個物品。%n%n這些新的多方塊機器的多樣性和複雜性遠遠超出了工業高爐、大型化學反應釜或者真空冷凍機等簡單的多方塊機器。雖然有些是簡單的立方體，但有些則具有更多樣化的機制和工作條件。作為回報，它們是非常強大的，因此務必留意他們。

rows.english:
You might already have a Steam Multiblock or the Large Sifter. But in EV, IV, and the following tiers you unlock multiblocks for (almost) every GT machine. And some more on top of that!

Most of them are made to do the same GT processing as the singleblock machines you've been using, but much faster. The multis can have up to three bonuses: energy savings, faster recipe time and parallels, which mean that a single recipe cycle can craft multiple items at once, if the power provided is enough to sustain it.

The variety of structures and intricacies of these new multis can go far beyond simpler multis like the EBF, LCR or VF. While some are simple cuboids, others come with more diverse mechanics and conditions to work properly. In return, they can be extremely powerful, so keep an eye out for them!

rows.before: §c§l氣壓洗滌！
rows.after: §c§l氣壓洗滌！
rows.english: Pressure washing!
rows.note: 第1935篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 如果您一直在處理挖掘到的礦石，那麼您一定會遇到各種各樣的粉碎的礦石。由於這些礦石比較髒，您必須將其清洗乾淨，才能獲得某些副產物。但如何清洗這些碎礦石呢？當然是使用大型蒸汽洗礦廠！只要有穩定的蒸汽供給和少量的水，你就能洗去雜質。並在短時間內得到洗淨的礦石。%n%n如果你厭倦了長時間等待洗礦，那麼這就是你的解決方案！%n%n§3這個多方塊結構有兩種模式，預設的洗礦機模式和簡易洗礦池模式。簡易洗礦池模式處理礦石的速度要快得多，但不會產生副產物。與其他多方塊結構一樣，可以透過機器控制器UI中的相應按鈕或用螺絲刀右鍵單擊控制器來切換模式。由於所有洗礦配方都是LV電壓，因此該多方塊結構可以執行所有洗礦配方。

rows.english:
If you have been processing the ores you have gathered until now, you will have come across a variety of crushed ores. Since these are quite dirty, you will have to clean them up to get certain byproducts. But how do you clean up this multitude of crushed ores? By using a Steam Purifier, of course! With a steady flow of Steam and a bit of Water, you can wash away impurities and get Purified Crushed Ores in no time.

If you're tired of waiting forever for your ores to clean up, this is your fix!

§3This Multiblock has two modes, the default Washer Mode and a Simple Washer Mode. Simple Washers process ores considerably faster, but they do not give byproducts. Like other Multiblocks, the mode can be toggled by the respective button inside the GUI or by right-clicking the Controller with a Screwdriver. Since all ore washing recipes are LV, this Multiblock can run all of them.

rows.before: 瑪麗鋦？
rows.after: 瑪麗鋦？
rows.english: Marie Curium?
rows.note: 第1937篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。鋦瓶頸0.144反應爐需求未核對整線配方。

rows.before: 就像是醃肉……哦不，完全不是，人們在研究放射性材料的道路上做出了許多犧牲，願他們永垂不朽，在此向你們致敬，瑪麗和皮埃爾·居里。%n%n這是整條核融合產鏈上生產出的唯一一種非電漿。但這不是重點： 重點是[warn]這是這條產線上的瓶頸之一。[/warn]每一臺用以生產最終配方的核融合堆，你都會需要大約0.144臺核融合堆生產鋦來維持，因此如果你想使用壓縮核融合反應爐來生產最終產物，僅靠一臺普通mk1反應爐來生產鋦是不夠的。你真正需要的數量取決於倒數第二步配方，也就是生產高階鎳鈦諾的那個。

rows.english:
It's like cured meat... no, not at all, many sacrifices were made on the path to understanding radioactivity, may they be remembered forever. This goes to you, Marie and Pierre Curie.

This is the only non-plasma produced in a fusion reaction in this entire chain. That's not the important part, though: the important part is that [warn]this is one of the bottlenecks of the chain.[/warn] For every reactor running the final recipe, you will need around 0.144 reactors of this, so you won't make it to a compact at the end with just one mk1 reactor. Expect to follow the count of the second-to-last recipe, the Advanced Nitinol one.

rows.english: XL Turbo Steam Turbine
rows.note: 第1938篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 這是第一個特大渦輪機。因為這是第一個，所以此任務將解釋一些特大渦輪機共有的機制。%n%n每個特大渦輪機可以容納12個渦輪轉子，但它的總速度比常規同等多方塊高出16倍。請確保每個轉子材料相同，並且確保足夠的輸入流速匹配多方塊裝置需求！如果還需要更快的速度，可以使用螺絲刀在控制器上啟用松模式，這會在提高渦輪機流量的同時降低效率。%n%n這些特大渦輪機還支援TecTech倉室，所以你可以用比常規輸出更高的多A動力倉，甚至之後使用雷射倉來處理最強渦輪機產生的數億EU/t。%n%n這五臺渦輪機與它們的下位替換燃料消耗相同，但也有一些例外情況將在相應的任務中提到。特大蒸汽渦輪機只消耗蒸汽，如其名字所述。%n%n[note]玻璃可使用任意等級。[/note]
rows.after: 這是第一個特大渦輪機。因為這是第一個，所以此任務將解釋一些特大渦輪機共有的機制。%n%n每個特大渦輪機可以容納12個渦輪轉子，但它的總速度比常規同等多方塊高出16倍。請確保每個轉子材料相同，並且確保足夠的輸入流速匹配多方塊裝置需求！如果還需要更快的速度，可以使用螺絲刀在控制器上啟用鬆模式，這會在提高渦輪機流量的同時降低效率。%n%n這些特大渦輪機還支援TecTech倉室，所以你可以用比常規輸出更高的多A動力倉，甚至之後使用雷射倉來處理最強渦輪機產生的數億EU/t。%n%n這五臺渦輪機與它們的下位替換燃料消耗相同，但也有一些例外情況將在相應的任務中提到。特大蒸汽渦輪機只消耗蒸汽，如其名字所述。%n%n[note]玻璃可使用任意等級。[/note]
rows.english:
The first of the XL Turbines. Because this is the first, this quest will include an explanation for the mechanics shared across all XL Turbines.

Every XL Turbine can hold 12 turbine items inside, in the 12 Rotor Assemblies, but their total speed is 16x higher than the regular multiblock equivalent. Make sure all the turbine items inside are of the same material, and also that you can provide enough input to match the flow rate that the multi needs! If you need even more speed, you can enable Loose Mode with a screwdriver on the controller, which can greatly increase turbines' flowrate while decreasing the efficiency.

These huge turbines also support TecTech hatches, so you can use multi-amp dynamos with a much higher output amount than normal, or even laser outputs later on to sustain the hundreds of millions of EU/t that the strongest turbines can produce.

Each of the 5 turbines takes in the same fuels as their smaller counterparts, with some exceptions that will be mentioned in the respective quest. This XL Steam Turbine only consumes Steam, as expected.
rows.note: 第1938篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 鈣瓶頸
rows.after: 鈣瓶頸
rows.english: Calcium Bottlenecking
rows.note: 第1939篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。半數硼反應爐加1／升級一階與現行建議略異，整條核融合鏈數量待配方核對。

rows.before: 給自己來些強筋健骨的鈣（電漿）吧。%n%n核融合鈣電漿的速度幾乎是硼電漿的兩倍，所以就只需要半數於硼電漿反應爐的核融合反應爐，又或是增加硼電漿反應爐的數量或等級。通常情況下，核融合鈣電漿的速度要慢很多，但是核融合氖電漿需要的鈣電漿的量並不多。%n%n記住，三條核融合鏈每條的最後一步，其所消耗電漿的速率都會成倍增加，也就意味著如果你是奔著天體鎢電漿去的，那麼大部分瓶頸將會出現在整個產線的末端。%n%n你需要2.13臺鈣電漿的反應爐供給一臺核融合氖電漿的反應爐。

rows.english:
Craft yourself some bone-strengthening Calcium in plasma form.

This step is almost twice as fast as the Boron one, so you only need half the reactors, plus one, or the tier above the reactors on the Boron side. It would normally be a lot slower, but the next step needs only a small amount of Calcium.

Keep in mind that, at the end of each of the three fusion chains, the plasma amount gets multiplied, which means that most of your bottlenecks will be near the end of the entire setup, if you're going for Celestial Tungsten Plasma.

You will need 2.13 reactors with this recipe to feed 1 reactor with the next step.

rows.before: 來到MV階段後，你可以繼續使用蒸汽。但是一直這樣並不是什麼好主意，相反其他類型的燃料將會越來越有用。原因是蒸汽輪機的效率會隨著電壓等級的提升迅速下降(這個只有75%%)，而且比起苯或者柴油，蒸汽還需要巨大的管道進行輸送。%n%n話說回來，如果你想繼續使用蒸汽的話，那麼建造一臺大型青銅鍋爐或是之後的大型鋼鍋爐就是個不錯的主意了。你將會需要大量的固體燃料，可能是木炭，因此請務必將其自動化！還有，絕不要忘了供水。

rows.english:
Having moved up to MV, you can continue using Steam. However, it's not a great idea to stay here, and other fuel types will be more useful to you instead. This is because Steam Turbine efficiency drops quickly with every tier (this one is only 75%), and the Steam itself needs big pipes to carry it around, compared to Benzene or Diesel.

That said, if you want to keep using this, then it's a good idea to build a Large Bronze Boiler or, later on, a Large Steel Boiler. You will need lots of solid fuel, probably Charcoal, so make sure you automate it! Definitely do not forget the water.
rows.note: 第1941篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §8§l標準核燃料：鈾
rows.after: §8§l標準核燃料：鈾
rows.english: Standard Nuclear Fuel: Uranium
rows.note: 第1942篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。pulsed reactor段落pack in rods為密集放置燃料棒，原譯停掉燃料棒不準確；未驗證任何反應爐設計。

rows.before: 這僅僅是“普通”的鈾燃料，沒有什麼特殊的。它產生的能量是釷的5倍，而產生的熱量為其4倍，同時持續時間為其2/5。%n%n大多數燃料棒都大同小異。通常在火星及其衛星上獲取鈾，別忘了從釷中也可以離心出一點鈾。%n%n順便一提，有一種“脈衝”型的反應爐，就是在反應爐溫度太高的時候關掉它。你可以停掉這些燃料棒，讓它們冷卻一會兒，這樣每個燃料棒能達到更高的利用效率。喜歡爆炸的話就試試吧。
rows.after: 這僅僅是“普通”的鈾燃料，沒有什麼特殊的。它產生的能量是釷的5倍，而產生的熱量為其4倍，同時持續時間為其2/5。%n%n大多數燃料棒都大同小異。通常在火星及其衛星上獲取鈾，別忘了從釷中也可以離心出一點鈾。%n%n順便一提，有一種“脈衝”型的反應爐，就是在反應爐溫度太高的時候關掉它。你可以密集放置燃料棒，再讓反應爐冷卻一會兒，這樣每個燃料棒能達到更高的利用效率。喜歡爆炸的話就試試吧。
rows.english:
Just "regular" uranium fuel, nothing special about it. It produces 5x the power, and 4x the heat of thorium, while lasting 2/5 the time.

Most fuel rods are basically this, but slightly modified. You generally get this from Mars and its moons, but you can get a little from centrifuging thorium if you want.

BTW, one of the reactor types 'pulses' the reactor to turn it off once it gets too hot. You can pack in the rods and then cool it off for a while to get higher efficiency out of each rod. Try it if you like explosions.
rows.note: 第1942篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。pulsed reactor段落pack in rods為密集放置燃料棒，原譯停掉燃料棒不準確；未驗證任何反應爐設計。

rows.before: §8§l棘手的核燃料：MOX
rows.after: §8§l棘手的核燃料：MOX
rows.english: Tricky Nuclear Fuel: MOX
rows.note: 第1943篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。MOX溫度與熱量條件未程式核對，僅還原最後一句工程師梗。

rows.before: 在正常情況下，MOX的發電與鈾棒相同，但隨著反應爐升溫，MOX可以產出更多能量。想要利用這一優勢，你需要嘗試設計出一種接近極限溫度的熱平衡堆。它的燃燒時間只有鈾棒的一半，且當反應爐溫度超過50％時，MOX棒會放出更多熱量。一根棒子頂所有引擎！%n%n[note]如果沒有其他方式獲取鈽的話，你需要先執行一個普通的鈾堆，再離心枯竭鈾。別忘了MOX棒不止一種！[/note]%n%n[warn]請確保在創造模式測試過且/或做好防爆工作！[/warn]
rows.after: 在正常情況下，MOX的發電與鈾棒相同，但隨著反應爐升溫，MOX可以產出更多能量。想要利用這一優勢，你需要嘗試設計出一種接近極限溫度的熱平衡堆。它的燃燒時間只有鈾棒的一半，且當反應爐溫度超過50％時，MOX棒會放出更多熱量。這是獻給各位工程師的燃料！%n%n[note]如果沒有其他方式獲取鈽的話，你需要先執行一個普通的鈾堆，再離心枯竭鈾。別忘了MOX棒不止一種！[/note]%n%n[warn]請確保在創造模式測試過且/或做好防爆工作！[/warn]
rows.english:
Under normal conditions, produces the same amount of power as uranium, but MOX produces more power the more you let the reactor heat up. Try to come up with a heat-neutral design as close to the limit as possible to take advantage of this. It lasts 1/2 the time, and produces more heat once the reactor is over 50%. A fuel for all the engineers out there.

[note]You'll need to run a uranium reactor for a while to get some plutonium if you don't have another way to get it. Remember that there's more than 1 type![/note]

[warn]Make sure to test in creative and/or use protection against explosions![/warn]

rows.before: 你的基礎蒸汽輪機太佔空間？該解決這個問題了。這臺大型蒸汽輪機可以幫助你生產大量的能源。它還能為你生產蒸餾水，不過你最好迴圈利用這些水。 別忘了為它製造一個渦輪並放入控制器的GUI中，否則這臺多方塊機器就無法正常執行。%n%n每種渦輪都有特定的最佳流量，而蒸汽又是燃料效率最高的工質，具體數值如渦輪的tooltip所示。你可以使用流體校準器覆蓋板，精確調整流量以匹配各種最佳流量，不過你也可以超出最佳流量以獲得更高的功率輸出，不過代價是燃料效率的降低。你可以製造四種尺寸的渦輪轉子，越大的轉子可以提供越高的功率輸出，但其效率有所不同。一般來說，大型渦輪轉子最好，因為它的效率最高，並且擁有不錯的最佳流量。%n%n使用渦輪時，需要注意流速。而所謂最佳流速，即渦輪所列不同燃料的最佳流量，除以對應的燃值。你還可以直接用大型渦輪計算器(Large-Turbine-Calculator)［在主資料表格(spreadsheet)內有個連結，指向discord中的計算器］；還可以在大型渦輪執行時（只需要提供很少的燃料讓它動起來就行），直接掃描主方塊，即可獲知該渦輪轉子使用某種燃料對應的最佳流速。 使用流體校準器或流體流量調節機，確保所提供的燃料速度與渦輪的最佳流速匹配，以發揮最高的燃料效率；不過你也可以選擇超出此最佳流速，以降低效率為代價，獲得更高的功率輸出，而蒸汽渦輪在超出最佳流速後的效率保持是最差的。在HV階段，你可能需要使用IC2的流體流量調節機，HV階段以後就能使用流體校準器覆蓋板了。%n%n再次重複，當你為渦輪提供超過最佳流速的燃料時（稱之為超載狀態），渦輪的輸出功率提高，但燃料效率降低，同時最高輸出功率取決於渦輪轉子類型及其超載效率等級。對於蒸汽渦輪，超載效率等級1：最高超載150％，輸出功率112％；超載效率等級2：最高超載200％，輸出功率133％；超載效率等級3：最高超載250％，輸出功率156％。越接近超載極限，損失的燃料效率越多。 注意，輸出功率不要超過你動力倉的最高輸出功率，不然，嘿嘿你就有麻煩了！%n%n75K耐久以下的渦輪配方已移除。用合適的長桿，使用NEI查詢用途，你就能看到有用的組裝配方了。當然你也可以查我們的資料表格。  長鎂鋁合金桿對應小型渦輪、長鈦桿對應普通渦輪，等等……%n%n登月前，最好的轉子材料是暗影金屬或脈衝合金。%n%n登月後，最好的HV轉子由暗影金屬或奧利哈鋼（不過這是IV材料）製成。幸運的是，現在渦輪機可以支援多A動力倉了，所以如果你需要額外電流，試試看吧！%n%n至於其他選擇，詳見Discord頻道中的大型渦輪計算器和資料表格。

rows.english:
All your little turbines take up too much space? Are you running out of water? It's time to solve these problems. This Large Steam Turbine can help you produce a tremendous amount of energy. It will also distill water for you, so you can use the same water again inside your Large Boiler. Don't forget to make a rotor for the turbine and put inside the controller, otherwise this multiblock won't do anything.

Each turbine has a specific optimal flow, the Steam flow that gives the highest fuel efficiency, the value shown on the turbine's tooltip. This is the flow you want to match, and you can use a Fluid Regulator as a cover to make it exactly what you want, but you can go beyond this flow to get an even higher EU/t value, at a loss of fuel efficiency. You can make turbines in 4 different sizes, with larger turbines producing more EU/t, but with varying amounts of fuel efficiency. Generally, Large is the best due to having the highest fuel efficiency and a good optimal flow rate

When using turbines, be careful of flow rates. To find the optimal flow rate, you divide the optimal energy flow rate listed on the turbine, by the energy value for the plasma. You can also use the Large Turbine Calculator (there's a link on the main spreadsheet, which is linked to in discord), or scan the multiblock's controller while feeding it a minimal amount of plasma to see what the optimal flow is. Make sure to use a Fluid Regulator set to this flow rate for highest fuel efficiency, or go beyond it to get more EU/t at a cost to efficiency, with Steam Turbines being the worst at retaining efficiency beyond the optimal flow.

If you go beyond the optimal flow, you will get a higher EU/t value, but less fuel efficiency, and the maximum EU/t value depends on the turbine type and its Overflow Efficiency tier. For this type of turbine, tier 1 reaches the max at 150% of optimal flow to produce 112% of the EU/t, tier 2 reaches the max at 200% of optimal flow to produce 133% of the EU/t and tier 3 reaches the max at 250% of optimal flow to produce 156% of the EU/t. The closer you get to this maximum, the more fuel efficiency you're throwing away. Don't exceed your dynamo hatch's maximum EU/t output, though, or you will have problems!

Use NEI with the appropriate long rod to find assembler recipes that will work for you. Or the spreadsheet. Long magnalium for small turbines, long titanium for normal turbines, etc.

Pre-moon, the best rotors are Shadow Metal or Vibrant Alloy.

Post-moon, the best HV rotors are Shadow Metal or Oriharukon (this is IV-tier). Luckily, turbines are now fully functional with multi-amp dynamos, so give those a try if you need extra amps!

For additional choices, see the spreadsheet and Large Turbine Calculator.

rows.english:
Using Steam as your single power source in HV is pretty difficult. Your fuel automation will have to be very fast, your pipes will have to be very big and the final efficiency of HV Steam Turbines is 66%, much lower than the other generators' 85%.

This is best used with an efficient furnace, like the GT++ Advanced Furnaces, to power something specific like a farm. Powering your entire automation in your path to an EV, using only these, is a nightmare. If you want more efficiency out of your Steam, consider building a Large Steam Turbine.

rows.english:
The Extreme Combustion Engine is an upgrade to the Large Combustion Engine, the IV version that needs Tungstensteel instead of Titanium. The structure is essentially the same, and it's almost a 1:1 ratio between the two materials, so this is a good generator when you've accumulated several stacks of Tungstensteel.

The caveat is that it only accepts High Octane Gasoline. This is the last and most powerful type of combustion fluid made from Oil, and it has the longest processing line of them all. As a reward, it has an excellent §a2.5M EU per bucket§r, and you can burn it here alongside some Liquid Oxygen for almost §a4 IV amps per tick.

§cThe Liquid Oxygen is very important, because it greatly boosts the speed of the multi and the fuel efficiency as well.§r It needs 40 L/s, so you will need more than one Vacuum Freezer to supply it continuously: for an ECE that is always running, you will need a double Vacuum Freezer, 1 EV and 1 HV. You can run fewer freezers if you overclock them, if the ECE isn't working all the time or if you upgrade to a Cryogenic Freezer,

rows.before: §8§l你聽到引擎聲了嗎？
rows.after: §8§l你聽到引擎聲了嗎？
rows.english: §6§lDo You Hear That Engine Revving?
rows.note: 第1970篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 你老式但可靠的內燃發電機漸漸力不從心，更不用說汙染問題了。 如果你想繼續使用液體燃料，你需要製造一個更好的引擎。%n這臺多方塊可以預設產生1A的EV電壓，如果你給它提供氧氣，則可以產生3A. 然而，這種動力不是毫無代價的-你需要不斷為機器提供少量潤滑劑（如果你想提高效率和輸出，則需要氧氣）。%n%n你還需要3個輸入倉，1個消聲倉和動力倉。這些倉室的等級取決於你。%n%n高十六烷值柴油和高辛烷值汽油(HOG)是這款引擎的優質燃料來源。%n%n你需要保持引擎前方的區域無方塊，以便能夠吸入足夠的空氣-甚至連火把都不能有。

rows.english:
Your old and trusty combustion engines don't quite cut it anymore, not to mention they're polluting the place. If you want to keep burning liquids, you need to build a better engine. This multiblock can produce 1A of EV voltage by default and 3A if you supply it with oxygen. However, this power doesn't come for free - you need to supply the machine with small amounts of lubricant constantly (and oxygen if you want to boost both its efficiency and output).

You will also require 3 Input Hatches, a Muffler, and a Dynamo Hatch. Their tiers are up to you.

Cetane Boosted Diesel and High Octane Gasoline (HOG) are excellent fuel sources for this engine.

You will need to keep the area in front of the engine clear so it can pull enough air - not even torches.
rows.note: 第1970篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §6§l大苯環神教聖堂
rows.after: §6§l大苯環神教聖堂
rows.english: §6§lThe Church of Benzene's Holy Altar
rows.note: 第1971篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: MV燃氣輪機是苯的完美搭檔，現在你能真正製造它了。請到“大眾生物學”工作列檢視詳情，學習如何自動化製造大量的苯，或者直接檢視NEI也行。從樹木中獲取苯是可再生的，也是一種發電的強力手段，而且如果你使用新解鎖的多方塊機器對產線不斷升級的話，它能支援你數個階段的發展。%n%n適時放棄蒸汽是個明智的決定，因為隨著用電需求的不斷提升，你需要巨大的管道來輸送蒸汽，而且現階段的蒸汽輪機效率較低。 相反，製造熱解爐或高階焦爐，讓木炭生產更加迅速，再從中提煉出苯，通入燃氣輪機發電，太妙了，我大苯環神教！

rows.english:
The MV Gas Turbine pairs excellently with Benzene, now that you can actually make it. Look at the "Bio for the Masses" tab for more details on how to go about it, or just check NEI. Benzene is renewable from trees, and it's a powerful source of EU that can keep you going for several tiers as long as you upgrade it with the new multiblocks you unlock over time.

It's a good idea to switch off Steam, since you need big pipes to carry that around and the fuel efficiency on Steam Turbines is lower. Instead, make a Pyrolyse Oven or an Advanced Coke Oven to make Charcoal faster, extract Benzene from it and run it through a few of these Gas Turbines.
rows.note: 第1971篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: MV內燃發電機燃燒輕燃油的速度比起LV版本更快，不過你可以將柴油自動化，並將其用作替代燃料，因為柴油更加強大。柴油可以說是現階段可以實現自動化併產出大量能量的最簡單且最高效的方式，而且如果你不斷對其進行升級，它還可以持續供給你更多階段的能源需求。%n%n另外，柴油可用作直升機揹包的燃料，直升機揹包是很棒的一種噴氣揹包類裝備，它可以讓你在基地內外自由移動。所以如果你有些柴油的話，強烈建議你做個直升機揹包。%n%n[note]此任務還可以解鎖“擺脫死亡，遊歷四方”章節中的任務。[/note]

rows.english:
The MV Combustion Generator burns Light Fuel faster than the LV version, but you can also automate Diesel and burn that instead, since it's even more powerful. It is arguably the easiest and most efficient way to generate lots of power for automation at this stage, and it'll last you a couple more tiers if you upgrade it as you go.

Additionally, Diesel can be used as fuel for the Copterpack, a good jetpack that makes it much easier to move around, inside and outside of your base. It's heavily recommended that you make one, if you have Diesel.

[note]This will also unlock new quests in the Armors and Jetpacks tab.[/note]
rows.note: 第1972篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §6§l流體校準器
rows.after: §6§l流體校準器
rows.english: §6§lFluid Regulator
rows.note: 第1973篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。原文也稱流量不精確爆炸，未程式核對；校準器GUI及外部表格連結保留。

rows.before: 渦輪需要精確控制流量，否則它們會[warn]爆炸[/warn]。將流體校準器貼在連線到輸入倉的管道上來控制進入渦輪的流量。想要提高流量，對準流體校準器的右側，然後：%n%n1L-空手右鍵%n16L-手持螺絲刀右鍵%n256L-手持螺絲刀，Shift+右鍵%n%n想要降低流量，對準流體校準器的左側，其餘操作一致。[note]按住Shift，空手右鍵校準器可以開啟GUI，進行更精確的設定。[/note]%n%n選定燃料後，請使用下面的GTNH發電計算器來計算需要設定的流量。在GTNH，這些數學計算就交給我們吧！至少在這個任務。%n%n[url]https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FTFdfmY_UWbTbFOyNzARKeI90pbHvPBH6M3JHJmaC-E/edit?usp=dsharing[/url]

rows.english:
Turbines require precise amounts of fluids or else they will [warn]explode[/warn]. Use the fluid regulator on the pipe attached to the input bus to control the rate of fluids into the turbine. To raise the fluid limit, look at the right side of the regulator and:

1L - Right-click with an empty hand
16L - Right-click with a screwdriver
256L - Right-click with a screwdriver while sneaking

To lower the fluid limit, do the same while looking at the left side.

Use the Large Turbine Calculator and the Turbine stats sheet on the spreadsheet to find what to set it to (after deciding on a fuel). At GTNH, we do the math for you! For this at least.

[note]If you shift-right-click on it you can use the interface which is more precise.[/note]
rows.note: 第1973篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。原文也稱流量不精確爆炸，未程式核對；校準器GUI及外部表格連結保留。

rows.before: §8§l大型燃氣渦輪
rows.after: §8§l大型燃氣渦輪
rows.english: §6§lGas Turbine
rows.note: 第1974篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。EU/t為輸出功率而非電壓已修正，超載比例未重驗；既有單獨[/warn]保留待格式實測。

rows.before: 大型燃氣渦輪相比於單方塊燃氣輪機，擁有更高的燃料效率，還可以透過升級消聲倉來降低汙染。%n%n你還需要消聲倉、維護倉、輸入倉和動力倉才能構建一臺完整的多方塊機器。別忘了流體校準器，用以控制多方塊的輸入流速！由於大型燃氣渦輪每t需要的最佳流量遠低於大型蒸汽渦輪所需的蒸汽流量，所以不需要太高階的流體校準器（目前LV就夠了）。%n%n每種渦輪材料都有特定的渦輪效率（效率越高，相同量的燃料獲得的EU越多），而且只有燃料的通入速度與最佳流量匹配時，多方塊才能達到此渦輪效率。%n%n再次重複，當你為渦輪提供超過最佳流速的燃料時（稱之為超載狀態），渦輪的輸出電壓提高，但燃料效率降低，同時最高輸出電壓取決於渦輪轉子類型及其超載效率等級。對於燃氣渦輪，超載效率等級1：最高超載150％，輸出功率112％；超載效率等級2：最高超載300％，輸出功率180％；超載效率等級3：最高超載450％，輸出功率252％。越接近超載極限，損失的燃料效率越多。%n%n要得知最佳渦輪材料的資訊，請看Discord頻道中的大型渦輪計算器以及資料表格。譯者注：也可以看看固體氧化物燃料電池MK-II（輸出1A-LuV以上）或者特大燃氣渦輪（輸出無限制）。[/warn]
rows.after: 大型燃氣渦輪相比於單方塊燃氣輪機，擁有更高的燃料效率，還可以透過升級消聲倉來降低汙染。%n%n你還需要消聲倉、維護倉、輸入倉和動力倉才能構建一臺完整的多方塊機器。別忘了流體校準器，用以控制多方塊的輸入流速！由於大型燃氣渦輪每t需要的最佳流量遠低於大型蒸汽渦輪所需的蒸汽流量，所以不需要太高階的流體校準器（目前LV就夠了）。%n%n每種渦輪材料都有特定的渦輪效率（效率越高，相同量的燃料獲得的EU越多），而且只有燃料的通入速度與最佳流量匹配時，多方塊才能達到此渦輪效率。%n%n再次重複，當你為渦輪提供超過最佳流速的燃料時（稱之為超載狀態），渦輪的輸出功率提高，但燃料效率降低，同時最高輸出功率取決於渦輪轉子類型及其超載效率等級。對於燃氣渦輪，超載效率等級1：最高超載150％，輸出功率112％；超載效率等級2：最高超載300％，輸出功率180％；超載效率等級3：最高超載450％，輸出功率252％。越接近超載極限，損失的燃料效率越多。%n%n要得知最佳渦輪材料的資訊，請看Discord頻道中的大型渦輪計算器以及資料表格。譯者注：也可以看看固體氧化物燃料電池MK-II（輸出1A-LuV以上）或者特大燃氣渦輪（輸出無限制）。[/warn]
rows.english:
A Large Gas Turbine is more fuel-efficient than singleblock turbines, and can have lower pollution output with upgraded mufflers.

You will also need a Muffler and Dynamo Hatch to complete the multiblock. Don't forget to use a Fluid Regulator, to control the flow rate into the multi! It can usually be an LV Fluid Regulator, since the optimal flow is much lower here than in Steam Turbines.

Each turbine material has a specific fuel efficiency (the higher, the more EU you get from the same amount of fuel), and the multi only reaches this efficiency if the fuel flow into it matches the optimal flow.

If you go beyond the optimal flow, you will get a higher EU/t value, but less fuel efficiency, and the maximum EU/t value depends on the turbine type and its Overflow Efficiency tier. For this type of turbine, tier 1 reaches the max at 150% of optimal flow to produce 112% of the EU/t, tier 2 reaches the max at 300% of optimal flow to produce 180% of the EU/t and tier 3 reaches the max at 450% of optimal flow to produce 252% of the EU/t. The closer you get to this maximum, the more fuel efficiency you're throwing away.

For the best turbine materials, see the spreadsheet and Large Turbine Calculator.
rows.note: 第1974篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。EU/t為輸出功率而非電壓已修正，超載比例未重驗；既有單獨[/warn]保留待格式實測。

rows.english: §6§lLarge Heat Exchanger - Fermat's Last
rows.note: 第1977篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 大型熱交換機是一種產能多方塊機器，可以接受非直接的燃料，輸出的也不是EU。那是它是用來做什麼的呢？ §7燒開水！§r%n%n實際上，它是一種蒸汽鍋爐，使用某些流體替代了固體燃料，不過機制更加複雜。它的三種主要“燃料”是岩漿，熱冷卻液和太陽能鹽（熱），其中太陽能鹽（熱）最強，但獲取也最困難。 透過煉獄之壺或無數其他選擇都可以輕易實現岩漿自動化，熱冷卻液通常出產於流體核反應爐，而太陽能鹽（熱）則在太陽能塔中生產。%n%n使用岩漿時，大型熱交換機§d每1L岩漿輸出160L蒸汽，輸入岩漿速度最高為1000L/s§r（也就是100%%渦輪效率下§a4000 EU/t§r）。使用冷卻液時，大型熱交換機§d每1L熱冷卻液輸出400L蒸汽，輸入熱冷卻液速度最高為800L/s§r（也就是100%%渦輪效率下§a8000 EU/t§r）。使用太陽能鹽（熱）時，大型熱交換機§d每1L太陽能鹽（熱）輸出2000L蒸汽，輸入太陽能鹽（熱）速度最高為160L/s§r（也就是100%%渦輪效率下§a8000 EU/t§r）。%n%n§c當你超出此輸入速度時，輸出變為過熱蒸汽，需要透過高壓蒸汽渦輪才能變回普通蒸汽。§r這時的最大輸入速度為之前的兩倍，轉換率變為§d岩漿1:80§r，§d熱冷卻液1:200§r，而§d太陽能鹽（熱）1:1000§r，同時100%%渦輪效率下能量輸出為岩漿的§a12000 EU/t§r，熱冷卻液的§a24000 EU/t§r以及太陽能鹽（熱）的§a24000 EU/t§r。%n%n§6§l非常強大，但也很複雜，需要大型蒸汽渦輪！§r%n%n想要獲知更多資訊，請到[url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Large_Heat_Exchanger[/url]閱讀其機制，或去到[url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Fluid_Reactor[/url]，學習如何使用流體反應爐。%n%n[note]中文wiki 大型熱交換機：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/959[/url]§r[/note]

rows.english:
The Large Heat Exchanger is a powergen multi that accepts a non-direct fuel, and doesn't output EU. What is it for, then? §7To heat up water with hot liquids, that's what!§r

Effectively, it's a Steam Boiler that uses fluids instead of solids, but it's more complicated. The three sources of energy are Lava, Hot Coolant, and Hot Solar Salt. The salt is the most powerful, but hardest to get. Lava can be automated from Everburn Urns or a myriad of other options, Hot Coolant usually comes from Fluid Nukes, and Hot Solar Salt is produced in the Solar Tower.

For Lava, the LHE outputs §d160 L of Steam for every 1 L of Lava, up to 1000 L/s of Lava input§r (§a4000 EU/t§r at 100% turbine efficiency). For Hot Coolant, the LHE outputs §d400 L of Steam for every 1 L of Hot Coolant, up to 800 L/s of input§r (§a8000 EU/t§r at 100% turbine efficiency). For Hot Solar Salt, the LHE outputs §d2000 L of Steam for every 1 L of Hot Solar Salt, up to 160 L/s of input§r (§a8000 EU/t§r at 100% turbine efficiency).

§cIf you go above these input rates, the output becomes Superheated Steam, which needs to pass through a Large HP Steam Turbine before the regular Large Steam Turbine.§r The maximum input rate here is twice of what was before and the conversion rates are now §d1:80 for Lava§r, §d1:200 for Hot Coolant§r, and §d1:1000 for Hot Solar Salt§r. The energy output at 100% turbine efficiency is §a12000 EU/t§r for Lava, §a24000 EU/t§r for Hot Coolant, and §a24000 EU/t§r for Hot Solar Salt.

§6§lVery powerful, but complicated, and needs turbines!§r

For more information, visit [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Large_Heat_Exchanger[/url] or [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Fluid_Reactor[/url].
rows.note: 第1977篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 你不想每次搬動礦機的時候都要重新安裝一大套配套設施，所以你需要某種簡單易用的單方塊發電機為其供能。電漿發電機是一個不錯的選擇。只需遠端傳送燃料即可。%n%n[note]你可能注意到了，隨著電壓等級的提高，電漿發電機的燃料效率在提高，而不像其他發電機一樣下降。享受這個小福利吧，雖說最高效的仍然是多方塊機器：大型電漿渦輪。%n%n譯者注：以後有了虛空採礦場，不用老是搬動，集中使用多方塊電漿供能是個不錯的主意.[/note]

rows.english:
This is the HV version, with the lowest efficiency so far of 85%. You can offset that by just generating more Benzene, alongside Phenol and Toluene in a Distillation Tower, or use Naphtha instead... You have many options at this point, surely enough to fight the increasing power demands of your automation.

Benzene doesn't get upgraded in HV, only in EV. You'll be able to make Nitrobenzene when you're there, and burn it in some turbines bigger than this one.

rows.before: 在HV階段，你不但解鎖了另一種發電機，還解鎖了高十六烷值柴油。在一系列反應之後，你可以獲得這種能量極高的內燃流體燃料，§a每桶可產1M EU§r，並可以在這些改進型發電機中執行相當一段時間。在本階段，你還解鎖了蒸餾塔，所以或許你可以獲取更多更多的燃料供這些發電機使用。%n%n很遺憾，在EV階段解鎖的下一個燃料，並不是由柴油製作的。如果你之後想對付它的話，需要搭建一套完全不同的處理線。
rows.after: 在HV階段，你不但解鎖了另一種發電機，還解鎖了高十六烷值柴油。在一系列反應之後，你可以獲得這種能量極高的內燃流體燃料，§a每桶可產1M EU§r，並可以在這些改進型發電機中執行相當一段時間。在本階段，你還解鎖了蒸餾塔，所以或許你可以獲取更多更多的燃料供這些發電機使用。%n%n很遺憾，在EV階段解鎖的下一個燃料，並不是由柴油製作的。如果你之後想對付它的話，需要搭建一套完全不同的處理線。
rows.english:
In HV, you unlock yet another generator, but also Cetane-Boosted Diesel. After a bunch of reactions, you can get a superpowered combustion fuel that is worth §a1M EU per bucket§r and run it for quite a while on these improved generators. You will also unlock the Distillation Tower here, so you might get even more fuel that you can burn in these generators.

Unfortunately, the next fuel, unlocked in EV, doesn't come from Diesel. It's a completely different processing line, should you wish to tackle it later.
rows.note: 第1996篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: §2§l把‘半流質’塞回發電機裡（LV）
rows.after: §2§l把‘半流質’塞回發電機裡（LV）
rows.english: Putting the 'Semi' Back Into Generators LV
rows.note: 第1997篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。現行GT焦爐倉與英文RC焦爐抽取方式不同，保留現行。

rows.before: 你可能收集了大量的雜酚油，卻幾乎沒有怎麼用它。為了解決這一點，製造一臺半流質發電機，然後將雜酚油作為蒸汽外的第二能源吧！單方塊發電機只會在有EU需求時使用燃料，所以如果你沒有消耗足夠的EU，可能最終雜酚油會塞滿你的快取。%n%n想要將你焦爐中的雜酚油提取出來，你可以使用焦爐倉和你喜歡的流體管道。%n%n燃燒雜酚油的方法還有不少，比方說RC的液態燃燒室，不過半流質發電機便宜得多，使用也更加方便，同時效率也相當出色（就雜酚油而言，是內燃發電機的6倍）。
rows.after: 你可能收集了大量的雜酚油，卻幾乎沒有怎麼用它。為了解決這一點，製造一臺半流質發電機，然後將雜酚油作為蒸汽外的第二能源吧！單方塊發電機只會在有EU需求時使用燃料，所以如果你沒有消耗足夠的EU，可能最終雜酚油會塞滿你的緩衝儲存空間。%n%n想要將你焦爐中的雜酚油提取出來，你可以使用焦爐倉和你喜歡的流體管道。%n%n燃燒雜酚油的方法還有不少，比方說RC的液態燃燒室，不過半流質發電機便宜得多，使用也更加方便，同時效率也相當出色（就雜酚油而言，是內燃發電機的6倍）。
rows.english:
You've probably collected a ton of Creosote and have little to use it on. To fix that, build a Semifluid Generator and use it alongside Steam as a secondary power source! Singleblock generators will only use fuel if there is EU demand, so you might end up with a filled Creosote buffer if you aren't consuming enough EU.

To extract the Creosote from your Coke Ovens, you can use buckets or cells to do it by hand, or the TiCon Faucet into GT fluid pipes, or an Electric Pump cover from You're Going to Hate This #2.

There are other options to burn Creosote, like the Railcraft Liquid Boilers, but this is much cheaper and easier to set up, while still being efficient with Creosote (6x as efficient as Combustion Generators).
rows.note: 第1997篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。現行GT焦爐倉與英文RC焦爐抽取方式不同，保留現行。

rows.before: 如果你還在燃燒雜酚油作為能源的話，那麼你可以使用這種機器獲得MV電壓。雖說不太持久，也絕不是好的主要能源，不過它終歸能為你補充一些EU。%n%n另一種選擇，重燃油？它的每桶燃值與苯相當，360k EU，也是唯一一種每桶燃值超過100k EU的半流質燃料。如果你合成柴油之後還剩下不少的話，用作半流質發電機的燃料是個不錯的法子。
rows.after: 如果你還在燃燒雜酚油作為能源的話，那麼你可以使用這種機器獲得MV電壓。雖說不太持久，也絕不是好的主要能源，不過它終歸能為你補充一些EU。%n%n另一種選擇，重燃油？它的每桶燃值與苯相當，360k EU，也是唯一一種每桶燃值超過100k EU的半流質燃料。如果你合成柴油之後還剩下不少的話，用作半流質發電機的燃料是個不錯的法子。
rows.english:
If you're still burning Creosote for power, you can get MV amps out of it with these machines. It won't last long, and definitely isn't a good main power source, but it'll give you some EU for your trouble.

Alternatively, Heavy Fuel? It has the same EU per bucket as Benzene, 360k, and is the only semifluid with more than 100k per bucket. If you have it, and are not consuming enough for Diesel, you can use it this way.

rows.english:
If you've built Distillation Towers to improve your Oil or Benzene processing line, you might have ended up with some extra fuels that are semifluids, such as Heavy Fuel or Creosote. If you've accumulated them so much that they've started voiding, you can instead make an HV Semifluid Generator and get free power out of them!

The Creosote from one DT that is processing Wood Tar is enough to power the DT itself, depending on the fuel efficiency. One HV generator is just enough to power it.

rows.before: 這臺機器可以利用火箭燃料發電。想要知道怎麼造火箭燃料，你得去“太空競賽”章節看看。GT++有一系列專有的火箭燃料，將它們自動化可以用來在此多方塊機器中發電，同時還可以為你提供探索星辰大海無盡的燃料。%n%n關於火箭引擎的數學計算非常複雜。請檢視控制器方塊的tooltip瞭解詳情，不過大概的使用方式如下：提供足量的二氧化碳，選擇你想要獲得多少EU/t的輸出，根據使用的燃料種類計算所需的燃料量，再根據EU/t值提供足量的液氫進行增壓。%n%n你終歸會將火箭引擎增壓的，有以下幾點原因。假設你至少有一個IV動力倉（緩衝），想要在正常模式輸出接近動力倉極限的電力，燃料效率將會較低，但在增壓模式下就會好很多。另外，這臺多方塊機器不會連續消耗燃料，而是在消耗和不消耗之間間隔一秒，同時輸出的能量保持不變。而在此基礎上增壓可以帶來更好的燃料效率。配合火箭燃料超高的燃值，火箭引擎的輸出功率將非常可觀。%n%n[warn]動力倉溢位可能導致爆炸！請確保你有足夠空間來輸出能量。[/warn]%n%n[note]中文wiki 火箭燃料產線：  §1§n[url]https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/p/742[/url]§r[/note]

rows.english:
This produces power out of Rocket Fuels. To see how to make them, look at the Space Race tab. These are specifically GT++ Rocket Fuels, and automating them for powergen in this multi will also provide you with endless fuel for your space travels.

The math regarding the Rocketdyne is complicated. Looking at the controller's tooltip helps, but the main gist of it is like this: provide Carbon Dioxide and make sure it doesn't run out, choose the EU/t you want to get, calculate the amount of fuel you need for the fuel you will use, and then provide enough Liquid Hydrogen to boost the multi, according to the EU/t value.

You will always want to have the Rocketdyne boosted, for several reasons. Assuming you have at least a buffered IV Dynamo Hatch, outputting close to the maximum on that hatch will lower the fuel efficiency, but not if it's boosted. Additionally, this multi doesn't consume fuel continuously, but with intervals of 1 second between consuming and not consuming, while generating power all the same. Boosting this consumption results in huge fuel efficiency, combined with the high fuel values of the Rocket Fuels.
rows.note: 第2022篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。現行額外動力倉溢位爆炸警告保留；火箭引擎流量公式未程式驗證。

rows.english:
With the power of §cgeothermal energy§r, the Deep Earth Heating Pump can heat up Coolant or boil Distilled Water to create an energy source from the Earth's core.

By using a Heat Exchanger, you can convert the Hot Coolant into steam and use it in your turbines.

Alternatively, you can make it output Superheated Steam directly, but only at 66% of the efficiency the hot coolant can achieve

rows.after: 與上一級一樣，但發電更多/更好。加熱時間更少，但消耗燃料的速度也更快。在長期產能方面它仍然比不上全速執行的大型燃氣渦輪，但它可以做到快速反應。別忘了還要配合大型高壓蒸汽渦輪。%n%n正確設定後，它能提供1A以上的LuV輸出。
rows.english:
It's the same as the previous, but more/better. It takes less time to heat up, but it chews through fuel pretty fast too. It still isn't as good as an LGT for power produced over time, but it can produce power faster. As long as you use it with the HP Steam Turbine.

It can produce 1A+ of LuV if you set it up right.

rows.after: §8§l固體氧化物燃料電池 Mk-I

rows.note: 第2036篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。原文100L/s氧與中文100mB/s為GT遊戲流體單位用法，未自行1000倍換算。

rows.before: 它可以使用氣體燃料，同時產生能量和蒸汽（只在加熱後產生），而且0汙染。如果其他發電機都有各種汙染問題的話，那麼這種發電機就是最佳解決方案了。%n%n它可以產出§a4A-HV/t§r，而且燃料效率不錯，同時每秒消耗100mB氧。 燃料電池還會隨著時間的推移而逐漸加熱，直到效率達到100％，此時它會開始同時輸出蒸汽。你可以使用單方塊或多方塊的蒸汽輪機，從中獲取額外能量。%n%n這兩者結合使其比你一開始建造的大型燃氣輪機更加強大。只有當你解鎖了更好的材料時，它才能比燃料電池-MK-I產出更多的能量。
rows.after: 它可以使用氣體燃料，同時產生能量和蒸汽（只在加熱後產生），而且0汙染。如果其他發電機都有各種汙染問題的話，那麼這種發電機就是最佳解決方案了。%n%n它可以產出§a4A-HV/t§r，而且燃料效率不錯，同時每秒消耗100mB氧。 燃料電池還會隨著時間的推移而逐漸加熱，直到效率達到100％，此時它會開始同時輸出蒸汽。你可以使用單方塊或多方塊的蒸汽輪機，從中獲取額外能量。%n%n這兩者結合使其比你一開始建造的大型燃氣輪機更加強大。只有當你解鎖了更好的材料時，它才能比燃料電池-MK-I產出更多的能量。
rows.english:
It uses Gas fuels to produce power and Steam at the same time, while also generating 0 pollution. If the other generators were being problematic, this is the best solution.

It produces §a4 HV amps per tick§r at a nice fuel efficiency, while consuming 100 L of Oxygen per second. It will heat up over time until it reaches 100% efficiency, at which point it starts outputting Steam as well. You can then use Steam Turbines, singleblocks or multiblocks, to generate even more power.

With these two things combined, it's more powerful than the Large Gas Turbine that you can build at the start. Only when you unlock better materials for that, will it generate more power than the SOFC Mk I.

rows.before: §5§l它是‘過熱’蒸汽
rows.after: §5§l它是‘過熱’蒸汽
rows.english: It's 'Super' Heated Steam
rows.note: 第2037篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 所以這意味著它會產生§o兩倍§r的能量！你可以透過大型熱交換機、固體氧化物燃料電池MKII或鈦/鎢鋼鍋爐獲得過熱蒸汽。透過高壓蒸汽渦輪後，過熱蒸汽會1:1地轉化為普通蒸汽，所以最好再加一臺普通蒸汽渦輪以達到最大利用率。加起來就是，一臺高壓蒸汽渦輪配合一臺普通蒸汽渦輪，過熱蒸汽得到了普通蒸汽3x的能量輸出。
rows.after: 所以這意味著它會產生§o兩倍§r的能量！你可以透過大型熱交換機、固體氧化物燃料電池MKII或鈦/鎢鋼鍋爐獲得過熱蒸汽。透過高壓蒸汽渦輪後，過熱蒸汽會1:1地轉化為普通蒸汽，所以最好再加一臺普通蒸汽渦輪以達到最大利用率。加起來就是，一臺高壓蒸汽渦輪配合一臺普通蒸汽渦輪，過熱蒸汽得到了普通蒸汽3x的能量輸出。

It gets converted to normal steam as the output at a 1:1 ratio, so make sure to have a non-HP one to take advantage of that. In total, an HP Steam Turbine and a regular one combined produce 3x the EU with Superheated Steam that normal Steam would produce.

rows.before: §8§l進階反應爐
rows.after: §8§l進階反應爐
rows.english: More Advanced Reactors
rows.note: 第2038篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。流體／強冷／扳手核電為文案對照，未驗證或執行任何反應爐設計。

rows.before: 流體反應爐，還有冰箱核電和扳手反應爐(lol)，是不同於普通版的進階版本。%n%n流體反應爐的建造方式與普通反應爐不同（使用右側的這些方塊，在普通核電外圍成一個5x5x5的中空立方體），目的是產生儘可能多的熱冷卻液（熱交換後迴圈使用），再將其轉化為電力。流體反應爐自己不發電，但更全面。將熱冷卻液送到大型熱交換機，即可獲得過熱蒸汽，再將其依次透過高壓蒸汽渦輪、普通蒸汽渦輪。%n%n冰箱核電（我們一般叫強冷） 指不透過散熱片，而是使用冷卻單元吸收熱量，維持反應爐的熱平衡。再用真空冷凍機恢復氦/鈉鉀冷卻單元耐久。這樣就無需透過散熱片來保證產熱散熱平衡，意味著可以塞更多的燃料棒，但一個小問題就會……KA-BOOM！%n%n扳手反應爐 指將反應爐塞滿燃料棒，啟動，在其爆炸前用扳手拆掉，重置熱量狀態。如果你可以將這個過程自動化，你就能獲得我們GTNH核科學的最高獎章！%n%n要是你還不知道MOX怎麼用，讓我來教教你。簡而言之，MOX燃料棒的發電量隨堆溫升高而升高。所以你需要維持好熱平衡並儘可能地提高堆溫。不過太高的堆溫可能造成附近的方塊被§o融化§r。MOX或者超能矽岩燃料棒都有這樣的功效。另外，MOX可以產出不少鈽（而鈾偏少）。%n%n增殖反應爐 指搭建此反應爐，更傾向於獲得其產物而非靠其發電，比如用釷堆獲得鎦，MOX堆獲得鈽，等等。請在NEI或wiki中檢視燃料棒（枯竭xxx）的用途。%n%n[note]由於冷卻液耗盡時，流體反應爐很容易爆炸，所以請確保正確設定了溫度相關的紅石訊號，可以緊急關停反應爐。（建議其他任何反應爐都設定一個溫控保險）[/note]

rows.english:
Fluid Nukes, Vac Nukes and Wrench Reactors (lol), are more advanced versions of the normal one.

Fluid means you build it differently (with the parts on the right, it's a 5x5 cube surrounding the normal one), with the goal of producing as much hot coolant (cycle in non-hot) as possible, to use that to produce power. It doesn't produce power on its own, but more overall. Send it to the LHE to get SH steam out of it, then go through an HP steam turbine, then a normal steam turbine.

Vac nukes remove heat by sending it to coolant cells instead of coolant. Any cell in a cardinal direction will receive the heat instead of the reactor. Use a vacuum freezer to restore the Helium/NaK cells' durability.

Wrench reactors are when you fill the reactor with fuel rods, turn it on, and wrench it to reset its heat state before it explodes. If you can automate it, you deserve a medal!

If you still don't know what a MOX one is, it produces more power the higher the temperature, so you try to keep it heat neutral, and as hot as possible. Of course, this can cause things nearby to, well, §omelt.§r You use MOX or Naquadria fuel cells work for this. You can also get more Plutonium out of MOX than Uranium.

A breeder reactor is when you set up a reactor to get an item out of it rather than power, like Lutetium from Thorium, Plutonium from MOX, etc. Look at the depleted x fuel rod list in NEI or on the wiki to see more.

[note]Since Fluid Nukes are liable to explode if you run out of coolant, make sure you set up a cutoff tied to the temperature or amount of coolant with redstone.[/note]

rows.before: 這是矽岩反應爐的多方塊版本，與單方塊版本的工作原理差異很大。%n%n它需要的是流體態的矽岩燃料或激發態的核燃料，而輸出的是枯竭的燃料。你可以在NEI查到流體燃料的詳細資料。%n%n大型矽岩反應爐執行時每秒消耗2400L液態空氣，如果沒有，就會持續消耗燃料但不產出能量。%n%n輸入冷卻液可以提升效率。%nIC2冷卻液：1.05x%n超級冷卻液：1.5x%n極寒之凜冰：2.75x%n富快子時間流體：5.00x%n%n輸入激發流體可以提高輸出功率。%n熔融銫：2x%n熔融鈾-235：3x%n熔融矽岩：4x%n熔融原子分離催化劑：16x%n擴大化空間流體：64x%n請注意：與冷卻液直接提升輸出不同，激發流體提高功率的同時會相應地消耗更多的燃料。激發流體更像是給反應爐加了“並行”。%n%n大型矽岩反應爐同樣支援§9Tec§1Tech§r多A動力倉和雷射倉。%n%n[note]注：在使用最好的冷卻液，激發流體和燃料時，這臺發電機的發電量會達到6640億EU/t。[/note]

rows.english:
The multi block version of the naquadah reactor, but it is completely different from the single block ones.

It uses liquid naquadah or excited nuclear liquid as fuel, and outputs the depleted fuel. You can see the liquid fuel information in NEI.

It consumes 2400 L/s liquid air when running, otherwise it will keep consuming your fuel without outputting power.

[warn]It will explode with more than one types of fuel in its hatches.[/warn]

You can input in coolant to increase efficiency.
IC2 Coolant: 1.05x
Super Coolant: 1.5x
Cryotheum: 2.75x
Tachyon Rich Temporal Fluid: 5.00x

You can also input boosters to increase power.
Molten Caesium: 2x
Molten Uranium-235: 3x
Molten Naquadah: 4x
Molten Atomic Separation Catalyst: 16x
Spatially Enlarged Fluid: 64x
Note: It will consume more fuel to match the output power, unlike coolant which directly increases the power. The boosters work like 'parallels' for your reactor.

It also supports §9Tec§1Tech§r's Multi-Amp Dynamo hatches and laser hatches.

[note]PS: This generator can produce up to 664 billion EU/t with the best coolant, boosters and fuel available.[/note]

rows.before: LuV階段的化學燃料發電機？好吧，如果你是柴油神教或大苯環神教的狂熱信徒，那你一定會喜歡上它的。%n%n%n%n這臺引擎可以接受所有的柴油燃料、氣體燃料以及火箭燃料（不過後面用大型火箭引擎效率更高）。它還需要助燃劑才能保持正常執行。%n%n這臺引擎每秒會消耗輸入倉中所有的燃料與助燃劑，並基於總燃值輸出能量。%n%n而效率取決於助燃劑/燃料比。這個比值越大（助燃劑越多），效率越高，最高為150％，但想要達到這個極限效率需要輸入近乎無限的助燃劑。對於高辛烷值汽油這類高燃值燃料，除非不計成本地投入助燃劑，正常的效率期望約為130％。%n%n舉個例子：你每秒輸入100mB高辛烷值汽油以及1000mB助燃劑。效率為149％，而高辛烷值汽油的總燃值為250,000 EU. 所以輸出能量為250，000*1.49/20=18，625 EU/t

rows.english:
A chemical fuel engine for LuV? Well, if you are a crazy fan of diesel or benzene, you will love it.

This engine accepts all diesel, gas and also rocket fuel, although the Rocketdyne burns the latter more efficiently. It also needs Combustion Promoter to keep it running.

This engine consumes all fuel and combustion promoter in its input hatches per second and outputs power depending on the amount of fuel consumed, and its fuel value.

Its efficiency is determined by the Combustion Promoter/Fuel ratio. If the ratio is larger (there is more promoter), the efficiency will be higher. The max efficiency is 150%, but you cannot achieve this value without inputting an infinite amount of promoter. Expect efficiencies around 130% for high fuel value fuels like High-Octane Gasoline, unless you spend a LOT of promoter.

e.g. You input 100mB/s of HOG and 1000mB/s of combustion promoter. The efficiency is 149% and the sum of the HOG fuel value is 250000 EU. The output power will be 250,000 * 149% / 20 = 18625 EU/t.
rows.note: 第2051篇desc對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。效率149%範例及燃料消耗未程式驗證。

rows.before: 在這部分，你可以在發電之餘獲得一些有用的東西。氙和高階鎳鈦諾，其中多虧了保護氣配方的改革，氙在工業高爐中變得十分有用。而至於高階鎳鈦諾，如果你還沒為它專設一個量子反常，可以試一下這個配方。誰知道將來還有些什麼。%n%n由於就在最後一步核融合之前，這些配方也是和之前一樣的0.144:1的比例，成為你使用壓縮核融合反應爐的障礙。需要重點關注的是倒數第二個核融合配方，高階鎳鈦諾電漿，你需要9.216或者說是10臺MK3核融合反應爐來供給一臺核融合天體鎢電漿的MK3壓縮核融合反應爐。而如果使用壓縮核融合反應爐製作高階鎳鈦諾電漿，並且只要能夠為其提供充足的原料，那就可以供給6臺核融合天體鎢電漿的MK3壓縮核融合反應爐。

rows.english:
It's here that you might yourself with some useful stuff alongside power. Xenon, which has become very useful in the EBF thanks to noble gas changes in its recipes, and Advanced Nitinol? If you don't already have a Quantum Anomaly setup for it, you can use this. Who knows what'll come in the future?

These recipes are the same 0.144 ratio ones that you've seen before and, since they're just before the final step, they will bottleneck you on the path to compact reactor setups. The one to focus on is Advanced Nitinol, which is the second last recipe, and where you'll need 9.216, or 10 Mk3 reactors to sustain a Celestial Tungsten compact at the end. If you build a compact here, however, you can feed 6 compacts as long as everything that comes before this is fast enough.

rows.before: 要完成這條核融合產線，你需要用一種特殊的材料，也是GT++的材料：泰坦精鋼，來激發你的星體鈦電漿。泰坦精鋼可是耗電大頭，這也是為什麼只需要2L這麼低的輸入量，你也不得不將一臺冶煉泰坦精鋼的合金冶煉爐貢獻給一臺核融合虛恩電漿的MK2反應爐。如果你想擴大這條產線的規模，最佳方案就是建造一臺巨型合金冶煉爐，並利用工業高爐的線圈來節省一些電力消耗，進而提高發電產線效率。%n%n虛恩電漿有著350M的熱值，也就可以很好地執行在三元金屬巨型渦輪而沒有懲罰，但錫電漿由於其熱值不及虛恩電漿的一半，在相同的渦輪配置下會有74.5%%的懲罰。如果你想大規模擴大電漿發電量，可以選擇MK2核融合產線，但MK3核融合產線可能是個更好的選擇。%n%n0.144:1的反應爐比例也同樣適用於這步。

To complete this chain, you need to activate the Astral Titanium Plasma you have with a special material, also a GT++ one, called Titansteel. This is a considerable powersink, which is why the input amount is so low at 2L, and it forces you to dedicate an ABS at UV tier to feed one mk2 reactor running the Runite plasma recipe. If you decide to upscale this setup, the best option is to simply build a mega ABS, where you can also use EBF coils to save some EU, and in turn make the powergen chain more efficient.

Runite Plasma has a 350M fuel value, which leaves it free to run on Trinium XLs without penalty, whereas Tin Plasma has a 74.5% penalty on the same turbines due to having less than half the fuel value. If you want to upscale your plasma powergen to great numbers, this is an option, but the mk3 chain is probably the one to choose.

The same ratio of 0.144 to 1 reactors also applies here.

rows.before: 太長；不看：這個任務需求的機械方塊數量是造一個最強的太陽能塔用的，這個塔要超多不鏽鋼，鈦，HV電路板，加上一些其他材料，但是它能產出大概2A LuV。%n%n你嘗試用過太陽能板嗎？可能造過一些？我問你哦，這些太陽能板有什麼共同點……它們不是產蒸汽就是直接產EU，太沒效率了。所有人都忘記了這件事！%n%n單方塊太陽很適合塞在任何有太陽的地方，給機器提供一個穩點的供電。然而，鑑於EU的儲存和運輸相當容易，來嘗試點好東西。不同於直接發電，用周圍環狀排列太陽能反射器將這些太陽能光束集中到中間結構上，然後沐浴在太陽系最強的核融合反應爐的超強力量中吧！%n%n（如果你最後造了更大的核融合，別來和我咬文嚼字）%n%n大致的原理就是，將太陽光直接照在一種比水更好的儲能流體上，太陽能鹽。太陽能塔會加熱所有塔中儲存的流體，但是注意，如果裡面有太多冷的太陽能鹽，它們會吸走大部分熱量從而降低整體的執行效率。%n%n實際上太陽能塔的熱量區間是0到100000,但它只會加熱30000以上熱量的太陽能鹽。每個迴圈中增加的能量取決於反射器的數量以及當前溫度。理想溫度剛好是上限的一半,50000熱量。為了讓太陽能塔工作在最高效率上，你需要慢慢加入冷的太陽能鹽以維持恰當的溫度。具體以什麼流速加入太陽能鹽就留給你自己算了，這取決於你所使用的反射器的數量。%n%n在以上的基礎上像用熱冷卻液那樣透過熱交換產生蒸汽或過熱蒸汽。如果你想要太陽能塔的工作效率最大化，請把它建在永遠白天的個人維度裡。

rows.english:
TL;DR: The casing amount in this quest is for the best Solar Tower, which generates around 2 LuV amps and is a major Stainless Steel, Titanium and HV circuit sink, amongst other things.

Have you ever laid eyes upon a solar panel? You might have built a few of them here. What do they all have in common, I ask you... they generate either Steam or EU directly from sunlight, and that is not efficient. There's something that everybody forgot!

Singleblock solar panels are best to insert anywhere that has sun, and provide constant power to a machine. However, EU storage and transport are easy here, so why not build something better? Instead of generating energy directly, send those warm beams of sunlight into a central structure with circles of Solar Reflectors, and bask in the eternal power of the biggest fusion reactor in the Solar System!

(If you end up making a bigger one, don't come arguing to me about this. Be quiet.)

The whole idea is that the energy of the Sun's rays is directed towards a fluid that can retain the energy, a Solar Salt that does it far better than water. The Solar Tower transfers heat to all the fluid inside it, but watch out! If there's too much cold Solar Salt inside, it will drain away all the heat and slow down the entire process.

In more detail, the Solar Tower has a heat value that ranges from 0 to 100000, and it only heats up Solar Salt at 30000 or above. The amount of heat gained per cycle depends on the number of Reflectors, but also the current heat value: this process is optimal at exactly half the maximum, so 50000 heat. To get a perfect tower setup, you have to slowly feed cold Solar Salt to maintain this heat value, taking away just enough heat to keep it there. I'll let you figure out what the flow rate is, given that it depends on how many Reflectors you have.

From there, generate Steam or SH Steam by heat-exchanging in the same way as Hot Coolant does it. If you want this setup to truly be optimal, do place it in your personal dimension for permanent daylight.

The astral titanium and celestial tungsten for alternate recipe can be sourced from laser engravers or the Plasma Fuel Line.

The tritanium can be sourced using fusion reactors, or by mining in the Deep Dark.

The shirabon will require an immense amount of fusion reactors and DTPFs to sustain.

After Eye of Harmony, condensed raw stellar plasma can be used to improve the yield for even more power.

You will also want to consider the Tachyon Rich Temporal Fluid to get the most out of the Mark VI.

rows.before: 到這就是MK-III核融合產線的結尾了，也是三條核融合產線的總和。在氦電漿的基礎上進行了14次核融合之後，終於將這來之不易的天體鎢電漿收入囊中，其高達720M的熱值可以免疫一眾巨型渦輪的懲罰，直至巨型時空渦輪。%n%n要擴大電漿發電規模直至終極目標和戴森雲，很可能就依靠天體鎢電漿或鋂電漿了，後者雖然是單步配方，但在單堆上的發電量要遜色於前者。64並行的天體鎢電漿的MK3壓縮核融合反應爐配合無盡渦輪有著超過80億EU/t的發電量。要擴大上述發電的規模並沒有那麼……那麼的難，只需要清楚哪些配方會成為最大的瓶頸並且擁有充足的原料。%n%n到目前為止，還沒電漿需要用天體鎢電漿制作，但在將來可能會新增這樣的電漿，尤其是諸如龍血等一眾GT++材料。恭喜你完成這條核融合產線！願原力與你同在。
rows.after: 到這就是MK-III核融合產線的結尾了，也是三條核融合產線的總和。在氦電漿的基礎上進行了14次核融合之後，終於將這來之不易的天體鎢電漿收入囊中，其高達720M的熱值可以免疫一眾巨型渦輪的懲罰，直至巨型時空渦輪。%n%n要擴大電漿發電規模直至終極目標和戴森雲，很可能就依靠天體鎢電漿或鋂電漿了，後者雖然是單步配方，但在單堆上的發電量要遜色於前者。64並行的天體鎢電漿的MK3壓縮核融合反應爐配合無盡渦輪有著超過80億EU/t的發電量。要擴大上述發電的規模並沒有那麼……那麼的難，只需要清楚哪些配方會成為最大的瓶頸並且擁有充足的原料。%n%n到目前為止，還沒有電漿需要用天體鎢電漿製作，但在將來可能會新增這樣的電漿，尤其是諸如龍血等一眾GT++材料。恭喜你完成這條核融合產線！願原力與你同在。
rows.english:
This is the end of the mk3 fusion chain, and the three chains altogether. After 14 fusion recipes on top of Helium Plasma, you hold in your tanks the elusive Celestial Tungsten Plasma, whose fuel value of 720M makes it immune to XL Plasma penalties all the way to spacetime!

Upscaling plasma powergen up to endgame, and the Dyson Swarm, is most likely reliant on either this or Americium Plasma, which is 1-step but not as powerful on a per-reactor basis. This can net you above 8 billion EU per tick, for every Mk3 compact that you have running Celestial Tungsten at 64 parallels, with Infinity turbines. Upscaling this is not so difficult, if you keep in mind which recipes will bottleneck you the most, as long as you have the resources for it.

There are no plasmas that build off Celestial Tungsten Plasma just yet, but it's possible that some might be added in the future, especially for GT++ materials such as Dragonblood. Congratulations on finishing this fusion chain! May the power be with you.

rows.before: 你知道人體內有多少鋅元素嗎？微乎其微，但很重要。現在想象一下這些都是電漿！%n%n和鈮電漿的配方差不多，鋅電漿的配方速度很快。唯一需要注意的是該配方消耗氚而非三元金屬（Tritium not Trinium），其中，氚是氫的一種稀有同位素，可以從氘這種不太稀有的氫的同位素中獲得。氚可以直接從海王星抽取，也可以用太空電梯抽取又或是簡單地離心為氦電漿而自動化的氘。

rows.english:
Do you know how much Zinc you have in your body? Very little, but it's important. Now imagine it's all plasma!

This is a very fast recipe, like Niobium Plasma. The only caveat is that it uses Tritium (not Trinium), a rare isotope of Hydrogen that you can obtain from Deuterium, a less rare isotope. You can pump it directly from Neptune, through the Space Elevator or simply by centrifuging the Deuterium you already automated for Helium Plasma.

rows.after: §9§l§n“半穩定”立了大功
rows.english: "Semi-Stable" doing a lot of work in here
rows.note: 第2061篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。

rows.before: 一個反物質單元！而且是被封存在一個由物質構成的單元中！這一定是很安全的。%n%n反物質正如您所想象的那樣，是物質的對立面。宇宙中的每一個“原子”都有其對應的“反原子”，當兩者相遇時……%n%n它們會互相湮滅，釋放出大量能量！%n%n只是，我們如何才能捕獲這種能量呢？
rows.after: 一個反物質單元！而且是被封存在一個由物質構成的單元中！這一定是很安全的。%n%n反物質正如您所想象的那樣，是物質的對立面。宇宙中的每一個“原子”都有其對應的“反原子”，當兩者相遇時……%n%n它們會互相湮滅，釋放出大量能量！%n%n只是，我們如何才能捕獲這種能量呢？
rows.english:
A cell of antimatter! Contained in a cell made of matter! Surely this is safe.

Antimatter is exactly what you may imagine, the opposite of matter, for every atom in the universe, an "anti atom" exists, and when both meet...

They annihilate themselves, releasing a lot of energy!

But how could you capture this energy?

rows.english: AMERICA!!!!!!!!!

rows.before: §o鋂§r這個名字正如§o銪§r，都是由發現它的機構所在的大洲命名的。這些被美國之力砸到一起的粒子啟動恰當的可控核融合反應，從而讓我們能夠繼續這強大的發電鏈路。這便是鋂電漿，記好了！%n%n實際上，在單配方產能裝置中，這個電漿可能是特大電漿渦輪的最佳選擇。然而，與氦和錫電漿之前的狀態相比，在MK-III壓縮核融合反應爐中，它的速度比較慢，因為鋂電漿沒有192x/128x的並行，更不用說它的配方時間已經是錫的8倍。%n%n為了維持你的UEV/UIV的基地，你還需要大量的Pu-241,但是這條核融合產線可以大大地減少所需的數量，即使兩個輸入（鋂和鋦）都需要鈽-241。%n%n這一步所需的時間超過了這條產線最後一步的一半，因此它是主要的瓶頸之一：如果你把最後一步升級為壓縮核融合反應爐，這裡你就需要37個MK3核融合反應爐來匹配產線的速度。

rows.english:
United States of SMASH those particles together to initiate proper controlled fusion reactions that allow us to continue this immense powergen chain. This is Americium Plasma, remember that!

This is actually the plasma that is probably the best choice for XL Plasma Turbines as a 1-recipe powergen setup. However, compared to Helium and Tin Plasma's previous state, it loses out a lot on speed on a mk3 compact, because it doesn't have the 192x/128x parallels, not to mention its recipe time is already 8x as long as Tin for the same amount of plasma.

It will also demand huge amount of Pu-241 for a UEV/UIV base to be sustained, but this fusion chain greatly reduces the amount needed, even if both inputs actually need Pu-241.

This step takes more than half the time of the final step, so it's one of the major bottlenecks: if you upgrade the final step to a compact, you would need 37 mk3 reactors to match speed here.

rows.before: 硼電漿需要氦電漿來核融合。沒錯，整條能源產線是建立在氦電漿的基礎之上的！%n%n核融合硼電漿的速度要比氦電漿慢很多，所以如果用於核融合這倆電漿的反應爐的數量和等級相同，氦電漿就會嚴重過剩。不過正如你所知，氦電漿對於大型電漿渦輪發電很有用，因此可以將這過剩的氦電漿利用起來為其他的核融合反應爐供能。不過，隨著規模的擴大，單是靠這個可就不大能供上電了。%n%n你需要3.75臺硼電漿的反應爐供給一臺氖電漿的反應爐。

rows.english:
This plasma needs Helium Plasma to be crafted. That's right, this entire powergen chain builds on top of Helium Plasma!

The Boron Plasma step is much slower than the Helium one, so if you match the number of reactors and their tier, you will end up with a large excess of Helium Plasma. As you know, it's very useful for power in Large Plasma Turbines, so you could use this excess to power all the other reactors. As you scale up, however, this alone will probably not be enough.

You will need 3.75 reactors with this recipe to feed 1 reactor with the next step.

rows.after: 鈮化

Do you remember Niobium-Titanium? This time, it's just Niobium! Just kidding, Titanium's coming up in a special form...

Both this and the Zinc Plasma recipe are very fast, so you won't need more than 1 reactor unless your scale is very large. Upgrade later as needed, use a mk2 or even mk3 for now.

rows.before: 你已經精通反物質的生產了，但是單有反物質可不能讓你的機器跑起來。為了將這種潛能轉化為無與倫比的能量，是時候[warn]掌控混沌[/warn]本身了！%n%n[quest]隆重介紹遮蔽拉格朗日湮滅矩陣！[/quest]%n%n反物質發電機透過在可控環境中讓半穩定反物質和普通物質發生反應來產生能量。%n%n每輪迴圈，發電機都會立即消耗輸入倉中所有的物質與反物質，直接將其全部轉換為能量.EU輸出基於等量的物質和反物質發生湮滅。因此，如果輸入數量不平衡，那就會浪費你寶貴的電力。%n%n根據用於湮滅的物質的種類，反物質的量會被進行一次乘方，直接增加每L反物質能產出的能量-這意味著一輪迴圈你湮滅的量越多，效率就越高！%n%n每輪迴圈的最大能量輸出受到結構中所有雷射源倉（至多64個）的容量限制，即使在無線模式也是如此。%n%n[note]它每輪迴圈不能輸出超過9.22e18EU,或者說剛剛好不到43個UXV16,777,216A雷射源倉（如果你真是夠瘋了的話）。[/note]%n%n產出公式和所有可用物質對應的指數如下：%n%n發電量=(§3反物質§r^§6指數§r)*1,000,000,000,000%n%n熔融銅-§61.00§r%n熔融UEV超導粗胚-§61.02§r%n熔融UMV超導粗胚-§61.03§r

rows.english:
You've mastered antimatter production, but raw antimatter alone won't run your machines. To turn that potential into unparalleled power, it's time to [warn]harness the chaos[/warn] itself!

[quest]Introducing the Shielded Lagrangian Annihilation Matrix![/quest]

The SLAM creates raw energy by reacting the Semi-Stable Antimatter with normal matter in a controlled environment.

Every cycle, the generator will react all antimatter and matter in hatches instantly, converting it all into energy directly. The EU output is based on the equal amounts of antimatter and matter annihilated. Therefore, imbalance between the amounts will waste your precious energy.

Depending on the matter used to annihilate, the antimatter amount gets an exponent applied to it, directly increasing the amount of energy produced from 1L of antimatter - this means the more you annihilate in one go, the more efficient it is!

The maximum EU for a cycle is limited by the capacity of all laser source hatches on the structure (limited to 64), even on wireless mode.

[note]It can't output more than 9.22e18 EU in a cycle, or just below 43 16M UXV Laser Sources (If you're crazy enough for it)
[/note]

The Formula and the exponents for each of the possible matters are:

Generated EU = (§3Antimatter§r^§6exponent§r) * 1,000,000,000,000

Molten Copper - §61.00§r
Molten Superconductor Base UIV - §61.02§r
Molten Superconductor Base UMV - §61.03§r

rows.before: 歡迎來到電漿系列任務
rows.after: 歡迎來到電漿系列任務
rows.english: Welcome to the Plasma Chain
rows.note: 第2066篇name對照本機英文；版本／機制差異見待查清單。整線15配方與8B產能為原文對照，未全產線驗證。

rows.before: 你好！如果你已經解鎖了核融合，你就可以開啟這個任務系列了，不過請記住，它被分為了三個部分（即三條核融合產鏈）：每個部分對應了一個等級的核融合反應爐，從Mk-I到Mk-III。%n%n關於電漿發電法，你可以從以下wiki連結中獲取更多細節資訊：[url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Fusion_Reactor[/url]%n%n這些任務追蹤了一些真正強大的電漿的製造流程，當你將產線規模提升至壓縮核融合反應爐與特大電漿渦輪時，這些電漿在遊戲末期的初始階段的發電中大放異彩。如你所見，當你使用優良材料（如三元金屬、無盡等）時，這些巨型渦輪會旋轉得非常快，但它們會根據使用的電漿的燃料熱值施加EU/t懲罰。這意味著氦電漿和錫電漿在這裡的效果要比在大型電漿渦輪中弱得多。%n%n這條產線的最終產物是天體鎢電漿，即使使用時空渦輪也不會有懲罰，而且平均到每個壓縮核融合反應爐時可以在某種程度上達到氦電漿的產出。最後一步是最慢的，但如果沒有其他瓶頸，一個壓縮核融合反應爐進行最後一步反應，在特大電漿渦輪中使用無盡製成的特大渦輪時大約會有§2§l超過8B EU/t§r的產出。%n%n然而，達到這個目標並不容易，整個過程使用了15種核融合配方，材料自動化程度遠遠高於任何簡單的核融合配置。這條任務鏈將會解釋哪些簡單，哪些不簡單，或者甚至成為瓶頸。如果你完成了這系列任務，你將獲得穩定的電力來源，直到你後續採用了戴森雲或者其它接下來出現的發電手段，並且這條產線在未來仍然有用！

rows.english:
Hello there! If you've unlocked fusion, you can start this questline, but keep in mind that it's divided into three segments (the three fusion chains): one for each tier of Fusion Reactor, from Mk1 to Mk3.

There are more fine details surrounding plasma power generation you can access by using the following Wiki link: [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Fusion_Reactor[/url]

These quests follow the process of creating some truly powerful plasmas that are useful for power generation at the beginning of endgame, when you've scaled up your setup to a Compact Fusion Reactor and XL Plasma Turbines. As you might have seen before, those huge turbines can go very fast with good materials, like Trinium or Infinity, but they will apply EU/t penalties according to the fuel value of the plasma used. This means that Helium and Tin Plasma are both much weaker there than they were in Large Plasma Turbines.

The end product of this whole process is Celestial Tungsten Plasma, which has no penalties even at Spacetime and can somewhat match what Helium Plasma would have produced, per compact reactor. The last step is the slowest, but, if there are no other bottlenecks, you can expect around §2§lover 8 billion EU/t§r assuming a single compact doing the last step with huge infinity turbines in a plasma XL.

However, getting there won't be easy. This whole process uses 15 fusion recipes in total, and a lot more material automation than any of the simple fusion setups. This questline will help explain what is simple, not simple, or possibly a bottleneck. If you complete this, you will be sustained in powergen until the Dyson Swarm, or whatever other option appears later on, and it will continue being useful later on!

rows.before: 電漿流能讓渦輪旋轉嗎？不，只是水變成蒸汽，然後再凝成水，只有水在迴圈罷了。檢視上面有關特大蒸汽渦輪關於特大渦輪的共有機制說明。%n%n記住，這臺渦輪機與其他常規的多方塊渦輪機有非常重要的區別。鑑於電漿能很容易在壓縮核融合堆的加持下爆倉，特大電漿渦輪必須採取相應的措施，不然僅多餘一個電漿就會將程序中的EU數值提高到荒謬的程度。然而，特大渦輪機的產能現在有一個基於比較燃料密度與其所使用的轉子材料的減值。%n%n檢視[url]https://i.imgur.com/vifsk0P.png[/url]，關於各種電漿和材料的不同組合。MK-I電漿顯示為綠色，MK-II為黃色，MK-III為紅色。下方的3個是核融合的終產物。%n%n這個公式有點複雜，但這裡列出一些重要的數值：%n-> 氦電漿即使使用無盡催化劑也會受到86.1%%的巨大懲罰值，與此同時錫的懲罰只有53.5%%，這意味著如果使用錫電漿預期產能幾乎是翻倍；%n-> 三元金屬的數值分別為92.4%%和74.5%%；%n-> 使用無盡的懲罰數值更高，分別為97.4%%和91.1%%；%n-> 時空的數值為98.3%%和94.4%%。%n%n這意味著在UHV/UEV階段，沒法再依賴這兩種電漿直接塞給特大渦輪機。在一步配方的電漿中，最好的選擇是mk3鋂電漿，它在使用無盡催化劑時只有微不足道的0.8%%的懲罰。如果想要更快的發電速度，請檢視以熔融天體鎢結束的核融合，它在特大電漿渦輪機中沒有懲罰值為0,並且與以前的氦電漿產能相同。請檢視下方有關核融合的任務。

rows.english:
Here's the special Titanium I promised you. GT++ materials enter the fray here, both with this and the Titansteel you need to add to that to make what comes next!

That step only comes after fusing Niobium and Zinc into Krypton Plasma. You get a rarer noble gas here than before, the next one will be Xenon. This recipe matches in speed with the next one, which uses Krypton to make Astral Titanium Plasma, by adding in the final plasma of the previous chain, Force Plasma! That's right, each chain needs everything from before to continue.

Once you have Astral Titanium Plasma, you can move on to the final mk2 step.

rows.before: 得到之前的兩種電漿後，即刻把他們核融合成新的東西——氖電漿。直接用的話，沒準你會做出來Neon（霓虹燈/氖氣）！當然更多還是用來生產後面更有用的材料，多留意一下。%n%n然而氖不是MK1最後一個需要做的電漿。你需要在適當的階段搞定三種電漿的生產，和一個非電漿材料，才能開始最後的步驟得到最終想要的發電用的電漿。 那個非電漿材料是奧金，你之前可能已經用過了。這一步你最好用合金冶煉爐來實現自動化，並附帶穩定的釷-232供應。%n%n翻合成表時你大概會發現製作1000L力量電漿只需要144L氖電漿，後面系列任務的最終目標產出步驟也是這個數量關係，而且都是一系列核融合配方的瓶頸步驟。一臺力量電漿核融合需要0.144臺氖電漿核融合，或者說，一臺核融合生產氖能供約7臺生產力量電漿（準確說是6.944……臺）。%n%nMK1部分的核融合產鏈到力量電漿為止，這是擁有每桶150M EU燃料值的電漿，它在使用無盡催化劑轉子的特大電漿渦輪中的效率懲罰為53.5％％，而氦電漿同情況下的效率懲罰為86.1％％。可能ZPM階段你還不需要這些，但這些將會是你未來發展的奠基石。
rows.after: 得到之前的兩種電漿後，即刻把它們核融合成新的東西——氖電漿。直接用的話，沒準你會做出來Neon（霓虹燈/氖氣）！當然更多還是用來生產後面更有用的材料，多留意一下。%n%n然而氖不是MK1最後一個需要做的電漿。三條核融合產線都有最後的活化步驟：加入對應科技等級的非電漿材料，製取發電用的電漿。 那個非電漿材料是奧金，你之前可能已經用過了。這一步你最好用合金冶煉爐來實現自動化，並附帶穩定的釷-232供應。%n%n翻合成表時你大概會發現製作1000L力量電漿只需要144L氖電漿，後面系列任務的最終目標產出步驟也是這個數量關係，而且都是一系列核融合配方的瓶頸步驟。一臺力量電漿核融合需要0.144臺氖電漿核融合，或者說，一臺核融合生產氖能供約7臺生產力量電漿（準確說是6.944……臺）。%n%nMK1部分的核融合產鏈到力量電漿為止，這是擁有每桶150M EU燃料值的電漿，它在使用無盡催化劑轉子的特大電漿渦輪中的效率懲罰為53.5％，而氦電漿同情況下的效率懲罰為86.1％。可能ZPM階段你還不需要這些，但這些將會是你未來發展的奠基石。
rows.english:
Once you have the two plasmas from before, fuse them together into a new one, Neon Plasma. If you were to use this directly, you could get Neon! There are other, more useful materials to get later in this process, so keep a lookout for those.

However, this is not the final plasma in mk1 recipes. To get it, you need to do the last activation step, which exists in all three chains, and involves adding a non-plasma related material, of the appropriate GT tier, to obtain the powergen plasma. The material you need here is Arcanite, one you probably have used before. This step requires you to preferably automate it with ABS, and have a steady supply of Thorium 232.

If you look at the last recipe, you'll see it's 144L Neon Plasma input to 1000L Force Plasma output. This multiplying makes it so that step, and all final steps, are the slowest ones. You will need 0.144 Neon Plasma reactors for every Force Plasma reactor, which means that 1 Neon reactor feeds nearly 7 Force reactors (6.9444... reactors, more precisely).

Once you get Force Plasma, this is the end of the mk1 fusion chain. Force Plasma is a 150M fuel value plasma, which means it has a 53.5% penalty with Infinity Catalyst in XL Plasma Generators. This is better than Helium Plasma with its 86.1% penalty but still not great for power generation. You probably don't need this in ZPM, but it'll be a stepping stone for your future progression.

High pressure, superheated loads of energy. Check the XL Steam Turbine quest above for an explanation of the mechanics shared across all turbines.

This XL Turbine is exactly the same as the XL Steam Turbine in the way it upgrades from the regular multi: the only accepted fluid is Superheated Steam, and nothing else works. They are meant to be built together, since any steam setups you might have at this point will surely be using the two.
